name: the history of the unreding
longdesc: An ancient book has been carefully placed to rest against the wall.

extra_descriptions.description:
This book is rather small, and it looks to be a part of a series.  This
particular text appears to be a copy of an original text, as in the bottom 
of each page a scribe has put his trade mark.

The Unreding:

Most of us have at one point or another asked why are we here?  Everyone
has their opinion's of history, but few people want to know the true facts
about how we came to be.  The information contained within this book takes
place in an age before the ages, in a time where gods walked the earth
with man, dwarf, and elven alike.  I had spent my entire youth looking
to understand the arcane, and history.  Studying the mysterious never came
close to preparing me for the events that happened during the Unreding, nor
the world that would remain after.  My role in all of it, was to document
and observe, so here within these volumes contains the summary of how our
world as we know it came to be.  -- Llig of Greece

After the forward the short book continues:

The story of ancient Greece is the story of ancient Rome.  The great rulers
of Rome had always demanded the very best for themselves.  Architecture,
land, wealth beyond all others, proved to be the most important thing in
their hearts.  The Greek were the native Centaurs, artists, knowledge 
seekers, always looking to better themselves and not acquire for themselves.  
The nation of greece was known throughout the known world for their work 
in Athens the city of enlightenment. This members of the Athens community 
had been able  study and understand the arcane nature of the gods of Olympus, 
proving that  the gods indeed did exist. This knowledge eventually led the 
Greeks to make contact with their creators.  This new forged relationship 
of worship and enlightenment allowed the Greek empire to rule its boundaries 
unchallenged.  Worship of the gods was a very public one in all of Greece.  
Gods had been known to personally walk the streets with their worshipers and 
give blessings to them.  
[Continued in chapter2]

As the centuries passed, and the wealth and power of the Greek empire
continued to grow.  Its fame covered the globe.  Travelers would save
their entire lives to afford the trek to Greece just to see some of its
splendor.  

Sula at one time a statesman, saw that the greed of the Romans was growing.
Almost enraged to watch his countrymen come so far away from what the
constitution was, Sula setup to remedy that.  He raised an army of comrades
be using his connections to the state senate.  Sula then did something
unthinkable, he took a newly and poorly trained army and marched on Rome.
Sula, his son Kalas, and the army that had been granted to them did the
unthinkable.  They marched on and occupied Rome, during this occupation Sula
revived the title of dictator in order to restore peace.  Sula wanting
nothing more than the squelch the greed of Rome used his power to enact
a series of reforms to the Roman constitution.  Then he resigned his role
as dictator, and retired from service.

Because of these events, the Caesar approached Sula after his resignation
and asked him to become the protector of Rome and the general of the armies.
Sula then came out of retirement and became a general of fame within the 
Roman Empire.  Even the Emperor of Rome at one point noted: "Sula is highly 
original, a gifted and skillful general, never losing a battle."  With
seemingly unstoppable force, Sula would crush the enemies of the Romans
with very few if any casualties in battle.  The Roman's growing ever more
powerful with their expansion and wealth.  Once again, only a few years after
Sula's conquest of Rome, the greedy nation set their eye upon their peaceful 
neighbor of Greece.  

Sula, being raised near the boarders of Greece knew all to well the power 
the Greeks had. The utopian society, the native and powerful race of 
centaur's that called greece home.  And the power of the Greek gods with 
them, Greece was not to be trifled with.  When the order came to Sula to 
conquer Greece for the glory of the Roman empire, Sula knew that despite 
all his training and experience, he was no match for the armies of Greece.  
Despite all his better judgement, Sula aligned himself with the Witchkings
and Demons of the void to help him in conquering Greece.  The cost the 
Witchkings demanded would be the souls of all those slain during the war, 
Greek or not, to serve the underworld for all eternity.
[chapter3]

Sula with his son and high commander Kalas, set the Roman army and the armies
of the underworld against the nation of Greece.  Nothing stood in the path
of the combined armies, hordes of demons grinning as they slew through
hundreds of thousands of Greeks humans and centaurs.  After several months
into the over year long campaign, the Roman's with their new allies had managed
to decimate the entire human population of the nation of Greece.  Leaving only
the centaur's that had originally populated the land.  

The Roman armies viewed this as a tremendous victory, and began to taunt the 
gods of greece.  Knocking down altar's and temples throughout the land, asking 
cleric's and worshipers of the olympian gods where were their gods now.  
When these events reached the ear's of Sula, he was clearly disturbed, sickened 
by the thought of how their new allies were influencing his countrymen.  In a 
private meeting to his cabinet, he was noted to telling his son, "This is why 
we as a race have failed, we have no control over our bloodlust and hunger for 
power."  Then addressing his cabinet as a whole "The army has developed a thirst 
for blood, just like our allies, we must finish this campaign as quickly as 
possible to avoid becoming like them.  Also, the actions taken against the gods 
of Olympus will not be over looked.  We either must crush the Greeks now, or 
we will not be able to avoid the consequences."

The Romans growing even more bold with their new allys, set their sights on 
attacking Athens and Olympus directly.  Sula wanting to march quickly on Athens
first so as to finish the war, and disassociate himself from the armies of the
Witchkings.  As the city of Athens was surrounded, and a base camp established
at the base of mount Olympus.  The schools of sorcery within Athens prepared to
wage war and took up arms, and prepared to defend the city with the remaining 
militia.  The powerful school's provided tremendous support to the militia, for 
months the Roman armies were driven back as they kept trying to break into the 
fortified city.  Even the undead armies we being forced back with great efficiency.

But after months of war, starving, exhausted both mentally and physically, the
citizens of Athens knew that their city was going to fall.  All of the surviving
citizens went to the temples of the gods and proceeded to worship them for the
seeming last time.
[Chapter4]

It was at this point that the Gods themselves hearing their worshipers and fearing
their demise, entered the fray.  The Olympian Gods revealed themselves within the
walls of Athens, wielding powers unseen by any creature, living or undead.  All 
of the arcane energy left radiating throughout the city from the exhausted mages
types (from both sides of the battle), and gods infinite power battling in the 
land triggered a cataclysmic vortex of celestial power causing the very land to
quake and shatter.  This vortex began to pull in buildings, and the very ground
into it like a giant whirlpool.  At first, none took note as the Gods were turning
the tide of the war again Sula and his allies.  The morale of the armies changed
as men by the thousands were being struck down in mere moments.  Driven back several
times, the allied armies continued with their orders trying to conquer Greece.

Then on the 5th Day of the Month of the Battle, Year 800 it happened.  As the
land of the kingdoms of Greece, Rome, and all the other great kingdoms were
being slowly smashed together by means of vortex created by the limitless power 
of the gods and the underworld colliding. During the final battle a great ball 
of flame flew over head and crashed only a few hundred hectares from the capital 
of Athens.  Right into the armies of Romans and the Underworld.  The demons and 
Witchkings delighting in the destruction of all around them, as they were crushed 
by the fireball and pushed back into the abyss from which they came.  This fireball
was not natural, and it strengthened the power of the cataclysmic vortex and turned
it from a slow whirlpool into a raging devouring one.

All of the raw power crashing into the ground caused the very foundations of 
the world to shake.  Such power was never seen before, and will never be seen 
again.  Even the gods felt their immortality threatened by the release of such 
energy.  The Greek gods came together and used all of their combined power 
to stop the vortex and crater from causing the entire world to implode.  The cost 
was severe.  The ancient nation of greece was reduced to ruins, the knowledge, 
the peace, the utopia, gone.  The gods exhausting their strength to save all of 
creation, became shades of what they once were.  Now angerly roaming the ruins 
of their once beautiful home.  The ancient continent physically altered forever, 
deserts, grasslands, rivers all smashed together in an unnatural state.  The 
few centaurs that survived the war, fled their homeland in an attempt put the 
past behind them.

Rome, forever gone, only Sula and a few loyal members of his cabinet survived.  
Sula, loosing his son in the final battle finally realized what his deal with
his allies had cost him.

So all on the newly formed ancient continent began to rebuild their civilizations.  
New races such as the Skexie began to walk the ground.  Others exposed from the underdark
for the first time.... This event had forever changed the world, the great fireball
seen flying through the air moments before the massive shaking of the ground became
known as the "Hammer of the Gods".  Every year on the same day, celebrations are
held throughout the world in memorial of those whom sacrificed so much on that
fateful day.

                    Attention Traveller!
                    --------------------
    Midgard is located in an region that contains many opportunities 
    for excitement and adventure.  The Midgard Explorers Guild has
    erected these signposts to aid those who are new to our city.

    Please ensure your map is on by typing config.  If it shows a minus
    sign before the map, please type config map to toggle it on.

    You can travel quickly to any of these locations by typing the 
    listed go command into your console.  Locations are specific places
    that you may wish to visit.  Waypoints are locations that lead to
    other areas.  Look for signs for further directions.

    LOCATION            DIFFICULTY     DIRECTIONS
    --------            ----------     ----------
    Bounce Room         All            go 2d
    
    Chessboard          New-Low        go 5w 4s 2w u
    Carnival            New-Low        go 5w carnival
    Museum              New-Low        go 3w museum
    Filthy Mansion      Low-Mid        go 6e gate 4s e
    Mortuary            All            go d w
    Pharaoh             New-Low        go 2d (and touch the door)

    WAYPOINT            DIFFICULTY     DIRECTIONS
    --------            ----------     ----------
    Outside East Gate   All            go 6e gate 3e gate
    Outside West Gate   All            go 5w 6s 6w gate

    Please be warned that exploring is a dangerous profession and that
    the Midgard Explorer's Guild offers no guarantees of safe travel.
    If something unfortunate does befall you, the Head Mortician
    always appreciates your business.

#{bold}HANSEL AND GRETEL#{o}
By Jacob Grimm and Wilhelm Grimm

Hard by a great forest dwelt a poor wood-cutter with his wife and his two children.  The boy was called Hansel and the girl Gretel.  He had little to bite and to break, and once when great dearth fell on the land, he could no longer procure even daily bread.  Now when he thought over this by night in his bed, and tossed about in his anxiety, he groaned and said to his wife: 'What is to become of us? How are we to feed our poor children, when we no longer have anything even for ourselves?' 
 'I'll tell you what, husband,' answered the woman, 'early tomorrow morning we will take the children out into the forest to where it is the thickest; there we will light a fire for them, and give each of them one more piece of bread, and then we will go to our work and leave them alone. They will not find the way home again, and we shall be rid of them.' 
 'No, wife,' said the man, 'I will not do that; how can I bear to leave my children alone in the forest, the wild animals would soon come and tear them to pieces.' 
 'O, you fool!' said she, 'then we must all four die of hunger, you may as well plane the planks for our coffins,' and she left him no peace until he consented. 
 'But I feel very sorry for the poor children, all the same,' said the man.

The two children had also not been able to sleep for hunger, and had heard what their stepmother had said to their father. Gretel wept bitter tears, and said to Hansel: 'Now all is over with us.' 
 'Be quiet, Gretel,' said Hansel, 'do not distress yourself, I will soon find a way to help us.' 
 And when the old folks had fallen asleep, he got up, put on his little coat, opened the door below, and crept outside. The moon shone brightly, and the white pebbles which lay in front of the house glittered like real silver pennies. Hansel stooped and stuffed the little pocket of his coat with as many as he could get in. Then he went back and said to Gretel: 'Be comforted, dear little sister, and sleep in peace, God will not forsake us,' and he lay down again in his bed. 
 When day dawned, but before the sun had risen, the woman came and awoke the two children, saying: 'Get up, you sluggards! we are going into the forest to fetch wood.' 
 She gave each a little piece of bread, and said: 'There is something for your dinner, but do not eat it up before then, for you will get nothing else.' 
 Gretel took the bread under her apron, as Hansel had the pebbles in his pocket. Then they all set out together on the way to the forest. When they had walked a short time, Hansel stood still and peeped back at the house, and did so again and again. His father said: 'Hansel, what are you looking at there and staying behind for? Pay attention, and do not forget how to use your legs.' 
 'Ah, father,' said Hansel, 'I am looking at my little white cat, which is sitting up on the roof, and wants to say goodbye to me.' 
 The wife said: 'Fool, that is not your little cat, that is the morning sun which is shining on the chimneys.' 
 Hansel, however, had not been looking back at the cat, but had been constantly throwing one of the white pebble-stones out of his pocket on the road.

When they had reached the middle of the forest, the father said: 'Now, children, pile up some wood, and I will light a fire that you may not be cold.' Hansel and Gretel gathered brushwood together, as high as a little hill. The brushwood was lighted, and when the flames were burning very high, the woman said: 'Now, children, lay yourselves down by the fire and rest, we will go into the forest and cut some wood. When we have done, we will come back and fetch you away.'

Hansel and Gretel sat by the fire, and when noon came, each ate a little piece of bread, and as they heard the strokes of the wood-axe they believed that their father was near. It was not the axe, however, but a branch which he had fastened to a withered tree which the wind was blowing backwards and forwards. And as they had been sitting such a long time, their eyes closed with fatigue, and they fell fast asleep. When at last they awoke, it was already dark night. Gretel began to cry and said: 'How are we to get out of the forest now?' 
 But Hansel comforted her and said: 'Just wait a little, until the moon has risen, and then we will soon find the way.' 
 And when the full moon had risen, Hansel took his little sister by the hand, and followed the pebbles which shone like newly-coined silver pieces, and showed them the way.

They walked the whole night long, and by break of day came once more to their father's house. They knocked at the door, and when the woman opened it and saw that it was Hansel and Gretel, she said: 'You naughty children, why have you slept so long in the forest, we thought you were never coming back at all!' 
 The father, however, rejoiced, for it had cut him to the heart to leave them behind alone.

Not long afterwards, there was once more great dearth throughout the land, and the children heard their mother saying at night to their father: 'Everything is eaten again, we have one half loaf left, and that is the end. The children must go, we will take them farther into the wood, so that they will not find their way out again; there is no other means of saving ourselves!' 
 The man's heart was heavy, and he thought: 'It would be better for you to share the last mouthful with your children.' 
 The woman, however, would listen to nothing that he had to say, but scolded and reproached him. He who says A must say B, likewise, and as he had yielded the first time, he had to do so a second time also.

The children, however, were still awake and had heard the conversation. When the old folks were asleep, Hansel again got up, and wanted to go out and pick up pebbles as he had done before, but the woman had locked the door, and Hansel could not get out. Nevertheless he comforted his little sister, and said: 'Do not cry, Gretel, go to sleep quietly, the good God will help us.'

Early in the morning came the woman, and took the children out of their beds. Their piece of bread was given to them, but it was still smaller than the time before. On the way into the forest Hansel crumbled his in his pocket, and often stood still and threw a morsel on the ground. 'Hansel, why do you stop and look round?' said the father, 'go on.' 
 'I am looking back at my little pigeon which is sitting on the roof, and wants to say goodbye to me,' answered Hansel. 
 'Fool!' said the woman, 'that is not your little pigeon, that is the morning sun that is shining on the chimney.' 
 Hansel, however little by little, threw all the crumbs on the path. The woman led the children still deeper into the forest, where they had never in their lives been before. Then a great fire was again made, and the mother said: 'Just sit there, you children, and when you are tired you may sleep a little; we are going into the forest to cut wood, and in the evening when we are done, we will come and fetch you away.' 
 When it was noon, Gretel shared her piece of bread with Hansel, who had scattered his by the way. Then they fell asleep and evening passed, but no one came to the poor children. They did not awake until it was dark night, and Hansel comforted his little sister and said: 'Just wait, Gretel, until the moon rises, and then we shall see the crumbs of bread which I have strewn about, they will show us our way home again.' 
 When the moon came they set out, but they found no crumbs, for the many thousands of birds which fly about in the woods and fields had picked them all up. 
 Hansel said to Gretel: 'We shall soon find the way,' but they did not find it. 
 They walked the whole night and all the next day too from morning till evening, but they did not get out of the forest, and were very hungry, for they had nothing to eat but two or three berries, which grew on the ground. And as they were so weary that their legs would carry them no longer, they lay down beneath a tree and fell asleep.
It was now three mornings since they had left their father's house. They began to walk again, but they always came deeper into the forest, and if help did not come soon, they must die of hunger and weariness. When it was mid-day, they saw a beautiful snow-white bird sitting on a bough, which sang so delightfully that they stood still and listened to it. And when its song was over, it spread its wings and flew away before them, and they followed it until they reached a little house, on the roof of which it alighted; and when they approached the little house they saw that it was built of bread and covered with cakes, but that the windows were of clear sugar. 
 'We will set to work on that,' said Hansel, 'and have a good meal. I will eat a bit of the roof, and you Gretel, can eat some of the window, it will taste sweet.' 
 Hansel reached up above, and broke off a little of the roof to try how it tasted, and Gretel leant against the window and nibbled at the panes. Then a soft voice cried from the parlour:

 'Nibble, nibble, gnaw,
  Who is nibbling at my little house?'
The children answered:
 'The wind, the wind,
  The heaven-born wind,'

and went on eating without disturbing themselves. Hansel, who liked the taste of the roof, tore down a great piece of it, and Gretel pushed out the whole of one round window-pane, sat down, and enjoyed herself with it. Suddenly the door opened, and a woman as old as the hills, who supported herself on crutches, came creeping out. Hansel and Gretel were so terribly frightened that they let fall what they had in their hands. The old woman, however, nodded her head, and said: 'Oh, you dear children, who has brought you here? do come in, and stay with me. No harm shall happen to you.' 
 She took them both by the hand, and led them into her little house. Then good food was set before them, milk and pancakes, with sugar, apples, and nuts. Afterwards two pretty little beds were covered with clean white linen, and Hansel and Gretel lay down in them, and thought they were in heaven.
 The old woman had only pretended to be so kind; she was in reality a wicked witch, who lay in wait for children, and had only built the little house of bread in order to entice them there. When a child fell into her power, she killed it, cooked and ate it, and that was a feast day with her. Witches have red eyes, and cannot see far, but they have a keen scent like the beasts, and are aware when human beings draw near. When Hansel and Gretel came into her neighbourhood, she laughed with malice, and said mockingly: 'I have them, they shall not escape me again!' 
 Early in the morning before the children were awake, she was already up, and when she saw both of them sleeping and looking so pretty, with their plump and rosy cheeks she muttered to herself: 'That will be a dainty mouthful!' 
 Then she seized Hansel with her shrivelled hand, carried him into a little stable, and locked him in behind a grated door. Scream as he might, it would not help him. Then she went to Gretel, shook her till she awoke, and cried: 'Get up, lazy thing, fetch some water, and cook something good for your brother, he is in the stable outside, and is to be made fat. When he is fat, I will eat him.' 
 Gretel began to weep bitterly, but it was all in vain, for she was forced to do what the wicked witch commanded.

And now the best food was cooked for poor Hansel, but Gretel got nothing but crab-shells. Every morning the woman crept to the little stable, and cried: 'Hansel, stretch out your finger that I may feel if you will soon be fat.' 
 Hansel, however, stretched out a little bone to her, and the old woman, who had dim eyes, could not see it, and thought it was Hansel's finger, and was astonished that there was no way of fattening him. When four weeks had gone by, and Hansel still remained thin, she was seized with impatience and would not wait any longer. 
 'Now, then, Gretel,' she cried to the girl, 'stir yourself, and bring some water. Let Hansel be fat or lean, tomorrow I will kill him, and cook him.' 
 Ah, how the poor little sister did lament when she had to fetch the water, and how her tears did flow down her cheeks! 
 'Dear God, do help us,' she cried. 'If the wild beasts in the forest had but devoured us, we should at any rate have died together.' 
 'Just keep your noise to yourself,' said the old woman, 'it won't help you at all.'

Early in the morning, Gretel had to go out and hang up the cauldron with the water, and light the fire. 
 'We will bake first,' said the old woman, 'I have already heated the oven, and kneaded the dough.' 
 She pushed poor Gretel out to the oven, from which flames of fire were already darting. 
 'Creep in,' said the witch, 'and see if it is properly heated, so that we can put the bread in.' 
 And once Gretel was inside, she intended to shut the oven and let her bake in it, and then she would eat her, too. But Gretel saw what she had in mind, and said: 'I do not know how I am to do it; how do I get in?' 
 'Silly goose,' said the old woman. 'The door is big enough; just look, I can get in myself!' and she crept up and thrust her head into the oven. 
 Then Gretel gave her a push that drove her far into it, and shut the iron door, and fastened the bolt. Oh! then she began to howl quite horribly, but Gretel ran away and the godless witch was miserably burnt to death.

Gretel, however, ran like lightning to Hansel, opened his little stable, and cried: 'Hansel, we are saved! The old witch is dead!' 
 Then Hansel sprang like a bird from its cage when the door is opened. How they did rejoice and embrace each other, and dance about and kiss each other! And as they had no longer any need to fear her, they went into the witch's house, and in every corner there stood chests full of pearls and jewels. 
 'These are far better than pebbles!' said Hansel, and thrust into his pockets whatever could be got in, and Gretel said: 'I, too, will take something home with me,' and filled her pinafore full. 
 'But now we must be off,' said Hansel, 'that we may get out of the witch's forest.'

When they had walked for two hours, they came to a great stretch of water. 
 'We cannot cross,' said Hansel, 'I see no foot-plank, and no bridge.' 
 'And there is also no ferry,' answered Gretel, 'but a white duck is swimming there: if I ask her, she will help us over.' 
Then she cried:

 'Little duck, little duck, dost thou see,
  Hansel and Gretel are waiting for thee?
  There's never a plank, or bridge in sight,
  Take us across on thy back so white.'

The duck came to them, and Hansel seated himself on its back, and told his sister to sit by him. 
 'No,' replied Gretel, 'that will be too heavy for the little duck; she shall take us across, one after the other.' 
 The good little duck did so, and when they were once safely across and had walked for a short time, the forest seemed to be more and more familiar to them, and at length they saw from afar their father's house. Then they began to run, rushed into the parlour, and threw themselves round their father's neck. The man had not known one happy hour since he had left the children in the forest; the woman, however, was dead. Gretel emptied her pinafore until pearls and precious stones ran about the room, and Hansel threw one handful after another out of his pocket to add to them. Then all anxiety was at an end, and they lived together in perfect happiness. 

My tale is done, there runs a mouse; whosoever catches it, may make himself a big fur cap out of it.

name: a ticket for Midgard Zoo
longdesc: A fun-looking ticket has been left here.  It has a picture of a cuddly bunny on it.

extra_descriptions.description:
This simple ticket has a picture of a cuddly bunny on it and the legend:

                    (\_/)
                   =(^.^)=
                   (")_(")
                 MIDGARD ZOO!
       SEE IT - SENSE IT - STEP IN IT

This will surely be a wonderful experience.  Maybe they have a mini-Balgor
slide for you to play on??!

name: a ticket for The Deadly Creatures Exhibit
longdesc: A terrifying ticket with an evil-looking bat on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This simple ticket has a picture of a bat on it and the legend:

             /\                 /\
            / \'._   (\_/)   _.'/ \
           /_.''._'--('.')--'_.''._\
           | \_ / `;=/ " \=;` \ _/ |
            \/ `\__|`\___/`|__/`  \/
                    \(/|\)/       `
                     " ` "
             MIDGARD ZOO PRESENTS:
        THE DEADLY CREATURES EXHIBIT!

Now this has to be exciting!!  Maybe they have Balgor down there for you to
play tiddlywinks with??!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a band of chitinous material most likely from a fire ant.  It is
just the right size to fit around your wrist.  That was lucky, wasn't it?

name: the Ant-Queen's Head
longdesc: The gruesomely severed head of the fire ant queen has been stuck on a shelf here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the severed head of the fire ant queen.  It still has some goo
where it was removed from the unfortunate insects body by some bold
adventurer... It was you, wasn't it?  Murderer!

name: a Fire Ant Mandible
longdesc: A mandible once-belonging to a fire ant has been here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a long, curving mandible made of red chitin.  It once belonged to
a fire ant.  It is very lightweight and quick, the perfect tool for that
budding rogue who wants to stand out in the crowd.

name: a Fire Ant Stinger
longdesc: The stinger of a fire ant has been left here by mistake.

extra_descriptions.description:
This stinger has been removed from the corpse of a fire ant.  It is still reasonably full of sloshing, evil-smelling, viscous black acid.  It looks
like it can be used just like a wand to spray your enemies for fun and
giggles.

name: a Warg Fur scarf
longdesc: A lovely looking furry scarf has been neatly folded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This scarf has been made from the furs of multiple wargs.  It is long,
soft, luxurious, and smells a little like an open sewer.  Just the thing
to keep you warm on cold days.

name: a pair of Warg Paws
longdesc: A pair of warg paws with sharp claws have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These are the paws from some poor, unfortunate warg who was likely just
going about its business when someone came along and chopped off its
paws.  They fit over your hands perfectly and have razor sharp claws
extending from the tips.  Ooh!

name: the Star of Volstova
longdesc: A fancy looking star has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This fancy looking jewel consists of a star-ruby surrounded by twenty-
five tiny princess-cut diamonds set in to a silver five-pointed star. 
Each point of the star contains five of the diamonds that range in colour
from pinky-red next to the ruby to dazzling white at the very tip.  It
looks expensive!

name: a Shashka
longdesc: A Shashka has been left here, waiting for you to take.

extra_descriptions.description:
A Shashka is a type of sabre, with a single sharp edge and no guard
protecting the hand.  The blade gently curves backwards, and when swung
with force produces a distinctive 'shaaashk' sound that gives the blade
its name.

name: scale sleeves
longdesc: some sleeves made from scales have been discarded here

extra_descriptions.description:
These sleeves have been made from the leathery scales of a cavern
crawler!  Wow!  They are hard and brittle and a little hairy.  A
dark browny-black in colour, they look like they'd protect you
well.  So long as you have arms like Popeye, these will fit you
nicely.

name: necklace with many beads
longdesc: A tacky looking necklace has been left here

name: strange coloured cloak
longdesc: you barely notice a cloak on the ground here

name: a Ring of Putrid Flesh
longdesc: A disgusting ring made of rotting flesh is here. What the heck?

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring has been made from rotting, slimy flesh.  It stinks!  It is a
green-purple, puss-filled, oozy-monstrosity that you'd be crazy to wear.

name: an Ogre Slayer band
longdesc: A ring won by slaying an ogre is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band of gold looks like it is a prize from a competition.  Several
spiky bits of crude engraving seem to indicate that the possessor of this
ring is a heroic ogre slayer... That sounds made up!

name: Balgor's Bonce
longdesc: The legendary helm Balgor's Bonce has been left here ready for you to steal.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is Balgor's Bonce.  It's a legendary, nay Mythic, piece of armour.
It is shaped exactly like Balgor's head, including one spiky ear and 
one ear that could win the cauliflower of the year award.  It even comes
with a nasal plate that extends down a little to cover Balgor's tiny,
pug-like nose.  If you're wearing this, it's probably like wearing a
saucepan on your head, for you are not Balgor, and it doesn't fit you
very well.  Oh, and someone has painted a skull on it for that tough-
orc look!

name: Balgor's Spiky Pauldron
longdesc: A single spiky pauldron is here ready to be worn by the one-shouldered minority.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a single pauldron designed to fit over one shoulder with
the expectation that the wearer protects their other shoulder using
their shield.  This design allows the pauldron to be especially
heavy and padded to prevent extra damage.  This particular model
has been painted red and then covered in spikes, giving the
impression of an angry red hedgehog perched on your shoulder.

name: barbed leather skirt
longdesc: A leather skirt covered in wicked-looking barbs has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This leather skirt extends from the waist down to mid-thigh.  The
leather has been pleated to allow it to flare around the wearers
hips during any strenuous activity.  Between each pleat is a set 
of cunning hooked-barbs that appear to stream out during a fight,
latch on to an enemy and drain their life!  How utterly evil and
delicious!

name: a Barbed Blade
longdesc: A cruel-looking barbed blade has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This looks like any ordinary dagger.  It has a curved blade that
ends in a very sharp point.  The difference between this and a
normal dagger is that this one also has a cruel-looking barb
extending backwards from the tip, meaning that when it's plunged
in to a foe, it causes even more damage on the way out!  Yuck!
The blade itself is candle-blackened steel with a dark crosspiece
and black leather hilt.  Set in to the pommel, giving the blade
balance and extra weight for thrusting, is a black diamond
engraved with a horrible-looking rune that can only be of Drow
origin.

name: Balgor's animalistic fury
longdesc: A charm full of Balgor's animalistic fury is here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}You feel the spirit of Balgor put his feet up and fetch a cold brew. AHHH.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: Balgor, hero of Moria, once again proves that he is, if nothing else, an endless source of awesome gear for the budding adventurer.

name: Pippi's Ginger Curls
longdesc: A lock of ginger curls has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}You feel the rage of the ginger Halfling leave you.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a lock of gorgeous ginger hair that has been tied off with a leather 
lace.  It feels soft to the touch and gives off a hint of strawberries.

name: Pippi's Leather Brawlers
longdesc: A pair of tough looking leather boots with 'PIPPI' stitched in to the label have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pair of leather boots appears to be a modified pair of standard leather boots
with reinforced plates over the toe, heel and shin.   A series of iron studs has
been added to the thick leather sole giving the wearer purchase in slippery mud
and an impromptu weapon to severely inconvenience any likely-looking lad.

name: a cow pie
longdesc: A delicious-looking cow pie steams in the cool air here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pie has been baked by the skilled hands of a Halfling master chef.  Sitting
in a deep dish, this pie is thick with beef and gravy and onions and carrots and
turnip and swede and cabbage.  Yum!

Ancient bands of an unknown metal weave like plaits through this suit

and no one else.

that looks like it is capable of ripping heads off and the shaft has
been hewn from a single length of dragon bone.  In the right hands
this would be a devastating weapon.

Someone has slaved long and hard over this potion.  They probably
used all kinds of magic words too.  Whatever it is, it looks like
a potion you really want to quaff right now.

And for the priestesses themselves, to possess such a weapon is a sign on her power and prestige.  'Ware the bite of these whips, for they are more dangerous the more heads there are.

name: a pair of adamantium bracers
longdesc: A pair of lavish black bracers have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: These adamantium bracers have been formed of strips of wafer-thin adamantium. The inside has been lined with the softest leather.  Even with all those spikes and points, the bracers feel light as a feather.

name: a pair adamantium gauntlets
longdesc: A fine pair of lavish, black gauntlets have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: These adamantium gauntlets have been formed of lobstered plates of wafer-thin adamantium.  The have been lined with the softest, warmest leather and they make you feel like you uproot a tree with your bare hands.

name: a silvery blue wand
longdesc: A silvery blue wand has been dropped in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: This wand has been formed from a single length of thin adamantium.  The surface glows with a silvery-blue sheen.

name: an adamantium helmet
longdesc: A black, lavish helmet lies up against a rock, just begging to be worn.

extra_descriptions.description: This adamantium helmet has been formed from a single wafer-thin sheaf of adamantium.  The inside has been lined with the softest leather and it fits over the skull perfectly, offering better protection that the strongest steel.  You feel your IQ increase just wearing it.

name: an adamantium ring inset with rubies
longdesc: A small ring of adamantium inset with rubies lies in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: This ring is a small, thin band of adamantium inset with rubies.  As it slips on to your finger you feel like you're a little less afraid of fire.

name: A spider shaped dagger
longdesc: A sharp dagger, with a handle carved in the shape of a spider has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This adamantium dagger has been forged from highly magical 
adamantium. The handle has been forged in to the likeness of a 
spider with the the 8 legs all spread out and pointing forward 
to form a crosspiece to look as if the creature is swallowing 
the long thin blade.

name: an adamantium breastplate
longdesc: A black, lavish breastplate has been left here, all forlorn.

extra_descriptions.description: Formed from flexible interlocking wafer-thin plates of adamantium this breastplate covers the breast from sternum to shoulders and down the back, with the metal ending in dangerous points that never seem to pierce or prick the body of the wearer, almost as if it increases flexibility.

name: an adamantium scale skirt
longdesc: A black, lavish skirt has been left here, waiting for use.

extra_descriptions.description: This skirt has been formed from interlocking scales of wafer-thin adamantium that have been secured over soft, flexible leather.  The plates are so light that they hardly feel like they are there at all!  Yet the skirt gives you a feeling of increased speed.

name: an adamantium chain halter top
longdesc: A black, lavish halter top has been left here, begging to be worn.

extra_descriptions.description: This halter top has been formed of fine, wafer-thin rings of adamantium.  Priestesses wear these to enhance the assets they have under their robes when they desire to take a male for whatever reason.  It feels highly magical and would give you increased flexibility.

name: a pair of adamantium high-heeled boots
longdesc: A pair of black, lavish boots has been left here, ready to walk with you.

extra_descriptions.description: These feminine boots have been formed of a soft, supple leather reinforced with well placed wafer-thin plates of adamantium.  The six-inch heels are formed from a single long spike of adamantium, making them the bane of all toes everywhere.

name: a spider-embossed adamantium shield
longdesc: A black, lavish shield has been left here, ready to defend you.

extra_descriptions.description: This shield is shaped like an eight-pointed star and has been formed from a single, wafer-thin sheet of adamantium.  A spider motif has been embossed over the boss in the centre with the legs extending out to the points of the star.

name: an adamantium belt of spiders
longdesc: A black, lavish belt is curled up here.

extra_descriptions.description: This belt has formed from thirteen adamantium spiders, linked together by their front two and back two legs.  The other four legs stretch out towards their respective cousins, making it look like a matching chain of arachnids that parade around the waist.

name: a sigil of House Udrinor
longdesc: A small sigil has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This sigil is a thin disc of adamantium on a leather thong.  It is engraved with the symbol of House Udrinor.

name: a sigil of House Sardavac
longdesc: A small sigil has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This sigil is a thin disc of adamantium on a leather thong.  It is engraved with the symbol of House Sardavac.

name: a sigil of House Parastric
longdesc: A small sigil has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This sigil is a thin disc of adamantium on a leather thong.  It is engraved with the symbol of House Parastric.

name: a sigil of House Moivas
longdesc: A small sigil has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This sigil is a thin disc of adamantium on a leather thong.  It is engraved with the symbol of House Moivas.

name: a Drow piwafwi cloak
longdesc: A Drow piwafwi cloak has been left crumpled in a help here.

extra_descriptions.description: The cloak can be made in every possible shape with just about every type of fabric. The most common forms are a circular piece of fabric with a hole in the center for the head, and fabric draped from neck, connected by a chain, brooch, cord, or pins. Talented drow weavers have woven strands of adamantine into this cloak, thus rendering it useless if exposed to the light -- the effect of which will turn the cloak to dust.

name: a Drow hand-crossbow
longdesc: An adamantium crossbow, so small it could fit in the palm of your hand, has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This crossbow has been forged from delicate wafer-thin plates of adamantium that all link and click together to form a tiny crossbow. The darts of the crossbow have been dipped in a sleeping poison. Care should be taken when handling the device!

name: an elaborately embroidered Drow wizard's robe
longdesc: A robe covered in fine embroidery has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This robe has been embroidered to to tell the story of the Drow and their elven cousins and the split long ago.  Battles have been artfully rendered in fine silk stitching using surprisingly bold and vibrant colours.  The bottom of the robe is a rich, velvety black colour with a mural of the Spider-Queen herself, herding her people.  The blackness blends through blues and greys in to a summery sky at the shoulders.

name: a cruel adamantium mace
longdesc: A cruel-looking mace has been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description: This mace has been forged from overlapping sheets of adamantium.  The flanges are razor sharp and yet carry the weight of a heavy hammer.  Drow priestesses wield these maces when they are not yet powerful enough to wield a whip of snake heads.  Don't let that fact fool you though, these maces are powerful constructions!

name: a black spider-silk robe with red lining
longdesc: A black spider-silk robe with a red lining has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This robe has been finely woven from jet-black spider silk.  When standing completely still it almost seems to cause the wearer to disappear from sight!  This robe would be perfect for a murderous assassin.

name: a pair of Drow trackless boots
longdesc: A pair of soft leather boots are here.

extra_descriptions.description: These magical boots have been created by the Drow.  They provide those lucky enough to wear them with the ability to levitate!

name: a muddy brown wand
longdesc: A muddy brown wand has been dropped in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: This wand has been formed from a single length of thin adamantium.  The surface glows with a muddy-brown sheen.

extra_descriptions.description: This wand has been formed from a single length of thin adamantium.  The surface glows with an icy-white sheen.

name: #{magenta}a gooey bug brain#{o}
longdesc: #{magenta}A disgustingly gooey purple bug brain has been dropped here. Yuck.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is the brain of a bug.  It is very gooey.

name: a spider web pouch
longdesc: A black pouch covered in fine silky webbing has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A small, blackened pouch woven from fine, glistening spider silk. It
shimmers faintly in the dark, its surface sticky to the touch, as if
still alive with the whispers of the web-spinner that crafted it.

name: an obsidian spider eye
longdesc: A smooth spidery-obsidian gem has been dropped here.  Quick!  Steal it!

extra_descriptions.description:
A smooth, obsidian gem shaped like a spider's eye, gleaming with a
faint, malevolent light. Shadows seem to cling to it, and gazing
into its depths stirs a sense of being watched.

name: a filigree web
longdesc: A small filigree-silver web has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{white}You feel like you just walked face first in to a spiders web for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
A small trinket shaped like a spider's web, crafted from tarnished
silver and dark silk. Its design is intricate and cold, with an
unsettling beauty that hints at forgotten rituals.

name: The Oathstone of Vek'Zor
longdesc: A brilliant purple sigil lies on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Gifted to the Weaponlord Ryltar Vek'Zor as a means of solidifying his
loyalty to the Spider Queens' causes, the oathstone is a flat, oval-
shaped obsidian disc, no larger than the palm of your hand, perfectly
smooth but unnervingly cold to the touch.  At its center is an inlaid
spider sigil, sculpted from bright, molten dire mithril and coated with
venotoxin, a poisonous, Drow-made resin that never dries or spills.  It
would be a very, very bad idea to lick it.

name: Darkfire
longdesc: Darkfire is here, burning with the flames of the darkest pit.
action: slash
item_ability_msg: #{black bold}Darkfire drips black, molten flames for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This ancient Drow longsword is Darkfire.  Forged in the pits below the
Temple of the Spider Queen from black adamantium, she is laced with thin,
ember-red runes that glow faintly like dying coals when drawn.  Her blade
curves like a serpent fang, serrated near the tip for rending flesh and
her hilt is wrapped in ashen drider-hide.  The crossguard flares like a
pair of spider mandibles, where hundreds of tiny rubies blink and burn
like demonic spider-eyes, watching your every move.  She is the pride of
the Rakdagor Weaponlord Ryltar Vek'Zor.

name: a chitinous spinner
longdesc: A chitinous spinner has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The chitinous spinner is a a small, blackened chitin cage in the shape
of a spiders abdomen mounted atop a carved obsidian rod.  Inside the
cage crawls a living spiderling, a spinner common to the filigree 
platforms of Rakdagor.  It has been magically altered and emits a soft,
pulsing crimson glow from the runes etched into its carapace.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a heavy axe of the kind lumberjacks use to chop down trees.

name: a checkered shirt
longdesc: A checkered shirt lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is an extra large, checkered shirt made from heavy cloth.

name: a pair of leather boots
longdesc: A pair of leather boots lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
They are fashioned from rough leather that has been oiled frequently to make
  it stay waterproof.  They look worn but quite functional.

name: a fireplace
longdesc: A fireplace made from stone is set against the east wall.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is fashioned from stones of various sizes that have been stacked on top of
each other and fastened with mortar.  Its chimney is constructed likewise and
  leads the smoke out through the low cabin ceiling.

name: a hooded brass lantern
longdesc: A hooded brass lantern has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: They say, " This message is too dark to see

It is a large and robust but somewhat battered oil lantern made from brass,
and it is equipped with a handle to make it handy and a hood to protect its
  flame.  Some letters have been scratched on its bottom.

name: a wooden chest
longdesc: A wooden chest stands in the corner.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a robust chest made from short, heavy planks that have been fastened
  together with tendons.  It is equipped with a simple brass lock.

name: a small brass key
longdesc: A small brass key lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a small, simple brass key with no inscriptions or marks of any kind.

name: a heap of gold coins
longdesc: some gold coins lie piled up in a heap on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: The coins seem to be gold.

name: some blackberries
longdesc: some blackberries grow on a bush nearby.

extra_descriptions.description: They look very tasty indeed.

name: a mushroom
longdesc: A small mushroom grows nearby.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a tasty little thing.

name: a large sign
longdesc: A large sign mounted on a pole is standing by the roadside.

extra_descriptions.description:
It says :-

                         Haon-Dor
                         --------

 This is the Forest of Haon-Dor.  Enter at your own risk.
     Please report any strange occurrences to Quifael.

Not the most interesting pole in the world.
  Better leave it here, though, as it holds the sign in place.

longdesc: A water barrel has been left here.

name: a colossal tree
longdesc: A colossal tree blocks the way westwards.

extra_descriptions.description:
The opening is far too narrow for you to squeeze through but it looks as if the
  tree is hollow.

This enormous tree must be a thousand years old.  Its rough bark looks gray
and pale and is decorated with scratches and claw marks.  On its west side is a
  small opening just above ground level.

name: a long, gray branch
longdesc: A long, gray branch rests heavily on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is quite heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
  long dead and very dry.  Could probably be lighted quite easily.

name: a long, gray branch
longdesc: A long, gray branch rests heavily on the ground.
action: pound

extra_descriptions.description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
long and straight and the wood is very hard, still being full of sap.  Although
it does not fit very well in your hand, it could be used as a clumsy but very
  heavy weapon.

name: a long, gray branch
longdesc: A long, gray branch rests heavily on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is very heavy and looks as if it has been dropped from great height.  It is
  somewhat twisted and the hard wood is still full of sap.

name: a toadstool
longdesc: A large toadstool grows nearby.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  the top
surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime that emits a weak,
  musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

name: a toadstool

It is a large, brown boletus that must weigh nearly five pounds.  It has small
white spots and the top surface is covered in a thin layer of transparent slime
  that emits a weak, musty smell.  Not the most delicious thing you have seen.

name: a yellow potion

name: a large round shield

extra_descriptions.description: It is made from hard wood that has been reinforced with heavy iron bands.

name: an iron sceptre

extra_descriptions.description: It is a heavy sceptre made from solid iron.

name: an iron ring

It is a quite heavy human-sized ring made from solid iron.  It lacks
  decorations of any kind.

name: Quickling bracers
longdesc: Someone, in their haste, has forget to pick up the bracers lying here.

extra_descriptions.description: The pair of Quickling bracers magically expand to fit your arms!

name: a Quickling knife
longdesc: A Quickling knife has fallen to the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A small Quickling knife, it's small size makes it look like a child's toy.
  However, that is a misleading, as the edge is very sharp.

name: a Quickling sabre
longdesc: A Quickling sabre has fallen to the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Quickling sabre looks like the preferred weapon of the famous Quickling
  Raiders.

name: a short sword of speed
longdesc: A short sword of speed lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: The short sword of speed looks like it would move more quickly in combat.

name: a magical eyeglass
longdesc: A magical eyeglass is lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The magical eyeglass looks very interesting, you can't wait to look around
  with it!

name: a blue dragon scale shirt
longdesc: A pile of blue dragon scales has been heaped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This shirt is made from the tough, cobalt scales of a blue dragon.

name: a green dragon scale shirt
longdesc: A pile of green dragon scales has been heaped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This shirt is made from the tough, emerald scales of a green dragon.

name: a bag of green dragon scales
longdesc: A large green bag of dragon scales has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
When I say 'a bag of green dragon scales' I don't mean, 'Hey kids, here's a bag
full of green dragon scales.' I mean, 'Hey kids, here's a bag MADE from green
dragon scales.'  It's fun to be precise...

name: the blue dragon horn
longdesc: The very tip of a blue dragon horn has been left here for no reason.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the broken tip off one of the horns of a mighty, fierce blue dragon.
It must have taken a hero of mighty proportions to snap it off and get away
with it.  So that rules out Arturian...  Maybe it was Viller?  Or Bob?  Or
Celesta?

name: a wand of green dragon scales
longdesc: A long, thin wand of green dragon scales smokes oddly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wand is long and thin.  It curves like the wind on the waves and ends in
a rather spectacularly carved dragon head from which pours a violent and icky
green smoke.  It's probably best not to breathe that in.

name: a wand of blue dragon scales
longdesc: A stubby, fat wand of blue dragon scales smokes oddly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wand is stubby and fat, like a dragon coiled up on it's nest and enjoying
a nap after devouring all the peasants and most of the sheep of a nearby farm.
It ends in a rather fierce looking dragon head replete with three-pronged horns
and shining cobalt eyes.  Electricity sparkles and crackles across the tips of
those very horns.  It's probably a good idea not to lick them... So you lick
them anyway?  Shame on you.  I bet that tasted like tin!

extra_descriptions.description: The pool looks VERY cold and you can see pieces of ice floating in it.

longdesc: The large harpoon has been left here.

name: a silver chest

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a robust chest made from silver planks that have been fastened
  together with tendons.  It is equipped with a simple silver lock.

name: white fox stole
longdesc: A long flowing white fox stole.

extra_descriptions.description: You see a long white flowing stole made of Arctic Fox.

name: a diamond studded cornet
longdesc: A very ornate gold and diamond cornet.

extra_descriptions.description: A beautiful gift.

name: Icy Gown
longdesc: A long blue Icy Gown.

name: a pair of ray-ban's sunglasses
longdesc: A COOL pair of Ray-Ban's sunglasses.

name: a big pile of gold coins
longdesc: A big pile of gold coins is lying here.

name: a pair of Oakley Blades
longdesc: A kick'in pair of Oakley sunglasses

name: Quifael's global optimizer
longdesc: Quifael's global optimizer has been left here.
action: hack, of course...

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a very unpredictable piece of software, consisting mostly of
  self-modifying code and inexcusable goto commands.  Looks very dangerous.

name: a black dragon scale shirt
longdesc: A black dragon scale shirt has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a sleeveless shirt made from big, black dragon scales joined with silver
threads.  Its inside has been made from the soft skin on the dragon's belly,
making it very comfortable to wear.  the name "Isha" has been engraved on one
  of the scales.

name: a black dragon scale skirt
longdesc: A black dragon scale skirt has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a short skirt made from big, black dragon scales joined with silver
threads.  Its inside has been made from the soft skin on the dragon's belly,
making it very comfortable to wear.  the name "Isha" has been engraved on one
  of the scales.

name: a black, hooded cloak
longdesc: A large, hooded cloak, as dark as the night, has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a heavy, black cloak with a large hood.  the name "Isha" is written
  inside it with a silver thread.

name: a broad silver belt
longdesc: A broad silver belt has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a broad belt made from tiny silver rings woven together.

name: a long, slender sword
longdesc: A long, slender sword lies on the ground.
action: slash

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a long, slender sword that seems to be made from silver.  the name
  "Isha" has been engraved on the hilt.

name: a coffee machine
longdesc: A coffee machine is standing here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a big old-fashioned thing with a sign that reads:

        Drink coffee! get wired! stay up all night and MUD!

name: a coffee cup
longdesc: A coffee cup has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a small white throwaway cup that has 'Keep MudLand tidy' written on its
  side and 'Quifatronic C-1000 mk I' on its bottom.

name: the Scythe of Death
longdesc: The Scythe of Death rests heavily on the ground.
action: reaps

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a very heavy scythe.  the gray handle is made from hard wood and the long
iron blade is completely smooth from countless years of use.  It feels cold to
  the touch.

name: a waybread
longdesc: some waybread has been put here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The waybread is the traditional feed of elves when traveling, they call it
  lembas.  It is said to refresh the weary traveler greatly.

name: a glinting ring of silver
longdesc: A lovely silver ring has been left here.

name: a golden ring
longdesc: A shiny gold ring has been abandoned here.

name: the devil rod
longdesc: The mysterious devil rod lies on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is indeed a mysterious rod.  It is dark black at the base but has four
  very sharp purple tentacles at the end.

name: the large mace
longdesc: A large mace lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The mace is pretty large with a weight of 10 lbs.  the head is actually four
  purple tentacles tied together.

name: the small mace
longdesc: A small mace has been left here.
action: crush

extra_descriptions.description:
This weapon does look like it does a lot of damage, but then you never know.
  It consists of a black handle and a purple head.

name: a purple cloak
longdesc: A purple cloak lies on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a very fine made cloak from an unknown material, in a nice purple
  color.

name: an neon blue potion
longdesc: A neon blue potion stands on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: In the flask is a transparent electric blue liquid.

name: a black key
longdesc: A black key has been left on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: This little key is made from a black metal of unknown origin.

name: a strange white skull
longdesc: A strange white skull lies on the floor looking at you.

extra_descriptions.description: You read the number '666'.

The skull has two small horns in the forehead. You notice some writing on
  the inside.

name: a pair of muddy gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of muddy gauntlets have been thrown away here.

extra_descriptions.description: These plate gauntlets are muddy indeed, however they look very effective.

name: a small stick
longdesc: A small stick lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It reads 'Feed me'.

The small stick does not look interesting at all.  But just as you are going
  to throw it away you notice some small letters.

name: a pair of muddy boots
longdesc: A pair of muddy boots has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.keywords:
These plate boots are muddy and they look well worn, but they also look very
  comfortable.

extra_descriptions.description: This looks like a whole lot of coins.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a very nice little weapon.

name: a huge bastard sword

action: slash

extra_descriptions.description: Quite a heavy weapon, with a pure white hilt.

name: a large helmet
longdesc: There is a large helmet on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: This looks like some heavy protection, for the head of course.

name: a chaos helmet
longdesc: On the floor is a grand evil-looking chaos helmet.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helmet has mounted some mean looking spikes on the front, moreover it
  looks like good protection.

name: a light sabre
longdesc: On the floor lies a strange looking sabre.

extra_descriptions.description: This looks like a sabre out of an well-known SF-movie.

name: a two-handed sword
longdesc: On the floor rests a enormous two-handed sword.

extra_descriptions.description: On the blade you can read 'Flame And Strength United Are My Soul Power'.

You notice that there has been inscribed some runes and a sort of pattern,
  which resembles flames running along the edge.

name: a silvery breast plate
longdesc: There is a silvery breast plate on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
On the breast plate you notice a relief of large rose. the metal seems to be
  some kind of silver or platinum.

name: some leg plates
longdesc: On the floor you see some leg plates.

extra_descriptions.description: They seem to be made from silver or platinum. You see the outline of a rose.

name: a pair of gloves
longdesc: You can see a pair of gloves on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: The gloves are made of silver threads.

name: a silvery helmet
longdesc: The silvery helmet lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The helmet is made from platinum or silver and has a white fur brush attached
  on the top.

name: the shield of the rose
longdesc: The shield of the rose rests on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
On the shield you see a clear painting of a dark red rose on a white
  background. You also notice the inscription :'Pax Est Sanctum'.

name: a pair of heavy plated boots
longdesc: A pair of heavy plated boots stand on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: The boots are made from a silvery metal.

name: some arm plates
longdesc: On the floor you see some arm plates.

extra_descriptions.description: They seem to be made from silver or platinum. You see the outline of a rose.

name: a crystal globe
longdesc: A crystal globe sits here, pulsating softly

name: a platinum wedding band
longdesc: A gleaming platinum wedding band is lying here.

name: a set of long branching antlers
longdesc: Herne's branching antlers sit here

name: a large waterbed
longdesc: A queen size, heated waterbed, with royal blue sheets, is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Looking at the waterbed, you can see that the very fine, royal blue, crushed
velvet sheets are quite messy.  It looks as if it has seen a lot of use
recently.  On closer examination, you can see silken cords of the same hue
connected to the corners.  They have large sweat stains, indicating heavy
  use.

name: a beautiful large statue of Maleria
longdesc: A very large, beautifully carved and sculpted statue of Maleria rests here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This exquisite statue of Maleria is so lifelike that you can almost see the
blush of her skin.  It is quite apparent that whoever had this made must
really love and care for Maleria.  the painstaking detail and perfect contours
require the touch that only a master sculptor and magician could provide.
This statue must have taken years, and perhaps was the life work of a master
sculptor.  There can be no other statue in the world that is so perfectly
  crafted.

name: a beautiful red rose
longdesc: A very beautiful large red rose is lovingly placed here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A beautiful rose, with blood red petals and a pine green stem.  This must be
the legendary Rose of Love, which grows in only one place in the world: the
  Valley of Lamneth.

name: a shapeless hat
longdesc: A shapeless hat, made of a felt-like substance, has been left here.

name: a rose petal
longdesc: A rose-petal, probably created when a God appeared, floats softly to the ground.

name: a small mushroom
longdesc: A small mushroom, created as a God left this room, falls to the ground with a loud THUMP!

extra_descriptions.description:
This mushroom does not look like the kind you eat for nourishment.  It might
  be the kind to get you stoned, though.....  You decide against experimentation.

longdesc: A beautiful glittering jeweled key is resting here.

  feel secure when you wear it.

name: a dwarven hammer

extra_descriptions.description: This hammer has several dwarven runes etched into it. It is a powerful weapon.

name: a thin breastplate-sized blue dragon scale
longdesc: A thin breastplate-sized blue dragon scale lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Small blue scales have been sewn to a leather backing making a very flexible,
  lightweight, and tough armor.

name: a rune covered black and gold key
longdesc: A small rune covered key made of some gold and black metal lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The runes on this key seem to twist and turn as you look at them. the black of
this metal seems to absorb the light around it, while the gold has a faint glow
  about it.

name: A harpy feather
longdesc: A thick, bushy and slightly filthy feather has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This feather is thick and bushy and very, very dirty.  So much so it
leaves a bad smell lingering on your fingers.  Yuck!

name: a chunk of earth elemental
longdesc: A useless chunk of rock is here.  Pointless!!  Ignore it!

name: a gaseous wisp of air elemental
longdesc: A strangely blue-tinted wisp floats here...  Weird!

name: a pair of harpy wings
longdesc: A pair of bronze dragon wings seems to float by themselves in the air.

name: a filthy harpy feather
longdesc: A disgusting looking feather has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{green bold}The harpy feather glows beautifully, then returns to it's usual disgusting state.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is a dirty poop-brown feather from a harpy. It's gross. Throw it away!

name: a yellow key
longdesc: A large yellow key lies here

extra_descriptions.description: The large yellow key has a marking of M.Z on the side

name: a half-eaten body
longdesc: A half-eaten body is here, looking very messy.

extra_descriptions.description:
There is a name tag on the corpse, it reads 'Al'
  There may also be something inside the body.

name: a small dart
longdesc: A small fuzzy dart is lying here, with a glint of green at the tip.

extra_descriptions.description: A tiny inscription on the dart reads : use like a wand.

name: a small stream
longdesc: A small stream trickles nearby, wandering off into the distance.

extra_descriptions.description:
The stream is slow flowing, gurgling over the rocks.  The surrounding
terrain feels peaceful as you listen to the sound of the water.  The 
water looks very clear and clean and it seems like you saw the movement
of some fish in it.

name: sea wharf
longdesc: The sounds of the waves crashing against the wharf fills the air.

extra_descriptions.description:
You are standing on the wharf.  The waves are crashing below,
filling the air with noise.  The wharf vibrates a little with every
wave, a low rumbling type vibration that works it's way through your
feet.

name: a simple fishing rod
longdesc: A simple fishing rod with a string at the end lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This fishing rod is no work of art but it looks strong and supple.
There is a strong string at the end of the rod with a vicious looking
hook.

name: sea beach
longdesc: The sounds of the waves lapping against the beach surrounds you.

extra_descriptions.description:
The beach is composed of fine grains of sand, your footsteps are swallowed
up in the sand.  The water laps gently against the beach, the waves
cresting and breaking like like silvery phantoms, appearing and 
disappearing in the waves.
