longdesc: There are sticky spider webs all over the roof,  with drained corpses inside.

extra_descriptions.description:
The corpses look like those of troglodytes, tunnel rats, and adventurers like
  yourselves. You might be able to pull a couple of them out.

name: the drained troglodyte corpse
longdesc: There is a corpse of a troglodyte here.

extra_descriptions.description: It has been completely drain of blood, and still has it's equipment.

name: the corpse of an elven adventurer
longdesc: An elven adventurer's corpse, covered with bite marks, is here.
action:
It has been slightly drained of blood. Apparently the cave spiders didn't like
  the taste of elven blood very much. It is fully equipped.

extra_descriptions.description:
It has been slightly drained of blood. Apparently the cave spiders didn't like
  the taste of elven blood very much. It is fully equipped.

name: a black metal breast plate
longdesc: A black metal breast plate is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This breast plate is made of a hard black metal of unknown origins. It has an
insignia emblazoned on the front you do not recognize - it is a white unicorn
  rearing over an eclipsed sun.

name: a pair of black metal gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of black metal gauntlets is lying in a small heap here.

extra_descriptions.description:
There is have a small relief of a white unicorn over an eclipsed sun on the
  back of each glove. They are light and extremely strong.

name: a black metal helm
longdesc: A black metal helm has been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Across the crest of the helmet there is a relief of a white unicorn rearing
over an eclipsed sun. the helmet is made of an unknown metal, possibly some
  kind of adamantium compound, and is both light and extremely strong.

name: a pair of black metal leg plates
longdesc: A pair of black metal leg plates wait here for a new owner.

extra_descriptions.description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
  over a solar eclipse. the plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

name: a pair of black metal arm plates
longdesc: A pair of black metal arm plates is lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
  over a solar eclipse. the plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

name: a pair of black metal boots
longdesc: A pair of black metal boots lie on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The boots are made from a strange black metal. They have a white unicorn
  rearing over an eclipsed sun emblazoned on the side, and look very sturdy.

name: a strong mahogany bow
longdesc: A solid bow made of mahogany lies here.

name: the troglodytes cook's apron
longdesc: A filthy cook's apron is here
action: It is an apron. It has grease stains on it, and smells bad.

extra_descriptions.description: It is an apron. It has grease stains on it, and smells bad.

name: a huge black iron pot
longdesc: A pot big enough to feed an army is here.
action: It is hot, and covered with scratches. It must be two inches thick!

extra_descriptions.description: It is hot, and covered with scratches. It must be two inches thick!

name: some murky brown liquid
longdesc: some murky brown liquid

name: an antique golden shield
longdesc:
An antique golden shield rests here, bearing the insignia of the guild
  of paladins.

extra_descriptions.description:
It looks much like the modern paladin's shield - it is fashioned from solid
gold and bears the insignia of the paladins, but unlike the modern day shield
which anyone can use, it may only be used by those with a pure spirit - the
  way all paladins once were.

name: a long iron rod
longdesc: There is a long iron rod resting on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It looks like it could be used to force things, as it tapers at both ends,
  each of which is slightly curved.

name: a beaten up cave fisher skull
longdesc: The beaten up skull of a cave fisher hangs from a peg on the wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It looks pretty beat up, and has a hole over one eye. It is quite large and
  since it is made of solid bone, is therefore somewhat heavy.

name: a small crystal sphere
longdesc: There is a small crystal sphere here, glowing brightly.

extra_descriptions.description: You can see yourself reflected in it. Your reflected image is crystal clear.

name: a large shiny chrome-plated hoop of metal
longdesc: A chrome-plated hoop of metal glints from a spot on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
It says "Given to C*znark the Wise, on Year 4, from your friend Azarath."
  Apparently it was given as a gift, over forty years ago.
It has a clasp made of steel, and some strange runes engraved on the inside.

name: a pile of broken bones
longdesc: A collection of broken bones from past meals lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Upon closer examination, the clenched fist of what remains of an elven
  adventurer still has a ring on it, barely visible.

Wow, there are human bones, elven bones, dwarven bones, and bones from other
races you don't readily recognize. Some of them have scraps of equipment on
  them still, but nothing looks worth taking.

name: a clenched skeletal fist
longdesc: A clenched skeletal fist lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is clenched very tightly about the ring. the skeletal digits have been
  rigidly fixed by the passage of time.

name: a ring with a sapphire set in gold
longdesc: A dazzling sapphire shines from the golden ring in which it is set.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is finely crafted, and obviously very valuable. It looks like it is
  probably very old.

name: a silver chalice
longdesc: A fine chalice of silver sits here in the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: To Evistar, may you drink always in safety and good health. -HC
It is of fine craftsmanship. There is a small engraving in the base.

name: the Necklace of Wisdom
longdesc: The Necklace of Wisdom lies on the ground, radiating goodness.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is made of an unknown substance, and is smooth to the touch and glassy
in appearance, and yet at the same time is as hard as steel. It is translucent,
allowing you to peer into its depths, without comprehending the mysteries that
are hidden there. It writhes in your hand like a live thing, sending shivers
  down your spine.

name: a wooden crate
longdesc: A wooden crate is stacked against the wall.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a sturdy-looking wooden crate.

name: some yellow dust
longdesc: There is some yellow dust here; probably the remains of what was once food.

extra_descriptions.description:
It looks like it once was probably some kind of foodstuff, but it really
  doesn't look very appetising anymore.

name: a bottle of fine aged whiskey
longdesc: There is a bottle of fine aged whiskey just waiting to be imbibed here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Wow! You really lucked out this time. This is an expensive draught, but well
  worth the asking price. You smack your lips in anticipation.

name: some very dry, very old iron rations
longdesc: There are some desiccated iron rations sitting here.

extra_descriptions.description: They don't really look that appetizing. At least they don't stink.

name: the barrel
longdesc: A barrel has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A strong wooden barrel bound with iron hoops. It looks old, but seems to be
  sturdy nonetheless.

name: the barrel
longdesc: A barrel has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A strong wooden barrel bound with iron hoops. It looks old, but seems to be
  sturdy nonetheless.

name: a wooden crate
longdesc: A wooden crate is overturned on the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is a sturdy-looking wooden crate, now ripped open.

name: a bar of soap
longdesc: A small bar of soap sits here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It has a has a fresh scent. You look like you could use a bath, so go ahead
  and have a scrub!

name: the desk
longdesc: sturdy iron bars to the south, and also a strong oaken door to the west.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is rather small and austere. It looks like it was made for efficiency,
more than anything else. It has a single door, which has a big heavy lock
  on it. It is firmly bolted to the floor.

name: the gray metal key
longdesc: You notice a key made of a dull gray metal on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: It is unremarkable.

name: a filing cabinet
longdesc: desk, other than that, the room is bare and uninteresting. There is a set of

extra_descriptions.description:
It is made of steel, and looks pretty heavy. the lock on it looks quite
  serviceable, despite its apparent age. It is firmly bolted to the floor.

name: a large steel key
longdesc: A large steel key rests here.

name: drawer
longdesc: The drawer from a filing cabinet has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is made of steel, and is kind of heavy and bulky. It looks like it was
  taken out of a filing cabinet or something.

name: the troglodyte skeleton
longdesc: The troglodyte skeleton is lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The bones are brittle with age. There is some beat up looking armor clinging
  to it, no longer useful in its protective function.

name: a gray potion
longdesc: A potion with a dull gray color sits here.

name: the small wooden cart
longdesc: A small cart is here

extra_descriptions.description:
The cart has only one wheel remaining on it's single axle. Apparently it was
  horse drawn, but there are no signs of the steeds that pulled it.

name: a broken greatsword
longdesc: One half of a broken greatsword lies here on the floor.

name: a pile of broken bones
longdesc: A collection of broken bones from past meals lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pile of bones must be several inches deep. They look like fish, mostly,
but you recognize some troglodyte bones in there as well, and something else
  humanoid, maybe.

name: a dull gray helmet
longdesc: A dull gray helmet rests here, surveying the room.

extra_descriptions.description: A couple garnets, and a few amethysts.

It is a T-cross model, with a drooping gray plume. It looks very old, but
still quite serviceable. There are some semi-precious stones set in the crest,
  making it worth something as treasure, at the least.

name: the trophy case
longdesc: A trophy case stands here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It has a very hard clear material through which you can see the contents.
Efforts to break through it are unfruitful. You wonder where the troglodytes
could have discovered such an item. There is a small hole on the left edge of
  the case; ostensibly it is the locking mechanism.

name: a small bone
longdesc: A very small bone rests here, almost unnoticeably.

extra_descriptions.description: It looks like a finger bone of an unknown creature of some sort.

name: the ghost sword
longdesc: A ghostly glowing sword floats just above the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is cool to the touch, and very light. You feel odd holding it, though.
  Clearly it was not crafted for mortal hands to wield.

name: the greatsword
longdesc: There is a greatsword leaning against the wall here. It is as tall as you are.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the largest sword you've ever seen. It dwarfs all other two-handed
  swords. There are some silver runes on the black adamantium blade.

name: a wall-sized bookcase
longdesc: A bookcase covers the entire wall.

extra_descriptions.description: It covers the entire wall.

name: a metal locker
longdesc: A metal locker stands here, dented from repeated attempts to break in.

extra_descriptions.description: It looks pretty beat up, but remains intact and unopened.

name: a floor cabinet
longdesc: There is a cabinet resting against the wall, locked up tight.

name: a massive wooden bar
longdesc:
A huge wooden bar stands at the western end of the room. Behind it are dusty
  glasses and empty bottles that haven't been touched in centuries.

extra_descriptions.description: They are also made of wood, and firmly attached to the wall.
They are empty.

A massive piece of furniture. It's made out of wood, and takes up the entire
western edge of the room, where it comes three feet of the ground and stands
bolted to the floor a few feet from the west wall. There are a few shelves on
  a counter inset into the wall as well, with glasses and empty bottles on them.

name: a flat black key
longdesc: There is a black key lying on the ground here, nearly invisible.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a very strange contraption, it folds and bends along many hinges. It
  looks like it would fit a complicated lock.

name: a twisted key
longdesc: A key lies on the ground here, twisted and scorched almost beyond recognition.

extra_descriptions.description:
It positively pulses with evil. It looks like it was thrown in a blast
furnace, and is partially melted on one side. It is completely black, but
you can't tell if it's from the process that burned it, or whether it was
  originally that color.

name: a gigantic oven
longdesc: A oven of truly impressive size abuts the south wall.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is warm, as if it was used recently. It is crusty and rusty and made of
iron and very large and bulky. You venture it probably was up to the task of
  feeding the residents of this outpost.

name: the stove
longdesc: A gritty black stove takes up the center of the kitchen.

extra_descriptions.description: It looks like it was used recently, unlike anything else in this outpost.

name: the heavy steel key
longdesc: A steel key weighs heavily on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: This thing could practically be used as a cudgel!

name: a gray metal key
longdesc: There is a gray metal key lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: You see something REALLY special. Not.

name: a U-lock key
longdesc: There is a funny key sitting on its end here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The business end looks like a circle with dents in the edge. the cylinder
that this circle is on the end of tapers up into flat circle, so you can hold
it to turn. Just what you would turn with this key totally escapes you - it
  would clearly be a lock, but of a kind you have never seen.

name: a reinforced oaken door
longdesc: A reinforced oaken door lies on the ground here, torn from its hinges.

extra_descriptions.description:
It has a couple of strong leather straps on the back. If you could carry it,
  it would be an incredible shield.

name: a battered desk
longdesc: A battered desk is turned over on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: It looks like it has been attacked with an axe.

name: a weapons rack
longdesc: A rack is on the wall here, with hooks for weapons to hang on.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is securely fastened to the wall. There are about twenty hooks for weapons,
  but only a few of the are still occupied.

name: a metal stand
longdesc: A metal stand for armor is in the center of the room.

name: a pair of green tights
longdesc: There is a pair of green tights sitting in a little heap here.

extra_descriptions.description: They have some initials embroidered on the inseam that read RH.

name: the glass cabinet
longdesc: A glass cabinet stands open on the south end of the room.

name: Golgar's Hammer
longdesc: Golgar's old hammer lies here, it looks battleworn and appears to be glowing.

extra_descriptions.description: Golgar's old hammer lies here, it looks battleworn and appears to be glowing.

longdesc: Golgar's old hammer lies here, it looks battleworn and appears to be glowing.

extra_descriptions.description: Golgar's old hammer lies here, it looks battleworn and appears to be glowing.

longdesc: A strange stick lies here.

name: the wrong end of a strange stick
longdesc: A strange stick with only one end lies here.

longdesc: An finely crafted silver longsword.

extra_descriptions.description: You see nothing special.

name: a pan flute
longdesc: A pan flute is lying here on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
A pan flute, much like Zamfir would use, but with strange markings on the
back side.  They appear almost comprehensible, as if the written language
used is a derivative of yours.  From what you see, it says, "VARD UF
  REKOJJ.

name: a spiked club
longdesc: A spiked club is lying here on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: A small wooden club with several spikes on the end of it.

name: a goblin burger
longdesc: A tasty goblin burger is sitting here, wrapped in paper.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a hamburger made of goblin meat.  It's a highly nutritious and
  rather tasty meal.

name: a jug of bug juice
longdesc: A jug of bug juice is sitting here, waiting to be taken.

extra_descriptions.description:
A jug full of red bug juice, probably made from the local insects.
You see some tiny objects suspended in the crimson-colored liquid.
  Probably bug parts (good protein source), can't hurt ya.

name: a rainbow-colored scarf
longdesc: A pile of rainbow-colored silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This scarf is rainbow-colored, with it's share of reds, oranges,
yellows, greens, blues, and violets.  the patterns of the colors is
  quite mesmerizing.

name: a wastebasket
longdesc: A standard shopping mall wastebasket is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is your standard shopping mall wastebasket, able to hold much
  refuse and can fit your average high school nerd.

name: a pair of steel mesh gloves
longdesc: A pair of steel mesh gloves are lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A pair of gloves made of a strong steel mesh, something like chain
  mail, but a much finer resolution.  They feel cold to the touch.

name: a pair of fine leather boots
longdesc: A pair of fine, high-quality boots are lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A pair of boots made of a fine, high-quality leather, almost
suede-like, yet not quite.  It has an alien look to them, as if they
weren't treated the same way as leather usually is.  Perhaps this is
  why they are so highly-priced.

name: a secret decoder ring
longdesc: A secret decoder ring is sitting here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a secret decoder ring, as found in many popular cereal boxes.
You can barely read the words, "Made in Korea" as an inscription on
  the ring.

name: a scimitar
longdesc: A scimitar is lying here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a standard, 52 inch scimitar, model 3-a with an inscription on
  the hilt reading, "Midgard Weapon Company, Inc.

name: the Sword of the Ancients
longdesc: The Sword of the Ancients rests here

extra_descriptions.description:
This huge sword is very old, and very, very big and sharp.
It has been engraved with a series of flames from the hilt
upwards. A number 6 has been stylised in those flames.

name: the Helm of the Dragons
longdesc: A strange helm lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: The metal is like nothing you have ever seen, perhaps this helm is of the gods

name: a rune covered Breast plate
longdesc: A rune covered breast plate lies here in the dirt

extra_descriptions.description: The breast plate is of no metal you have ever seen, strange markings cover the plate.

name: a pair of silver boots
longdesc: A pair of silver boots stands neatly in the corner

extra_descriptions.description: They are made of pure silver.... they radiate a strong sense of magic.

name: silver shield
longdesc:
A Sturdy looking shield of silver rests against a nearby wall, gleaming
  brightly.

extra_descriptions.description:
The shield is made of a silvery substance.. It is like nothing you have
  ever seen.

name: a black and silver cloak
longdesc: A black and silver cloak lies crumpled in a corner.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is of a fine, black material that is as dark as night......
  Silver runes and symbols are carefully inscribed on the back of the cloak.

name: a pair of silver leg plates
longdesc: A pair of leg plates formed of some silver substance lie in pile.

name: a pair of silver gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of silver gauntlets lie here.

extra_descriptions.description: You see nothing special.

longdesc: A dark black cloak lies here in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: You see nothing specials.

longdesc: A rune covered bracelet lies here, burning fiercely.

extra_descriptions.description: It had several large diamonds placed on it... it burns fiercely!

longdesc: A small, wicked looking dagger lies here, its blade as black as night.

name: Krieg's Smashstick
longdesc: Kriegs stick lies here, blunted from whackin his neighbour

extra_descriptions.description: Krieg's xmas gift 2010, yay Bunta and Countess!! :)

name: a golden shield
longdesc:
A golden shield rests here, bearing the insignia of the guild
  of paladins.

extra_descriptions.description:
The shield is made of solid gold, normally too soft for armor, the shield
has been magically protected to avoid being easily damaged. Looking closer
at the shield reveals the insignia of the guild of paladins, a group of
  trustworthy warriors who protect the citizens of the land.

name: a Paladin's longsword
longdesc: An extremely fine crafted longsword lies here, glinting in the sunlight.

extra_descriptions.description:
It is a exquisitely crafted blade of the finest silver, looking closer 
you notice the insignia of the guild of paladins inscribed on the blade.

name: a bulletin board
longdesc: A large bulletin board is mounted on a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Use "Look AT board" to see a listing of the messages. Use "Read
<message number>" or "Remove <message number>" to read or remove
  a message, respectively.

name: a corrupted golden shield
longdesc:
A golden shield rests here, bearing the insignia of the guild
  of paladins.

extra_descriptions.description:
The shield is made of solid gold, normally too soft for armor, the shield
has been magically corrupted to help being easily damaged. Looking closer
at the shield reveals the fake insignia of the guild of paladins, a group of
  untrustworthy warriors who harass the citizens of the land.

name: chromed scales of Tiamat
longdesc: a chromed dragon scale glimmers brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The scales seem to be meshed into a perfect pattern giving
  the scales a chrome like pattern that glimmers in the light

name: chromed sleeves of Tiamat
longdesc: chromed dragon scales lie in the form of sleeves here.

extra_descriptions.description: You see some shiny chromed scales.

name: Tiamat's Claws

You open the dusty book and finds that most of the pages have been burned

the last page in the book seems rather new, 2 years old tops;

the forces of the black minotaur have invaded our peaceful forest, and we
are doomed to the retreat in the tombs. In the day of the moon, Year 50 our
good king, Tarin lost his battle against the minotaur, and became one of
it's minions. the queen declares the third day in the month of the Moon,
as a day of holiness, no work must be done.
the minotaur have found our retreat in this mountain, and are now invading
us, the head of their invading force is Tarin our old king! *sob* How cruel
can this life be?.
We are drawn back to our last bastion in the marble hall, and will be able
to keep this for several days we think. Our queen is often leading a helping
hand against the enemy.
the power is rising says the queen, new hope is born.
  -referatum.

longdesc: An evil-looking dagger with a jewelled hilt has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Mina's Fang is a beautiful and cruel dagger. She, and yes this dagger is
very definitely a she, was crafted for the Vampire Queen herself. The
hilt is studded with gems--emeralds, rubies, sapphires and diamonds. In
contrast, the steel of the blade shimmers with a blood-red lustre. Each
time the dagger is plunged in to a victim the jewels on the hilt glow
with a powerful magic, as the soul of the perforated target is slowly
sucked dry by the daggers' lust for life. It is said that Mina's Fang is
sentient... But the one who wields her would know.

name: Kalas' Klaw
longdesc: A slender sword with a gleaming red blade has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword has a slender, razor-edged, gleaming red blade, it's length
inscribed with designs of cloaked figures and tall scythes, accentuated
by a black blood trough running along its centre. The pommel and hilt
have been beautifully carved to resemble a skull and vertebrae
respectively, with the upper portion of the hilt is grooved like ribs.
The crosspiece has also been ornately carved and resembles a skeletal
pelvis, with legs spread out wide and bent back toward the head, so that
the wielder's hand would fit neatly within the 'bony' boundaries. All of
the carved detail is white, like perfectly-bleached bone, except for the
eye sockets of the skull pommel, which seem like black, bottomless pits
at one moment and fiery red infernos at the next.
