This mace is ancient.  So it old it must have been made in another
time and place by a people so knowledgeable that they even engraved
these wonderful flames along the bar and flanges.  A stylised number
5 has been embossed near the handle.

name: meat cleaver
longdesc: A meat cleaver lies here.

name: clerical robes
longdesc: some clerical robes lie here.

name: Smaug's Ring
longdesc: A black ring glows with a red aura here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring has been forged from one of the scales of Smaug the Mighty.  Not
only does this ring radiate power, it seems to possess some of the spirit
of the dragon itself!

name: Smaug's Claw
longdesc: A large, sharp, dangerous and above all evil-looking claw has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This claw has been taken from Smaug himself!!  It is super-sharp, heavy,
dangerous and evil-looking.  If you were insane, you could wield this as
a mighty weapon!

name: Sabatons of the Dwarven Defender
longdesc: A pair of highly armoured steel sabatons are here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These sabatons are not made for walking.  They are made to withstand
a tremendous beating.  Wearing these sabatons would keep your feet
safe and sound.  So much so you'd be admired by health and safety
officials the world over.

name: the corpse of a dwarven defender
longdesc: The corpse of Dwarven Defender is lying here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the corpse of a Dwarven Defender.  It has been charred
beyond recognition, the once fine armour melted and fused to
the blackened flesh.

name: Heartreaver
longdesc: The battleaxe Heartreaver has been propped against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The blade of this axe is formed from three evenly spaced prongs
of bright, silvery steel that attaches to the haft at the very
centre.  The haft itself is wrapped in fine steel cord, polished
to be as bright at the head whilst the handle is covered in a
tough black leather, softened from years of use, that contrasts
nicely with the rest of the weapon.  Overall, this axe might be
just the thing for decapitating your foes with.

name: Smaug's Wrath
longdesc: A glowing, tangible form of Smaug's wrath is here, flickering hotly.
item_ability_msg: #{bold red}Smaug's Wrath snuffs out like a candle in the wind.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Smaug's Wrath is a glowing, intricate gemstone shaped like a dancing flame.  It
captures the very essence of Smaug perfectly.

name: dwarven prayer beads
longdesc: A set of fine alabaster prayer beads have been left in a neat pile here.
item_ability_msg: #{cyan}The dwarven prayer beads emit a holy chorus of triumph and then fall silent.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This fine chain of 25 alabaster beads is broken only by the hammer sigil
of Fortrus in the centre, allowing a devout dwarf the chance to count the
daily prayers and rituals they follow with precision and a gloriously
satisfying click of stone on stone.

name: Will of the Fallen Dragon
longdesc: A strange will of the fallen dragon has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold blue}The Will of the Fallen Dragon loses the will to go on.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
The Will of the Fallen Dragon is an odd thing.  It could be a gem, it could be a
rock.  Who knows?  What you do know is that it pulses with power!

name: Shadow Strike
longdesc: A dagger wreathed in shadows lies on the floor here, forgotten.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged in the bowels of the Underdark, this shadowy dagger almost
seems to smoke as you look at it, with wisps of blackness rising
from the blade like vapour from a hot drink.

name: Wings of the Fallen Dragon
longdesc: A set of ancient, rotting dragon wings have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These wings once belonged to the Smaug.  Before his death he was a
magnificent creature, his brassy-scales shining in the sun.  Now
these wings reveal him to be a decrepit and vile thing, full of
hate and malice, his severed wings all black and diseased.  About
all you can say is that they look really cool when you wear them.
They might even do the really fun thing where they flap and knock
your enemies down.  Here's hoping!

name: the Defender
longdesc: The Defender lies here humming softly

name: the Scepter of Power
longdesc: The Scepter of Power lies here glowing brightly.

name: a misty cloak
longdesc: A misty cloak lies on the ground here.

name: the golden breast plate
longdesc: A golden breast plate lies gleaming on the ground here.

name: the glowing purple stone
longdesc: A brilliant purple stone lies on the ground here.

name: a major cloak of distortion
longdesc: A major cloak of distortion lies on the ground here.

name: a pair of banded sleeves
longdesc: A pair of banded sleeves.

name: a pair of banded leggings
longdesc: A pair of banded leggings lie on the ground here.

name: banded plate
longdesc: A plate of banded mail lies on the ground here.

name: a two-handed steel sword
longdesc: A large two-handed steel sword lies here on the ground.

name: a large marble fountain
longdesc: A large marble fountain lies in the center of the courtyard.

name: a small brush
longdesc: A small brush lies on a table here.

name: a dark blue cloak
longdesc: A dingy dark blue cloak lies on the ground here.

name: desk
longdesc: A small desk stands here on the western wall.

name: a large painting
longdesc: A large painting hangs from the wall here.

name: a steel sword
longdesc: A steel sword lies in the dust here.

name: a large steel shield
longdesc: A giant sized steel shield lies on the ground here.

name: a small steel shield
longdesc: A small steel shield lies on the ground here.

name: a large gleaming red cloak
longdesc: A red cloak of rank lies on the ground here

name: steel prison key
longdesc: A large steel prison key lies here.

name: a small oak key
longdesc: A small oak key lies here.

name: a small iron key
longdesc: An intricate little iron key glows softly here.

name: white marble key
longdesc: A heavy white marble key lies here on the ground.

name: a tiny black key
longdesc: A tiny black key lies on the floor here.

name: Tiamen's power-band
longdesc: A ring worn by the mighty Vie-Tiamen sits here in the dust.

name: a ring of black gold
longdesc: A polished black gold ring lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: You see nothing special.

name: a red dragon scale shirt
longdesc: A pile of red dragon scales has been heaped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This shirt is made from the tough, scarlet scales of a red dragon.

name: a Paladin's golden breast plate
longdesc: A golden breastplate has been left here to gather dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This golden breast plate looks like it should be useless.  It is made
of gold, it is heavy, it has a rather nice but silly vignette of some
ancient paladin hero slaying the evil masses and holding aloft a sword
that glows and leads in to a fancy emblazoned symbol of the guild of
paladins.  It is way OTT.  Yet... You feel like, if you were a paladin
this would be just the thing to wear the goody-goody Paladin's dance.

name: the Paladin Defender of Law
longdesc: The Defender of law lies here glowing heroically

extra_descriptions.description:
What idiot makes a sword out of gold?  We may never know, yet some-
one has and it looks amazing.  Sparkling, clean, lavish.  It's the
kind of sword one waves in the air dramatically before throwing ones
life away by charging an army of the undead.  However, legend has it
that foes who face off against someone wielding this sword, never
flee from battle... So it... Umm... Gives your enemy courage??

name: a steel mace
longdesc: A steel mace with a leather grip has been stored carefully here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mace was forged for the guards of Castle Nodonn.
What are you doing with it?

name: a short steel sword
longdesc: A short steel sword has been stored here carefully.

name: a steel nasal helm
longdesc: A conical nasal helm has been stacked here neatly.

extra_descriptions.description: This helm bares the Castle Nodonn makers mark.

name: Belt of Onslaught
longdesc: The Godly Belt of Onslaught has been left here by King Nodonn.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has been wrought from steel plates that overlap and fit together
so perfectly that they become as flexible as leather.  Each plate has been
embossed with an image of a warrior in battle, defeating enemies in great
gouts of blood and gore.  And above each image, shining like a cold blue
star, is a rune of potent magic.

name: polished steel plate
longdesc: A highly polished steel plate has been stacked here neatly.

name: polished steel greaves
longdesc: Some highly polished steel greaves have been stacked here neatly.

name: polished steel spaulders
longdesc: Some highly polished steel spaulders have been stacked here neatly.

name: a polished steel shield
longdesc: A highly polished steel shield has been stacked here neatly.

name: Bonebreaker
longdesc: The mighty mace Bonebreaker has been stored carefully here.

extra_descriptions.description: Bonebreaker is a hefty, powerful mace.  It has an enchantment on it.

name: the sigil of Nodonn
longdesc: A brilliant purple sigil lies on the ground here.

name: a regal tiara
longdesc: A pretty regal tiara has been stacked here neatly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This tiara belonged to Queen Merce.
That makes you a murderer or a thief...

name: a ragged death shroud
longdesc: A shroud, used for laying the dead to rest, has been dropped here.

name: a gleaming red robe
longdesc: A gleaming red robe has folded up here neatly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a beautiful gleaming red robe.
There's blood stains on it...
You did that when you killed the owner, didn't you?
'Fess up!

name: Tiamen's toe bone
longdesc: An ancient, blacked toe bone is here, looking like it fell off a leprous skeleton.
item_ability_msg: #{yellow}Tiamen's toe bone wriggles as if tired and goes limp.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the toe bone of Vie Tiamen, the Lich King who resides in the crypts
of Nodoon's Castle.  He (we assume) will want it back.

name: Tiamen's Ancient Death Shroud
longdesc: A tatty old cloth used for the covering the dead has been left here to rot.

extra_descriptions.description:
This a nine meter square of ancient, rotten cloth.  It had the soul purpose
of wrapping a corpse after death.  The stained, bedraggled material is holier
than a Swiss Cheese, and luckily one of these gaping rends is big enough for
you to squeeze your head through and wear around your neck.  You don't look
great in this, and you certainly do not smell good, but I bet you're proud
of yourself for robbing a poor old dead man of his last blanket.

name: Tiamen's Ring of Endless Power
longdesc: A glowing white ring spins endlessly here, creating a mini whirlwind of dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring is made of gold but glows white.  You'd expect it to be hot but
it's cool to the touch, almost icy, as if the hand of death that held it
for so long cooled it to a manageable temperature.  You feel like there is
no spell you cannot master with this ring adorning your finger.

name: Tiamen's Parallax Star
longdesc: A miniature star floats here, casting a ruddy glow over the surrounding detritus.
item_ability_msg: #{yellow}Tiamen's Parallax Star flares as if it is about to nova and then cools again.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This object is a tiny burning star that floats around you as if locked to your
own gravitational pull.  It looks like it could be extremely powerful...

name: a Shield of Ancient Lichdom
longdesc: #{yellow}A dusty old shield has been dropped here - it looks awful, leave it.#{o}
item_ability_msg: #{bold yellow}The Shield of Ancient Lichdom disintegrates into dust before reforming again.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This shield is just bigger than a buckler but smaller than a small round
shield.  Shaped like a coffin lid, the wooden frame has been inlaid with
thousands of tiny bones.  As you look closer, you see they are miniature
skeletons of humans and elves, dwarfs and orcs, all crawling and scrabb-
ling at the surface, crazed as if they are the tortured, trapped souls of
the damned fighting to escape whatever Hell they are in.  You even think
you can hear wails and gnashing of teeth coming from a long distance away.
A chill runs up your spine as you consider it.

name: a royal purple robe
longdesc: A royal purple robe lies here.

name: a glowing mithril ring
longdesc: A mithril ring with energy glowing about it sits here.

name: Bonecruncher
longdesc: A large, blood-stained axe sits here.

name: a small silver key
longdesc: A small silver key, glinting in the light, lies here.

name: a small golden key
longdesc: A small golden key lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a small golden key.  Against all the laws of probability it
has a small tag on it upon which someone has scrawled:

                             Mirror Key
                        Remember to get milk

name: a large cell key
longdesc: A large gray cell key lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a cheap and brittle key for a cell.  It is made of some kind
of cheap metal that is likely to break off in the lock if you're not
careful with it.

name: a red, runed key
longdesc: A key lies here, shedding a soft glow

name: a flaming key
longdesc: A key lies here, burning brightly

name: a tiny golden key
longdesc: You can barely make out a tiny golden key on the floor.

name: a green glowing key
longdesc: A green, glowing key lies here

name: a moria gate key
longdesc: A gray key made of stone lies here.

name: boots of elvenkind
longdesc: A pair of dark green boots lies here.

name: boots of tracking
longdesc: A pair of well used red boots lies here.

name: glowing white boots
longdesc: A pair of white boots, shining brightly, lies here.

name: a cloak of elvenkind
longdesc: A dark green cloak is piled up on the floor here.

name: a small silver cross
longdesc: A small silver cross lays here, surrounded by a white light

name: a ring of protection
longdesc: A ring, set with diamonds, lies here unnoticed.

name: flaming bracers
longdesc: A set of bracers lies here, burning brightly.

name: a flaming belt
longdesc: A flaming belt lies here, burning brightly

name: a crystal dragon skull
longdesc: A large dragon skull, made from crystal, lies here.

name: a blue ice bracelet
longdesc: A dark blue bracelet lies here.

name: a pitch-black belt
longdesc: A belt, as dark as midnight, lies here.

name: a brightly glowing shield
longdesc: A shield, glowing like the sun, lies here.

name: a cloak of Arachnida
longdesc: A black cloak, shot with streaks of red, lies here.

name: Phifer's decanter
longdesc: A small jug sits in the corner.

name: a small silver cross
longdesc: A cross, glowing with a heavenly light, lies here.

name: a frost brand scimitar
longdesc: A frost rimmed scimitar lies here

name: a shimmering white key.
longdesc: A key lies here, shimmering softly with a soft glow.

name: a shimmering black key
longdesc: A black key lies here, shimmering

name: a shimmering gray key
longdesc: A gray key, shimmering softly, lies here.

name: a crimson red key
longdesc: A crimson red key, the color of blood, lies here shimmering

name: a rusty dagger
longdesc: A rusty, tarnished dagger lies here.

name: a gleaming broadsword
longdesc: A broadsword, gleaming like the sun, lies here.

name: dark green boots
longdesc: A pair of dark green boots lies here.

name: a set of weighing scales
longdesc: A set of shining scales lies here

name: a pitch black potion
longdesc: A pitch black potion lies here.

name: a glittering blue potion
longdesc: A glittering blue potion rests here.

name: a ring of travel
longdesc: A ring of travel

name: a black journal
longdesc: A black journal has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Nightshades cont.

      the Nightwalker: Appears similar to a giant of some type, without
carried weapons and standing 20' tall.

   a last warning, the touch of any Nightshade is said to be poison.

Having done much research on the Nightshade, this is what i have found.
the deadly nightshades are large, powerful evil beings which seek to spread
death. Thankfully they are extremely rare, usually created or summoned by
a powerful being.
   All Nightshades are a deep jet black in color, with no other colors on
their entire forms. They have no visible eyes, apparently sensing their
surroundings magically. Tales tell of them even seeing people that took
the precaution of being invisible. a late master thief couldn't even sneak
past one, as another tale goes.
   Find mention of specific powers was difficult, as few who meet one live
to tell the tale. I did find though, that it takes very potent weapons of
power to hit one.
   the last i could find is that there are three types of Nightshades:
       the Nightcrawler: Appears similar to a purple worm, about 100' long
and 10' to 15' wide.
       the Nightwing: Appears similar to a gigantic bat with a 50' wing-
spread.
A small book bound in black dragon hide. You can look at page1, page2, etc.

name: Drow longsword
longdesc: A sharp looking longsword of adamantium lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: A sword of drow make. Sharp and light for it's size. the pummel is intricately carved into leering demon visages.

name: black elvenchain shirt
longdesc: A chain-mesh shirt of black stone lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A fine-mesh shirt of black metal. the style is that of drow armor.
i.e.: Padded shoulders, long in length, and tapering to points a lot.

name: black elvenchain sleeves
longdesc: A pair of chain-mesh sleeves of adamantium lie here.

extra_descriptions.description: A fine-mesh pair of black metal sleeves. the style looks to be drow.

name: black elvenchain leggings
longdesc: A pair of chain-mesh leggings of black stone lie here.

extra_descriptions.description: A pair of fine-mesh leggings of black metal. the style looks to be drow.

name: soft knee-high, black leather boots
longdesc: A pair of black leather boots sit here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A pair of knee-high boots, turned down at the top. They are of a soft
black leather you do not recognize.

name: soft black leather gloves
longdesc: A pair of black leather gloves lie here.

extra_descriptions.description: A pair of black gloves. They are of a soft black leather you don't recognize.

name: Drow buckler
longdesc: A small black buckler has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A small buckler of black metal. a large black widow above the symbol of
chaos are bas-relief on the surface.

name: an opal pendant
longdesc: A pendant of glittering opal has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: A beautiful pendant of dark glittering metal and fiery opals.

name: the Dao Circlet
longdesc: A circlet of gold has been carelessly left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A delicate circlet of gold. Legends tell of it being crafted for a Dao
Prince, ages ago. the Dao is to earth, as the Efreeti is to fire.

name: A rabid monkey
longdesc: A rabit monkey foams at the mouth in front of you.

extra_descriptions.description: This item is to be returned to Reignfyre immediately.

name: the Shadow armor
longdesc: A breast plate of black has been left here, in the shadows.

extra_descriptions.description:
A dusky black breast plate of unknown leather. the shadows seem to almost
cling to it.

name: the Heart of the Nightshade
longdesc: A huge black gem, lies here winking evily at you.

extra_descriptions.description:
When the Great Nightcrawler exploded into darkness, this was left. It is
an inky black multi-faceted spherical gem, the size of a trolls fist. It's
facets glint at you evily.

name: a dull waved dagger
longdesc: A dull wavy-bladed dagger lies here, forgotten.

name: Skull Crusher
longdesc: A beautifully wicked mace rests here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A wicked bloodmace. This weapon bends the rules on cleric restrictions.
the mace is huge and well balanced, with large spikes adorning the head.

name: spring
longdesc: A large spring has formed here.

name: boots of free action
longdesc: A pair of fine soft leather boots of elven design rests here.

name: a prismatic sword
longdesc: A shimmering sword lies here reflecting all the colors of the rainbow.

name: a shield of fire
longdesc: a small fire burns brightly in the corner.

name: a cloak of darkness
longdesc: A cloak of purest black lies here.

name: chaos armor
longdesc: a suit of armor lies here, shimmering in a choatic light.

name: a diamond-tinted shield
longdesc: a diamond tinted shield made for Huttan the barbarian lies here.

name: Ibanez dirty key
longdesc: A black key with the signature of Ibanez lies here.

name: Shield of Dark Fire
longdesc: a large black fire burns in the corner.

name: a diamond-tinted shield
longdesc: a diamond tinted shield made for Huttan the barbarian lies here.

name: a dragonspine trophy
longdesc: A dragonspine trophy has been left here.
item_ability_msg: The dragonspine trophy effect fades.

name: a Cross of Lorraine
longdesc: A Cross of Lorraine lies in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a small gold cross.  It is made of single vertical bar crossed 
by two horizontal bars.  The horizontal bars are graded in such a way
that the upper is shorter that the lower.  This particular version
represents the faith Sir Xavier of the Vale has and his undying love and
commitment to Law.  A fact that the Lord of Chaos uses against the wit-
less, ignorant knight.

name: a Mirror Key
longdesc: A Mirror Key is here, waiting to be taken.

extra_descriptions.description:
This tiny key has been polished to a brilliant shine.  You can see your
face in it!  Stop staring, you narcissist!

name: Kharn's Horde Key
longdesc: Kharn's Horde key has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This iron key glows from within as if it has been heated up to an
incredible temperature!  It belongs to Kharn the Immolator, and he
probably wants it back.

name: Moxia's Horde Key
longdesc: Moxia's Horde key has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This iron key glows from within as if it has been heated up to an
incredible temperature!  It belongs to Moxia the Cursed, and she
probably wants it back.

name: The Key to Escaping
longdesc: The Key to Escaping Draxas' throne room is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This small gold key opens something... But what??

name: The Key to the Dragon Hall
longdesc: The Key to the Dragon Hall has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is golden key that has been engraved with the image of a
dragon.  Very fancy indeed!

name: The Key to Castle Draxas
longdesc: The Key to Castle Draxas is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This neat little key opens the great black gates to Castle Draxas.

name: the Corpse of Sir Xavier
longdesc: The mangled corpse of Sir Xavier is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the corpse of Sir Xavier.  He took a geas.  He fought valiantly.
He died.  Now all that is left of this once fine knight is the meat on
his bones.

name: Chain of the Eight Point Star
longdesc: A heavy chain holding an eight point star has been left here to get dusty.

extra_descriptions.description:
The eight point star is the symbol of Draxas and is synonymous with the
forces of Chaos.  This one has been forged from an iron-like material
that has the same properties as the normal, worldly iron, but has been
tinted red.  Many scholars call this demonspar, but there's no evidence
that the stuff comes from any demonic pit.  The chain contains 33 heavy
links and is offset by a large eight point star at the centre.  It looks
very heavy...

name: Dracthyr Cuffs
longdesc: A spiky demonspur cuff is here, looking like a health and safety hazard.
item_ability_msg: #{bold white}The demonspur cuffs flame hotly for a moment. #{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Demonspur is a type of mithril native to the plains of Chaos.  Darkling
smiths have been known to forge many terrible wonders from it, including
deadly weapons and powerful devices.  These cuffs are around 6 inches in
length and fit on to the wrist.  A series of spikes has been hammered in
to the metal from the bottom side providing a nasty looking catch for
any flesh unfortunate enough to be struck.

name: a Floating Eight Point Star
longdesc: An eight point star floats just above the dirt and grime here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold}The floating eight point star goes nova in a shock of blinding light!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a small eight point star that spins on it's axis every few seconds.  It
looks to made of sparkling ruby.

name: Balgor's Lost Chicken Skull
longdesc: A highly polished chicken skull has been placed on a tiny plinth here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Balgor, legendary hero of Moria, has more lost items than the entire pantheon
of wretched adventurers from Midgard.  This is his prized chicken skull, made
from the calcite remains of a dead chicken butchered in the name of Mehungo,
the Orcish God of Food.  Whilst it provided two good drumsticks in the past,
its days of providing a decent meal appear to be over.

name: the Severed Tail of Lord Draxas
longdesc: The severed tail of Lord Draxas wriggles and squirms in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the severed tail of Lord Draxas.  It is around four feet in length and
blood-red in colour, with a heart-shaped barb on the end.  The stump oozes a
black, viscus liquid that could be blood.  The one-time owner of this horrible
wriggling thing was a demonic prince and self-proclaimed Lord of Chaos known as
Draxas.  He instigated an incursion in to the realms that persists to this day. 
This part of him lives on, writhing and thrashing around.  It imparts some of
the most powerful magic in the realms.

name: a horned full-face helm
longdesc: A horned full-face helm sits here menacingly.
action: The eyes behind the helm glow red!

extra_descriptions.description:
This helm has been forged from iron and consists of a T-cut front plate that
allows the wearer to see out whilst protecting all of the face.  A set of
horns has been added to the sides of the helm, just below the dome of the
crown, that curl upwards above the head and meet near the tips before they
curl outwards once more.

name: a leather harness
longdesc: A simple black leather harness has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This harness consists of several lengths of leather straps that buckle
together at a metal loop that sits in the centre of the chest.  Overall
it looks pretty (if you're in to that), and would certainly show off a
whole bunch of bulging muscles, but otherwise looks to offer very little
protection.

name: a Wickedly Spiked Axe
longdesc: A mean looking axe covered in wicked spikes has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This axe is a standard looking weapon covered in spikes.  There seems to be
blood dried on to the blade.  Yuck!

name: a Wickedly Spiked Mace
longdesc: A mean looking mace covered in wicked spikes has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is the biggest, spikiest mace you have ever seen.  It is immensely heavy.

name: Abolleth
longdesc: The greatsword Abolleth has been thrust in to the earth here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Abolleth is a giant greatsword.  The handle, blade and crosspiece have
been forged of demonspur in the fiery depths of the chaos plane.  The
grip has been wrapped in supple red leather, whilst the crosspiece has
been shaped like a pair of bat wings outstretched and lacquered in red
and black enamel.  The blade, all six-feet of it, has been finely etched
from the base upwards, giving it a dull, dark look, whilst the edges and
point have been sharped and polished to a high sheen, contrasting nicely
with the matte of the interior.  At the bottom of the blade, just above
the crosspiece, a decorative gem creates the illusion of a circular eye
with a slit, cat-like pupil, that darts around, looking here, there and
everywhere... It must be an illusion, right?  No sword has an eye...
Right?

name: molten demonspur breastplate
longdesc: A breastplate glows red hot in dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This breastplate has been forged from a type of mithril found only in
the Plains of Chaos.  It seems to have been heated to an incredible
temperature, but something is preventing it from cooling off.  It blasts
waves of heat at your face that beat on your flesh like a hammer in the
sun.

name: molten demonspur epaulets
longdesc: A set of epaulets glow red hot in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These epaulets have been forged from a type of mithril found only in
the Plains of Chaos.  They seem to have been heated to an incredible
temperature, but something is preventing them from cooling off.  They
blast waves of heat at your face that beat on your flesh like a hammer
in the sun.

name: molten demonspur legplates
longdesc: A pair of legplates glow red hot in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These legplates have been forged from a type of mithril found only in
the Plains of Chaos.  They seem to have been heated to an incredible
temperature, but something is preventing them from cooling off.  They
blast waves of heat at your face that beat on your flesh like a hammer
in the sun.

name: molten demonspur helm
longdesc: A helm glows red hot in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helm has been forged from a type of mithril found only in the
Plains of Chaos.  It seems to have been heated to an incredible
temperature, but something is preventing it from cooling off.  It
blasts waves of heat at your face that beat on your flesh like a
hammer in the sun.

name: a ragged lace nightgown
longdesc: An ancient and ragged lace nightgown has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold red}The ragged lace nightgown loses a little bit of integrity.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This nightgown looks like it might have once been beautiful, with pretty
floral edging and scroll work to match the skill of even the most gifted
of Elven seamstresses.  Now though, it is a dirty, grey ragged thing, in
no condition to be worn at all.  Little bits of ancient, rotten lace fall
off here there as you move.  Hopefully it will hold together long enough
for you to appreciate the beauty it once held.

name: a rotten spellstaff
longdesc: A rotten old spellstaff leans against a wall here.
item_ability_msg: #{green}The rotten spellstaff crawls with maggots for a moment!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a spellstaff that at some point in the distant past was a glory
to behold.  There are still tinges of its once golden stain here and
then.  Now it is a wretched thing, crawling with maggots, and worms, and
worse.  It is mostly a vile green in colour now, and what little flecks
of gold are left from the original stain are doomed to be gone in the
next few years.

name: ragged warband
longdesc: A ragged leather warband has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This warband has been made from weathered, ragged-looking leather.  However,
on closer inspection you can see that the ageing and weathering is by design
and the warband is actually in very good condition and likely to last a long
while.

name: a ragged warcloak
longdesc: A ragged leather cloak has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This warcloak is made of thick, warm leather that has been weathered to make it
look old and used.  In reality it is well made and in a very good condition.

name: A crooked warlock hat
longdesc: A crooked, pointy hat with the word 'WAARLOKK' embroidered on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hat looks like a traditional wizards hat except it has no brim and is crooked
from top to bottom - as if it has been sat on by a large bottom.  It is, however,
covered in moons, stars, runes, and other shapes that the maker thought was going
to be mystical but instead makes it look silly.  To top it off, someone has stitched
in bright golden thread the word 'WAARLOKK' across what could possibly be the front.

name: the Darkling Desire
longdesc: The Desire of the Darkling is here, sparkling mystically.
item_ability_msg: #{blue bold}The Darkling Desire fades and hope is lost :-()#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This trinket is the Desire of the Darkling, the thing that drives those strange
little dark-skinned Elfish creature to do what thet do for the Lord of Chaos.

name: a Shire-forged steel maille shirt
longdesc: A maille shirt formed from Shire-forged steel has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This maille shirt has been made from hundreds and hundreds of tiny steel links
forged in the Shire.  This kind of work is produced only for the greatest of
the Shire heroes.  Whilst not as intricate as the work of the Dwarfs, or as
magical as the work of the Elves, it is practical and hard-wearing enough for
the likes of you.

name: a Shire-forged steel bracer
longdesc: A steel bracer of Shire-forged steel has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bracer is made of practical and hard-wearing steel forged in the Shire.
Whilst not as intricate as the work of the Dwarfs, or as mystical as the work
of the Elves, it is never-the-less a good piece of armour that would serve
you well on the field of battle.

name: Shire-forged steel greaves
longdesc: A set of Shire-forged steel greaves have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These greaves have been forged in the Shire using locally sourced steel.  In
such a small place, objects like this hold great value, so are usually kept 
in reserve for heroes and leaders.  Although the work itself does not have
the powerful enchantments of the Elves, or the skilled tooling of the Dwarfs,
it is of high quality and should prove to be very practical on the battlefield.

name: Angrist
longdesc: The short sword Angrist, the Chaos Bane, has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged long, long ago by the Elves, when wars waged across the Realms, and
the smiths of Nordrasil worked night and day to produce the finest weapons
the Silvan people had ever seen.  Angrist is a short sword, quick and deadly
in design.  Following the defeat of Nuahlon, relics like this were scattered
to the winds, diminishing the power of the Elves.  This one was found by a
young Halfling adventurer from the Shire, who went on to join the Knights of
Thaumlore.  If you want the tale of how she won it, you should ask her.

name: a Shire-forged steel shield
longdesc: A shield made of practical Shire-forged steel rests against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from locally-sourced steel, and made by Halfling smiths, this shield is
one of the finest examples of the work of the little-folk.  Once emblazoned with
the sigil of the Shire, it now proudly displays the markings of Thaumlore, and
is used to help protect the wearer from the threats posed by incursions from the
lower planes.  It is round, with a sturdy leather strap and handle, practical in
every sense of the word.

name: stained warcloak
longdesc: A dirty, stained warcloak looks like it's rotting in to the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Once upon a time this warcloak was magnificent.  You can see it was lined
with soft, warm fur to keep the wearer warm in the colder climes, and
decorated with red swirls and loops reminiscent of the barbarian tribes
of the vast northern reaches.  Alas, this is no longer the case.  Most of
the fur has rotted away, leaving thick tufts of dreadlocked and matted hair
in places, and large swathes of bald patches that stink of mold.  The
decorations are all but gone, wiped away by dirt, grime and gnawing insects
that have burrowed in to the thick leather and laid fat, swollen, pale eggs
that are likely to burst and belch forth foul larvae to do yet more damage.
But, overall, it will still provide some excellent protection.

name: Neiglen, the Disease Barer
longdesc: Neiglen, the Disease Barer, is here, ready to start a plague in your neighbourhood.

extra_descriptions.description:
Neiglen is a short-handled handaxe, like the type favoured by Dwarfs the world
over.  Formed from demonspur, it has a waxy, brown-leather handle that feels
damp to the touch, and makes your fingers feel tacky.  The head is tinted green
and embossed with a the head of a serpent with an open mouth and forked tongue.
The blade is very sharp, and curves upwards from a point near the grip to the
top in an S shape.  The blade is balanced by a lethal-looking spike on the off-
side.  A gangrenous, viscous liquid oozes from pore-like holes dotted across the
metal.

name: stained wargloves
longdesc: A pair of old, stained wargloves have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pair of demonspur wargloves that have not been well looked after at
all.  The underlay of leather is stiff, rough and rotten in places.  They feel
gritty on your hands, as if the owner never cared for the gloves or themselves
and they make you feel dirty just wearing them.  The demonspur, a mithril-like
metal native to the lower planes, is also dirty, stained and rusty in places.
You could catch a disease just looking at these things.

name: Rusty Old Warmail
longdesc: Some rusty old warmail has been dropped in to a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from demonspur - a type of mithril native to the evil lower planes,
this old warmail is covered in rust.  Mold has even found a purchase on the
metal, turning it a vile green colour in places that makes the rust look a
lot uglier than it otherwise would.  Overall, this armour could do with a 
good clean... In a volcano... Preferably one called something like 'Mount
Doom'.

name: a Rusty Chaos Warhelm
longdesc: A round full-face helmet in the style favoured by the minions of chaos lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Chaos Helmets have a distinct look about them; rounded tapering down to the
nape of the neck, and always with a T-cut visor to see through that leaves
the eys glowing like red-hot coals on a dark night.  This one is decorated
with a single horn that curls forward from the temple on the left side.  The
mirror horn on the right hand side has snapped off at the base long ago.
The demonspur, a mithril-like metal from the lower planes, is blackened with
dirt and spotted with rust, and looking inside you see the soft-leather pad-
ding is wet and rotten.  Yuck!  I wouldn't put that on your head if I were
you!

name: a Crystal Dragonscale Shirt
longdesc: A shirt made from crystal dragonscale has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shirt has been made from the scales of a very ancient red dragon.
So ancient in face that the scales themselves are red-hot and loot like
they're molten and crystallised.  This could only have come from Pyros,
the daughter of Tiamat, and eldest of all dragons.

name: the Crystal Skull of Pyros
longdesc: The crystal skull of the dread dragon Pyros is here, taking up a lot of room.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skull once belonged to Pyros, and is now seemingly yours.  It has
all the hallmarks of a dragon skull, with pointy teeth and a set of horns
that could do some serious damage if you ran really fast with them.

name: the Crystal Dragon Claw
longdesc: A crystal dragon claw has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the severed front-right claw of Pyros, daughter the Dragon
Goddess Tiamat, and eldest dragon to grace the realms.  You would
be forgiven for thinking it would take a team of giant barbarians
and a whole engineering squad with cranes to lift it, but it is
remarkably light, with four forward-facing claws and a single claw
facing backward.  Getting hit by this thing is likely to hurt.

name: Wings of Pyros
longdesc: The crystal wings of Pyros are here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold magenta}The Wings of Pyros flare open dramatically!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This wings are almost translucent to look at and rise up above the
wearers head whilst in the relaxed position.  And then, every now
and then, they will flare out as if opening wide, exposing delicate
crystal feathers that create a rainbow of light scattering over the
heads of all nearby.

name: a Burning Stake
longdesc: A stake burns here, spitting and hissing as it does so.
item_ability_msg: #{bold red}The Burning Stake flickers, dies out, and flares back to life!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a burning stake, like the type used to stab vampires through the
heart to kill them.  This one is a splinter from the stake that Moxia the
Cursed was tied to at her execution.  And, like her, it burns continuously,
its fire never to be smothered.

name: a Molten Ring
longdesc: A ring burns hotly here in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This unique ring is made of demonspur, a type of mithril found on the
lower planes.  It has properties almost the same as the worldly mithril
except that it is easy to tarnish.  Luckily some power forces this ring
to burn so brightly it is molten to the touch, rendering all imperfections
of the metal invisible.

name: a Witch-Hunter Hat
longdesc: A wide-brimmed black felt hat has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hat has been made from soft, black felt that has been stretched
over a wide-brimmed wicker frame.  The crown has been reinforced with
steel plates, providing very good protection for something so flimsy.
A leather strap and silver buckle adorns the base of the crown, giving
the whole affair a classy, sophisticated look that would be sure to
turn heads at the local Midgard pubs.

name: a molten brand
longdesc: A molten brand has been left here to smoulder in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This a leather square of skin that has been stitched in to a pouch.  Although
you can't tell what creature this came from, it has been branded with a large
'W' that still burns and glows hotly.  Traditionally a 'W' symbolised a witch
and as this came from Moxia the Cursed, it's likely to be an actual cutting
of her own skin from where she was branded in life... Yuck.

name: a Molten Blade
longdesc: A blade has been left here with a red-hot molten edge.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the only surviving sabre of Moxia the Cruel that she wielded in life
to devastating effect.  It was added to the fire with her, and still glows
hotly from the intense heat.

name: a gleaming sword
longdesc: A shiny, gleaming sword has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword is made of steel and looks fit to be wielded by a righteous
paladin or cavalier on a crusade.  Just above the crosspiece are the
letters 'X V'. Whatever that means.

name: a gleaming shield
longdesc: A bright, polished shield gleams under the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shield is round and made of steel.  It has the symbol of the
Vale emblazoned on the front; a silvery-green oak tree over an 
inverted tan chevron.  It looks ideal for a paladin or cavalier.

name: gleaming pauldrons
longdesc: A pair of shiny, gleaming pauldrons sparkle in the dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
These pauldrons are made of highly polished steel and fit over the shoulders to
provide extra protection to the arms.  Just below the rim near the collar are
the letters 'X V'.  No idea what that means, probably means they were the 15th
made...

name: gleaming legplates
longdesc: A set of legplates gleams brightly in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These legplates are made of gleaming plates of steel that have been polished
to a high sheen.  They would be perfect for a paladin or cavalier.  They have
the letters 'X V' engraved on the crotch... Odd place to put a moniker...

name: gleaming boots
longdesc: A pair of bright, gleaming boots have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots are made of plates of steel over a leather insole.  They have
been polished to a high sheen.  They are just the type of thing a paladin
or cavalier would wear in the quest to be as ostentatious as possible.  The
letters 'X V' have been engraved on the heel...

name: gleaming gloves
longdesc: A pair of gloves gleam and sparkle in the dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
These gloves have been made from plates of steel over a soft leather
underlay.  They have been polished so much they gleam.  Each palm has
the letters 'X V' engraved on them... Well, that's not going to help
you tell your left from right.

name: a tabard of the light
longdesc: a white tabard has folded up neatly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a white tabard that has a the symbol of the vale emblazoned on
the chest; a silvery-green oak tree over an inverted tan chevron.  On
the inside back of the neckline someone has added, in crude stitching,
the letters 'X V' and 'do not boil wash'.  Maybe this is for a size 15?
Well, that's far too small for the likes of you!

name: four-horned helm of the champion
longdesc: A helm with four horns on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a typical helm worn by warriors of chaos.  Made from Demonspur, a
type of mithril native to the lower planes, it is perfectly cylindrical
from neck to forehead where it domes over the crown of the head.  A 'T'
has been cut in the face to allow the wearer to peer out with the minimal
of flesh being exposed.  And for some reason, when worn, it causes the
eyes of the wearer to glow red, like hotly burning coals, giving the helm
a sinister, demonic feel.

name: the Black Reaver
longdesc: The Black Reaver, a large bastard sword, sits in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Black Reaver is a large bastard sword made of demonspur; a mithril-like
metal from the lower planes.  The handle is short and allows you only to
grip the shiny black leather with a hand and a half.  The crosspiece has
been stylised in to a fanged skull with 4 legs, whilst the blade is tapers
forward for nearly six feet of wavy, sharpened death.

name: a Spiked Pauldron
longdesc: A single spiked pauldron has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a single pauldron made of demonspur, a mithril-like ore mined from
the depths of the lower planes.  It sits on a single shoulder, providing
protection for the weapon arm.  This particular one is covered in long,
rusty-looking spikes that are likely to give you a nasty infection should
you prick yourself.

name: a Spiky Maul
longdesc: A spiky maul lies in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This maul is around 20 inches long and ends in a ball of demonspur covered in
spikes.  It looks like it will punch through armour well, and deliver some
devastating damage.

name: a Spiked Harness
longdesc: An uncomfortable looking harness covered in spikes is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This harness is made of leather.  Were it not for the ridiculous spikes that
protrude from it, it would look quite innocuous.

name: a Spiked Warhammer
longdesc: A warhammer covered in spikes has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This warhammer looks like any other warhammer except that it is covered in
evil looking spikes from just above the grip to the tip of the head.  While
not pretty to look at, it's probably devasting to your enemies.

name: Chaos Studded Belt
longdesc: A thick black belt with demonic studs on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt is made of thick leather, 6 inches wide, that stretches around
the best to form a belt.  Along the central line is a series of studs in
the likeness of the Lord of Chaos, Draxas, grinning wikedly up at you.

name: a Spear of Blight
longdesc: A long, demonspur spear stands here, looking dangerous.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spear is a made of a demonspur from tip to base.  The head and shaft
all formed from the same piece of ore.  Magical runes have been inscribed
around the shaft around six inches below the head that sparkle and crackle
with blue and white lightning.

name: a dragon-hide pack
longdesc: A large pack made of dragon-hide has been dumped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a lovely red pack made of dragon-hide.  It has fine detailing
around its many pockets, including a flap that allows you to close it
and prevent prying eyes from seeing your most prized possessions!

name: a Dragon Ring of Force
longdesc: A red lacquered ring has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold yellow}The Dragon Ring of Force spins and grinds for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring has been forged from demonspur in the fiery heat of a dragons
breath.  It has been enchanted with runes of chaos that encircle the
inner band, leaving the outer plain.  And then, over the top of the
demonspur, a red lacquer has been added that gives it a bloody, lustrous
sheen.

name: a Dragon Ring of Thaumaturgy
longdesc: A green lacquered ring has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold yellow}The Dragon Ring of Thaumaturgy spins and sparks for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring has been forged from demonspur in the fiery heat of a dragons
breath.  It has been enchanted with runes of chaos that encircle the
inner band, leaving the outer plain.  And then, over the top of the
demonspur, a green lacquer has been added that gives it a vile, lustrous
sheen.

name: a Dragon Ring of Grace
longdesc: A blue lacquered ring has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold yellow}The Dragon Ring of Grace spins and whirls for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring has been forged from demonspur in the fiery heat of a dragons
breath.  It has been enchanted with runes of chaos that encircle the
inner band, leaving the outer plain.  And then, over the top of the
demonspur, a blue lacquer has been added that gives it a vile, lustrous
sheen.

name: a Dragon Necklace
longdesc: A necklace formed from beads of crystal dragon scale has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This necklace has been formed from tiny beads of crystal that form on the
tops of crystal dragon scales.  Rare and delicate, items made from them
are said to be incredibly powerful and rare.

name: the Spawn of Chaos
longdesc: The spawn of chaos spins in circle here.
item_ability_msg: #{red bold}The Spawn of Chaos freezes in time for moment!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a tiny dragon spawn.  It has a lot of innate power that maybe
you can harness?

name: Chaos Dragon Wings
longdesc: An enormous set of dragon wings have been dumped here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold magenta}The Wings of Pyros flare open dramatically!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a large pair of dark red wings that belonged to the Chaos Dragon
spawn Onydraxas, daughter of Esadora Onyx and Draxas, Lord of Chaos.

name: a Vial of Dragon Blood
longdesc: An ounce sized vial of dragon blood sits in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a small glass vial that holds an ounce of rich, crimson dragon
blood.  It bubbles and smokes and lights the way with a bloody sheen to
keep you warm and safe.

name: Deathbringer
longdesc: Deathbringer, the axe of chaos, has been left impaled in the earth here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged deep in the lower planes from demonspur mixed with the blood of a
thousand sacrificed demons, Deathbringer was the gift of Draxas to his
daughter, Onydraxas.  It has a long, sweeping handle with a curve not un
-like a bow, with a large gem socket in the pommel for extra power and a
soft, demon-skin handle.  The blade accentuates the curve of the handle,
rolling forward like a scythe.  Deathbringer has tasted more souls than
any other weapon in these realms and, it is said, has the power to send 
its wielder in to a furious rage.

name: Deathbringers' Helm
longdesc: A large helm, crowned with spikes, has been left in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from demonspur, this helm is dark and brooding, with spikes rising up
from every surface, like flames in a fire.

name: a sack of dragon treasure
longdesc: A large sack full dragon treasure is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This large sack is full of dragon treasure.  Oh... Yes... It's been looted
by an adventurer and now contains knick-knacks from the Chessboard and a
load of beers...  Typical.

name: a dragons treasure
longdesc: A dragons treasure worth of gold has been left here.

name: the Soul of Onydraxas
longdesc: A sparkling red soul gem has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
After the defeat of Onydraxas, her soul withered and decayed in to this
sparkling, red gem.  What you do with it now, is up to you.

name: the Corrupt Brainstem
longdesc: A glistening, disgusting purple brainstem has been left to rot here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the wobbly, purple brainstem of Onydraxas.  It has been corrupted by
the magic of Chaos and the influence of Draxas.  It's probably best to junk
it.

name: Esadora's Promise
longdesc: A demonspur ring emblazoned with a large princess-cut emerald is here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold green}The emerald in Esadora's Promise pulses brightly!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring forged with the combined power of Esadora Onyx and her lover
Draxas with the intent to bind their wills and allow the creation of the
Deathbringer, Onydraxas.  A simple loop of demonspur, it is crowned with
a large emerald in a princess-cut.  A tiny part of Esadora Onyx and Draxas
lives in this gem, giving them a kind of immortality, but it is also the
source of the rings' power.

name: Drape of the Deathbringer
longdesc: A fine, red and black drape is here, looking immaculate.
item_ability_msg: #{bold cyan}Flaring wildly, the Drape of the Deathbringer looks like evil bat wings for a moment!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Like all dragons, Onydraxas is able to take a humanoid form if she wishes.
In her case, her preferred appearance is that of a dark-skinned Drow with
layered black and red hair and bright green, feral eyes that match her own.
Draxas used part of his soul to create this drape for her when she takes on
that form, providing her protection and enhancing her powers.  It is woven
from golden silk on the front, and dark, lustrous sanguine silk on the back,
and trimmed with light cream silk.  It is spectacular.

name: Drakfang, the Life Bane
longdesc: A long incisor from the mouth of Onydraxas is here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold cyan}Drakfang hungers for another life!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Drakfang is an actual dragons tooth.  It is around 18 inches long, with a 
serrated edge and sharp, pointy tip.  The handle has been wrapped in red 
leather and the pommel contains enough socket holes for three gems.

name: an unholy mace
longdesc: a dark mace lies here, cold to the touch.

name: a grave spear
longdesc: a long ornate spear lies here.

name: a shrouded cloak
longdesc: A pale burial cloak is piled up on the floor here.

name: a broken black broadsword of the undead plane
longdesc: The bottom half of what used to be a broadsword lies here.

name: a blue shroud
longdesc: A blue shroud has been dropped here.

name: an amulet of bone
longdesc: A bone on a leather strap lies here on the ground.

name: a wraith hammer
longdesc: A wraith hammer has fallen to the ground here.

name: a wraith sword
longdesc: A wraith sword has fallen to the ground here.

name: an unholy pendant
longdesc: A unholy pendant is on the ground here.

name: a finger-bone necklace
longdesc: A necklace made of finger bones is here.

name: A wraith shield
longdesc: A very large wraith shield has been left here.

name: a blue elixir
longdesc: A blue elixir has been set here.

name: a pair of grave boots
longdesc: A pair of grave boots has been lost here.

name: a wraith band
longdesc: A band of iron lies here.

name: a large wraith band
longdesc: A large iron band lies here.

name: a suit of ornate wraith mail
longdesc: An ornate suit of wraith mail lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This armour has been made from tiny links of the condensed ethereal essence of a
wraith.  It is a lightweight and very strong!

name: a suit of wraith mail
longdesc: A suit of wraith mail lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This armour has been made from tiny links of the condensed ethereal essence of a
wraith.  It is a lightweight and very strong!

name: a bone ring
longdesc: A bone ring has been lost here.

name: a glowing bone ring
longdesc: A glowing bone ring has been lost here.

name: a diamond encrusted bone crown
longdesc: A crown with some very big diamond lies here.

name: a black potion
longdesc: A black potion has been set here.

name: a large club
longdesc: A large crude club lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: You see a big, hastily made club.  It is quite heavy .

name: a small diamond
longdesc: A small diamond glitters on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: This diamond is worth thousands of gold pieces!

name: a backpack
longdesc: A small backpack lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: This backpack looks sturdy enough to hold almost anything.

name: a clear potion
longdesc: A clear potion lies here.

name: a golden dagger
longdesc: A golden dagger lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: This dagger is inscribed with the runes of the archmage.

This plain grey key opens the grate that leads to the Labyrinth of
Tartarus.

name: a large cleaver axe

With a tall wooden handle and a sharp edge, this axe cuts
through wood like butter.

name: a farmer pitchfork

extra_descriptions.description:
The pitchfork is heavy to lift and wield,  rust stains its
edges.

name: a raven egg
longdesc: a unprotected raven egg lies here, waiting to be eaten.

name: a primitive scarecrow
longdesc:
A ghost like scarecrow stands mounted into the field here,
keeping ravens away.

name: a mother's apron
longdesc: a fat-stained apron lies discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Stained with grease and fat, this apron has been used several
times while preparing food.

name: a wooden wardrobe
longdesc: A wooden wardrobe stands heavy upon the floor here.

name: a barrel of rainwater
longdesc: A barrel filled with rainwater stands here, close by the wall.

name: a tightly meshed fishing net
longdesc: a bundle of strings lies all tangled up here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A skillful hand tied this net together, fishes should have
serious troubles escaping this fierce prison.

name: a grain sack
longdesc: a sack made from holding grain, stands here.

name: a iron ration
longdesc: a food package lies here, wrapped in layers of cloth.

extra_descriptions.description:
From what you can tell from the smell, and the looks of this
food, it could be dangerous to eat.

name: the large stone well
longdesc: A large stone lined well stands here.

name: an old suit of rusty chain mail
longdesc: An old suit of battered chain mail lies here on the ground, slightly rusting.

extra_descriptions.description: This old suit of battered and rusty chain mail has seen many battles.  Many of the links are split asunder or are missing, but it still seems to protect well enough.  A creeping rust is starting to make its way along the bottom of the mail, working its way slowly upward.   There are patches of chain links that are slowly disintegrating into a fine crimson dust, while others seem to gleam in the nearby light.

name: a rusty old helmet
longdesc: An old dented helmet lies here on the ground, gathering a thin layer of rust.

extra_descriptions.description: This extremely old and worn helmet is covered in a light layer of crimson rust.  There is a scattering of dents all along its surface, and one of the horns is broken clean off.  The remaining horn is chipped at the tip, and discolored a muted yellow from age.  The nose protector is twisted askew and the edges of the helm have been beveled from the passing of time.

name: an old rusty suit of plate mail
longdesc: An old rusty suit of war-torn plate mail lies here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: This well-worn and war-battered old suit of plate mail has been through many battles.   Numerous dents all along its well-rusted surface tells its long embittered story, as chips of metal and flakes of rust slowly fall to the ground.  The edges of the plate mail are chipped and notched, as segments of the mail` are coming loose from their moorings.  Any unique markings, designs, or filigree work have long ago faded from time and battle, lost in the thick layer of crimson rust that mars its surface.

name: a rusty pair of greaves
longdesc: A battered pair of armor for the legs lies here on the floor, slowly gathering a layer of rust.

extra_descriptions.description: An extremely old pair of battle-ravaged steel plates is starting to succumb to the ages.  A layer of bright crimson rust crawls along the surface of the greaves, eating away at the thick metal protection.

name: a rusty pair of vambrace
longdesc: A battered pair of vambrace lies here on the floor, slowly gathering a layer of rust.

extra_descriptions.description: An extremely old pair of battle-ravaged steel plates is starting to succumb to the ages.  A layer of bright crimson rust crawls along the surface of the vambrace, eating away at the thick metal protection.  These plates are short and curved, to fit the arms and to give some measure of defense to them.

name: a rusty pair of sabaton
longdesc: A pair of laminated plate armor for the feet lies here on the floor, slowly gathering a layer of rust.

extra_descriptions.description: An extremely ancient pair of sabaton, consisting of multiple laminated plates of steel. The plates have slowly begun to rust, as the exposed areas of armor are covered in a bright orange layer, while the jointed worn edges are still bright metal.  The ends of the sabaton end in a sharp point, covered by a hard metal cap to better aid in protection.

name: a rusty pair of gauntlets
longdesc: An old pair of steel gauntlets has been dropped on the ground, as a layer of rust starts to grow on them.

extra_descriptions.description: An old battle-torn pair of steel gauntlets have a light layer of rust growing on their thick metallic surface .  The jointed segments are still movable, despite their appearance.  They cover up to the forearms, working in conjunction with the pair of vambrace to help protect the arms and hands from damage.  There are faint markings or designs that are barely noticeable, despite the covering of rust, scratches, and nicks.

name: a rusty shield
longdesc: An old large shield lies forgotten on the ground, a layer of rust grows along its edges.

extra_descriptions.description: A thick steel shield from ages past, is slowly giving way to the ravages of time. A thick layer of crimson rust is scattered all along its surface, with spots of bright metal peeking through.

name: a rust-covered longsword
longdesc: An old plain longsword is covered in a few layers of decay and rust, as it lies here on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: An unadorned long sword made of steel is covered in a thick layer of rust, with many notches and nicks all along its length.   The hilt and pommel are plain, with a simple wire grip.

name: a rust-covered dagger
longdesc: An old unadorned dagger is covered in many layers of decay and rust, as it lies here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A simple dagger made of solid steel has been neglected for years, and is now covered in layers of red and black rust. The hilt is unadorned, except for a wire grip on the pommel. The blade still seems very sharp despite the passing of time.

name: a fragment of shadows
longdesc: A torn fragment of shadows lies here on the ground, between the borders of light and darkness.

extra_descriptions.description: A torn fragment of the essence of shadows, a piece of the border ethereal is here.  Somehow the border of light and darkness has coalesced and solidified into this fragment here.  It emanates a bone chilling cold, as the warmth of those who touch it fades away.

name: an ornate signet ring
longdesc: A lovely and decorated signet ring lies here on the ground, waiting to be worn.

extra_descriptions.description: This signet ring is a lovely silver band with golden filigree, with a tiny little rune of unknown origin in its center.  There are tiny little fragments of gemstones set in a circle around the rune, and the ring fairly hums with a quiet power.  The dweomers are ancient in origin, from a long forgotten era of the world.

name: a shiny gemstone bracelet
longdesc: A gemstone covered bracelet glitters on the ground, waiting to be worn.

extra_descriptions.description: A lovely silver bracelet studded with many various gemstones, fairly gleams in the faint light.  There is an intricate gold filigree and ivory inlays of various types of runes of some unknown origin.  Despite the age, the bracelet is in pristine condition, shining like a newborn sun.

name: a pair of battered overalls
longdesc: A pair of battered overalls lies on the ground, crumpled in a heap.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a battered yet well loved pair of dusty overalls that have seen many years of good use.  There are imbedded dirt and grass stains in the knees, and many patched areas all over the overalls.  It is made of a sturdy blue cloth, with intricate stitching, and many pockets placed all over to hold tools.

name: a very sharp gardening trowel
longdesc: An extremely sharp gardening trowel rests here in the ground, waiting to repot some dirt for plants.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a lovingly cared for and extremely sharp gardening trowel, which has been used by the caretaker for many decades of gardening.   It is made of an exceptional quality steel and has been religiously oiled and sharpened to prolong its life.

name: a neatly signed, enchanted guest book
longdesc: An enchanted book with neat signatures of long forgotten guests, lies here gathering dust.

extra_descriptions.description: A thick leather bound book with a gold embossed title in exquisite calligraphy, holds the signatures of all the guests that have arrived in times gone by.    The pages are yellowed and brittle, and the signatures have faded from a dark black ink to an eerie crimson color, akin to blood.  The names of guests line up with the names of the recently departed that they have come to visit over the years.

name: a heavily enchanted mace
longdesc: A war mace that is heavy in enchantments, glows here brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A bright mithril mace, heavy in enchantments, is covered in runes to the long forgotten gods. It glows brightly like the mid-day sun, and shines as if newly polished.  The head of the mace is made of pure mithril, cast with flanges in a star formation.  The haft of the mace is hardened steel, wrapped in leather.

name: a mint-smelling bottle of chemicals
longdesc: A thin bottle of chemicals that smells vaguely of mint, is about to be crushed on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A crystal bottle, containing an odd colored chemical, that is often used by the embalmer in his work.  This bottle smells vaguely of peppermint.

name: a sweet-smelling bottle of chemicals
longdesc: A thin bottle of chemicals that smells vaguely of sugarcane, is about to be crushed on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A crystal bottle, containing an odd colored chemical, that is often used by the embalmer in his work.  This bottle smells vaguely of sugarcane.

name: a foul-smelling bottle of chemicals
longdesc: A thin bottle of chemicals that smells vaguely of something rotten, is about to be crushed on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A crystal bottle, containing an odd colored chemical, that is often used by the embalmer in his work.  This bottle smells distinctly rotten.

name: a brimstone-smelling bottle of chemicals
longdesc: A thin bottle of chemicals that smells vaguely of brimstone, is about to be crushed on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A crystal bottle, containing an odd colored chemical, that is often used by the embalmer in his work.  This bottle smells vaguely of brimstone.

name: a sharp heavy rib splitter
longdesc: An extremely sharp cutting tool rests here in the ground, often used for an autopsy.

extra_descriptions.description: A heavy sharpened steel tool known as a rib splitter, is often used in autopsies or in embalming.  The splitter has been magically hardened and hums with the quiet resonance among the other devices in the room.   The splitter consists of two sharpened and jointed segments, used to cut through the chest cavity and separate the ribs to get to the organs underneath.

name: a glowing sphere of flame
longdesc: An enchanted sphere of flames glows brightly, scorching the ground near it.

extra_descriptions.description: A medium sphere composed of pure flames burns brightly, enchanted by long forgotten dweomers.  The flames crackle gently and unopposed, yet seem cool to the touch.

name: an enchanted chisel
longdesc: An enchanted woodworking chisel is covered in sawdust, as it lies here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: An ornate chisel has been enchanted long ago with magicks to harden and sharpen the steel blade.  The handle is wrapped in leather with a wire grip, to prevent slippage.

name: a mausoleum key
longdesc: A fancy brass key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This rather fancy brass key has a tatty old paper tag attached to it
that reads 'MAUSOLEUM'.

name: a fetid and diseased heart
longdesc: A disgusting looking heart has been left on the floor...  It's still beating :(

extra_descriptions.description: A medium sphere composed of pure flames burns brightly, enchanted by long forgotten dweomers.  The flames crackle gently and unopposed, yet seem cool to the touch.

name: a heavily enchanted mace
longdesc: A war mace that is heavy in enchantments, glows here brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A bright mithril mace, heavy in enchantments, is covered in runes to the long forgotten gods. It glows brightly like the mid-day sun, and shines as if newly polished.  The head of the mace is made of pure mithril, cast with flanges in a star formation.  The haft of the mace is hardened steel, wrapped in leather.

name: a diamond edged hatchet
longdesc: A brilliant hatchet with a diamond edged blade has been left here.

name: a lock from BreezeWalker's mane
longdesc: A small lock of golden horse hair floats about, never touching the ground

name: a black demonic ring
longdesc: A small ring is phasing between the physical world, and the demon plane

extra_descriptions.description: The ring has a black aura about it.

name: a tear shaped crystal
longdesc: A tear shaped multi facet crystal

name: An ice cold obsidian amulet
longdesc: A whisper thin piece of obsidian lies here....

name: a fine white silk robe
longdesc: A fine white silk robe lays here perfectly pressed.

name: a forging hammer
longdesc: A hammer used for forging high quality weapons has been set down here.

name: a worn and dented breast plate
longdesc: A breast plate that has survived many battles

name: archer's gloves
longdesc: A pair of leather archer's gloves

name: The Orb of Nuahlon
longdesc: The Orb of Nuahlon glows gently with a black light.

name: a pair of fine boots
longdesc: A pair of very fine boots has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots are made of fine polished leather that has been embossed
with magical runes.  They would look fabulous on any officer!

name: Frostfang
longdesc: An ice-white blade steams gently as it cools the air around it.

extra_descriptions.description:
This dagger looks very much like a cross between a dragon's incisor and an
icicle.  It is slick to the touch but surprisingly not cold, allowing it to
be held and wielded without freezing off the owners hand.

name: a heap of gold
longdesc: There is a heap of gold here.

name: a rich mans wallet
longdesc: A thick wallet weighed down with coins has been dropped here.

name: a town's treasury
longdesc: A town's treasury's worth of gold has been left here.

name: a king's ransom
longdesc: A king's ransom worth of gold has been accidentally dropped here.

name: a dragon's hoard
longdesc: A dragon's hoard has been left here.

name: Emberlight
longdesc: A burning gland has been discard here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This fiery glowing gland looks like it should be too hot to the touch 
for anyone to be able to hold.  Yet, it is quite cool and gives off a
perpetually bright orange glow, perfect for harnessing as a light 
source.

name: Voltang
longdesc: A very unique blue dragon scale shield has been carelessly dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Voltang is a rigid collection blue dragon scales that have been
fused together form a highly effective shield.  The scales on the
outside gleam from recent polishing and seem to hum as if they
contain some power of the original owner.

name: Shadowmane
longdesc: A black dragon wing has been left here... Maybe the dragon didn't need it?

extra_descriptions.description:
The leather of this wing is covered in pits and holes, burn scars
and divots.  An acrid, nasty smell clings to it, reminding you of
sulphur.  When wrapped about a wearer, the wing almost seems to
come alive, flaring out as if preparing to take flight.

name: Bilescourge
longdesc: A large ugly-looking venom sack taints the very floor where it lays.

extra_descriptions.description:
The leather of this wing is covered in pits and holes, burn scars
and divots.  An acrid, nasty smell clings to it, reminding you of
sulphur.  When wrapped about a wearer, the wing almost seems to
come alive, flaring out as if preparing to take flight.

name: a scary mask
longdesc: A distorted mask of countess floats here menacingly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mask is a perfect likeness of Countess rendered in stone.  
Her eyes sparkle with mischief as they wink.  Her lips seem to 
move as if forming the word...

"#{red}#{bold}BOO!#{o}"

name: a red demonic ring
longdesc: A small ring is phasing between the physical world, and the demon plane

extra_descriptions.description: The ring has a red aura about it.

longdesc: A small ring is phasing between the physical world, and the demon plane

extra_descriptions.description: The ring has a white aura about it.
