longdesc: A small ring is phasing between the physical world, and the demon plane

extra_descriptions.description: The ring has a blue aura about it.

name: a green demonic ring
longdesc: A small ring is phasing between the physical world, and the demon plane

extra_descriptions.description: The ring has a green aura about it.

name: a slice of chocolate cake
longdesc: A slice of chocolate cake has been left here.

name: a lemon danish
longdesc: A mouth watering lemon danish has been placed here.

name: a slice of cherry cobbler
longdesc: A slice of cherry cobbler on a shiny white plate has been left here.

name: a strawberry tart
longdesc: A well wrapped strawberry tart is here.

name: an orange glazed muffin
longdesc: A deliciously glazed orange muffin is here.

name: a dagger of mercy
longdesc: An ivory dagger with a long thin blade is here.

name: a sword of compassion
longdesc: A small ivory sword lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It says : Only the pure of heart may wield this weapon.
The small sword seems to have an inscription of some sort.

name: the claws of Mist
longdesc: A pair of claws rest here.

name: a Hammer of Justice
longdesc: A bright red hammer lies on the floor.

name: a pair of red enamelled steel greaves
longdesc: A pair of red enamelled steel greaves have been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These functional greaves have been coated in red enamel to make them look
really cool.  However, they have seen some wear and the chips, scratches
and occasional dent testify to the rigor's they have been subjected to.

name: a red enamelled steel spangenhelm
longdesc: A red enamelled steel spangenhelm is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spangenhelm has been formed from 6 interlocked steel plates on a
bronze frame.  The curves into a high point, perfect for deflecting
blows away from the head.  A nasal guard and a pair of cheek flaps
complete the plate steel whilst a short and plain, un-enamelled,
chainmail skirt hanging from the back offers some limited neck
protection. The plates have all been enamelled in red but wear and 
tear have left them covered in scratches, dents and chips.

name: A red leather cloak
longdesc: A red leather cloak is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This red leather cloak offers the wearer some limited protection and
a snug windbreak during those long nights on watch.  The leather has
been oiled and cared for and is supple to the touch.  Perfect for the
fashion conscious knight on the go.

name: A red enamelled steel hauberk
longdesc: A red enamelled steel hauberk is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hauberk has been formed from tiny interlocking loops of steel
that have been coated in red enamel.  The hauberk extends down to
mid-thigh and has long sleeves ending at the back of the hand.  It
looks awesome, but wow does it weigh some!  And all that enamel has
been chipped and scratched from the trials of being a warrior of
good.

name: A pair of red leather boots
longdesc: A pair of red leather boots are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Whilst sabatons would offer more protection, the knights of Thaumlore
are not cavalry, and leather boots, without those ridiculous tapered
toes, are much more functional, allowing for a keen grip and a warm
foot on those cold, frosty nights standing watch on the walls.  The
leather has been well maintained and oiled, and is supple and strong
to the touch.

name: A pair of red enamelled steel bracers
longdesc: A pair of red enamelled steel bracers are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These functional bracers have been coated in red enamel to make them look
really cool.  However, they have seen some wear and the chips, scratches
and occasional dent testify to the rigor's they have been subjected to.

name: A red leather belt
longdesc: A red leather belt is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt is designed to be to tied around the waist of a knight.
It is much longer than a standard belt, allowing it to be cinched
and then knotted.  Red enamelled steel plates have been fixed to
it in places giving it a military look.  The leather is soft and
strong, perfect for holding a scabbard, a purse or the severed
arm of your latest foe.

name: A pair of red enamelled steel gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of red enamelled steel gauntlets are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These rather ugly steel gauntlets consist of long wrist guards formed
from lobstered steel, allowing a bracer and hauberk sleeve to all
interconnect like some clever sod designed some functional armour.
The plates continue all the way to the knuckles and the bridge of the
thumb where more clever craftsmanship has allowed a pair of red
leather gloves to be fastened with small, yet strong, rivits.  All of
the steel has been coated in red enamel that looks pretty but has all
the function of a chocolate teapot, as all the chips and scratches
will testify to.

name: A white steel spangenhelm
longdesc: A white steel spangenhelm is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spangenhelm as been formed from 3 white interlocking plates of
white steel on a bronze frame.  The helm curves upwards in to a high
point, allowing blows to the top of the head to be deflected away
from the skull.  A pair of cheek flaps meet a full face covering
mask in the shape of a weeping angel.  So perfect is the sculpting
that you could almost believe it was really the face of the knight
behind it.  A curtain of fine white steel mail, attached to the
back of the helm, completes the look, making it seem like shining
white hair is flowing from the helm down to the knights shoulders.

name: A white leather cloak
longdesc: A white leather cloak is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This leather has been bleached and dyed over and over until all
colour has been drained from it, leaving just a bright, shining
white.  It has been well maintained, oiled and cared for.  The
top of the cloak contains a high collar of stiff leather whilst
the back is embossed with an intricate scene of a knight rising
up on the bodies of a multitude of demons.  How delightful...

name: A white steel breastplate
longdesc: A white steel breastplate has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This stunning breastplate has been formed from white steel.
The whiteness has been cunningly added to the forging process
so there is no messy and functionally useless enamelling
required.  Two sheets have been rounded and connected at the
centre of the chest to form a ridge, designed to deflect any
stabbing blows.  Whilst not so good at deflecting a slashing
attack, the armour will offer decent protection and will
make any knight look good.

name: A pair of white leather boots
longdesc: A pair of white leather boots are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots are made from soft and supple bleached leather.  If it
wasn't for the mud, these boots would sparkle.  Whilst they don't
offer the best of protection, they do allow the wearer to have a
sure grip on most surfaces.

name: A pair of white steel bracers
longdesc: A pair of white steel bracers are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These bracers have been designed with an articulated elbow piece
to allow the armour to fully cover the lower and upper arms to
the top of the bicep.  In principle, a shoulder-plate could be
attached but it seems to be missing.

name: A white leather belt
longdesc: A white leather belt is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a belt made from a strip of bleached leather.  It has been
reinforced with steel loops and handily has several pouches and
frogs hanging from it for ease of carrying around your daily needs.

name: A pair of white steel gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of white steel gauntlets are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Formed from thin sheets of lobstered steel over leather, these shiny
white steel gauntlets fit like a glove!  (Pun intended).

name: A pair of white steel greaves
longdesc: A pair of white steel greaves are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These greaves have been made by attaching 2 rounded plates via a
hinge and hook mechanism, giving protection for the shins and the
calves, unusual in design, they offer very good protection, if not
manoeuvrability.

name: The Landing Stone
longdesc: An orb of transportation "The Landing Stone" is here, waiting to be touched.

extra_descriptions.description:
This stone has been built in to the very fabric of the tower, there would
be no way to lift it and take it.  It sits on a pedestal around four feet
above the ground and glows with an eerie green light.  If you stare in to
it's depths you can make out the Central Plaza of Thaumlore Fortress...
Maybe your destination if you were to #{bold}touch orb#{o}?

name: a statue of Mount Celestia
longdesc: An amazing statue of a mountain, rising from a pristine sea, is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mountain is perfect in every way. As you draw closer you can make out the
finest of details: small clouds, streams, snow flakes freshly settled. The
whole thing is breath taking. It makes you want to touch it!

name: A rune-engraved cylinder
longdesc: An engraved stone cylinder stands here on a pedestal.

extra_descriptions.description: This cylinder has been carved with runes that glow a deep green.

name: A rune-engraved cylinder
longdesc: An engraved stone cylinder stands here on a pedestal.

extra_descriptions.description: This cylinder has been carved with runes that glow a deep red.

name: the Ancient Staff of Celestial Power
longdesc: A rune-engraved wooden staff, with a large crystal embedded at one end, rests here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This staff is roughly seven feet in length and made of a smooth, highly
polished wood that is almost white in colour.  Glowing blue runes have
been engraved in a swirling pattern from top to bottom.  At the top, a
bright cyan-coloured crystal pulses with power.  This is indeed a very
powerful artefact.

name: A Celestial Medal of Valour
longdesc: A bright golden medal has been left here

extra_descriptions.description:
This Medal of Celestial Valor appears to be rather cheap and useless.  Yet,
as you peer at it letters form on it's surface, one after the other, glowing
a bright red, like a summer sunset, repeating in a never ending loop...

#{YELLOW}- #{red}#{bold}T#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}O#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}U#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}C#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}H#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}M#{o}#{YELLOW} - #{red}#{bold}E#{o}#{YELLOW} -

name: the Skirt of Valor
longdesc: A fine silver skirt is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pleated mithril skirt has been inscribed with power runes of warding
and heroism, protecting the wearer and granting great courage in the face
of insurmountable odds.

name: the Crown of Valor
longdesc: A crowned silvery mithril helm is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This crown has been formed from a single ring of highly polished mithril
that has been cut and shaped so that it provides protection and grants
the wearer an authoritative demeanour.  The metal has been further
embossed with power runes that convey a sense of courage and stalwart
determination.

name: the Breastplate of Valor
longdesc: A shining silvery mithril breastplate is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This breastplate fits like a glove.  No matter your body type, this piece
of handsome armour is guaranteed to make you look like a shining example
of knighthood.  The edges have all been engraved with glowing runes of
power that instill and sense of courage and righteousness.

name: the Boots of Valor
longdesc: A pair of shining silvery mithril boots are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots are actually made of interlocking mithril plates over a soft
and supple leather that protect the feet and yet still feel like you're
wearing a pair of leather boots that a thief-in-the-night would love to
own.

name: the Paudrons of Valor
longdesc: A pair of shining silvery mithril paudrons are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These shining, beautiful paudrons make your shoulders look like they could bear
the weight of the world.  With these on, nothing can stop you.  The metal has
been engraved with power runes, giving you that feeling that no burning building,
no rampaging elephant, no fiery pit can stop you.

name: the Belt of Valor
longdesc: A shining silvery mithril belt is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt is a circle of interlocking rings of mithril.  And it looks
bloody good.

name: the Gauntlets of Valor
longdesc: A pair of shining silvery mithril gauntlets are lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The mithril of these gauntlets has been lobstered from the tip of the
finger to the middle of the forearm, creating a flexible, yet fully
armoured gauntlet that you can wear in battle or down the pub to
impress your friends.

name: a smokey torch
longdesc: A smokey grease-burning torch is mounted to the wall.
action: The torch crackles and spits as it burns.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a reward token
longdesc: A shiny reward token has been left here, begging to be touched.

name: a tiny pair of wings
longdesc: A tiny, golden set of wings has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a tiny pair of wings that can fit in to the palm of your hands.  It
is not much use beyond being a nice little trinket to display on your mantel
piece and #{bold}touch#{o} when the fancy takes you.

name: Wings of Dawn
longdesc: A pair of white-gold angelic wings is here, floating in the air.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Wings of Dawn were gifted to Ramial by the Goddess Amaterasu
as a reward for the angelic aid during the Dawn War with the forces
of Chaos. Following the war Amaterasu ascended to Mount Celestia
where she watches her angels from the cloudy slopes.  So white as
to be almost golden in colour, the feathers are soft as silk and
yet as strong as steel.  There is no bloody stump from where these
were removed, instead they seem to want to grip on to their owner,
effortlessly and painlessly.

name: a sludge-green potion
longdesc: A disgusting looking potion of snotty green slude has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This potion is likely to make you vomit.  Don't quaff it!

name: a metallic grey potion
longdesc: A lumpy looking metallic potion has been left here.  Yuck!

extra_descriptions.description: This potion is likely to make you vomit.  Don't quaff it!

name: The Black Blade of Disaster
longdesc: A large broadsword with an eerie-black blade has been stuck in to the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a truly evil sword, you can tell by the way your mind screams at you
to throw it away as soon as you hold it.  The blade itself is made of a metal
substance much akin to mithril, yet it absorbs all the light, making it so
dark that its hard to make out the surface without using your fingers to feel
for lumps and grooves.  The hilt, handle and pommel all form together in to a
monstrous visage of twisting demonic faces, all laughing at you.  Yet, the
power that courses through it could render you one of the most powerful beings
in the universe.  This sword would be the dream of any avenger.

name: a hatch key
longdesc: A strange lump of black muddy, decaying organic matter is lying on the ground.

name: a shining longsword
longdesc: A beautiful, shining longsword has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This longsword has been forged from fine mithril, allowing it to be
wielded by those with magical gifts.  Although those without can use
it too...

name: a bottle of dwarven fire-ale
longdesc: A bottle with a bright yellow liquid lies here.

name: a potion of infernal majesty
longdesc: An evil looking potion smokes and sparks here.

name: A glossy bloody bracelet
longdesc: A glossy bracelet with a bloody color lies here.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: drop of celestial blood
longdesc: A gooey drop of blood is on the ground.

name: the Hound Archons' head
longdesc: The ghoulish remains of the Hound Archons' head are here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This grisly visage is actually a well made helmet formed from leathers and
furs ranging in colour from rust red to blood red.  It fits neatly over the
head, allowing your eyes to peet out from the hounds eyes.

name: the Archons' Lantern
longdesc: A bright and shining lantern has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pretty lantern seems to be made of a very sturdy brass and glass mix
that gives the light that shines forth a warmth and hospitality that you
wouldn't normally associate with something to light dingy corridors.

name: the Archons' Trumpet
longdesc: A lovely looking trumpet has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Parp!  Parp Paaaaarp Parp!  Yes, that is the sound a trumpet makes.  Yes it does.
Don't make me slay you.

name: the Archons' Sword
longdesc: A powerful-looking sword has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword is a magnificent feat of engineering, with blade, guard, pommel
and handle all formed from the same piece of flexible, yet strong, mithril
and steel mix.  Only the supple white leather of the handle is different.

name: a band of angelic heroism
longdesc: A band sparkles in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band has been formed from interlocking feathers from an angels
wings and fits neatly about the wrist.

name: a band of angelic purity
longdesc: A band sparkles in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band has been formed from interlocking feathers from an angels
wings and fits neatly about the wrist.

name: a Flaming Key
longdesc: A flaming key, in the shape of a feather, lies here forgotten.

extra_descriptions.description:
This key glows with a reddish-yellow light, as if burning with an
intense heat - yet it is cool to the touch.  The prongs and forks have
been shaped in such a way that the overall effect looks like a fiery
feather.  How pretty.

name: the Key to Tower Five
longdesc: A key, in the shape of a tower stamped with the number '5' has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This steel key is shiny, polished and well looked after.  It seems as
if it will open a certain hatch to something called 'tower five'.  Whatever
that is.  There is a small inscription at the very base, so tiny it takes
holding the key up in the light, as close to your eye as you can get, to
read it:

'Those who can, walk on air.'

name: a Key of Dwarfish Origin
longdesc: A key of obvious Dwarfish origin is here, gathering dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This key looks like it has never been used.  Some Dwarfish runes seem
to indicate that it will fit in to a door at a heavily warded archway.
*shrug* Who knows?  It is probably junk.

name: a Fortrum Cell Key
longdesc: A key to a cell in Fortrum lies here... Wait... What cell??

extra_descriptions.description:
This key is made of mithril and appears to open a cell door somewhere
inside Fortrum.  I don't remember Fortrum have a cell block???

name: a pitch-black longsword that flames brightly...
longdesc: A pitch-black longsword flames brightly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword has a very definitive look of evil about it.  The blade is
pitch-black and burns brightly with a cold blue flame.  The handle is
made of some sort of ivory that has been carved in to the likeness of
hundreds of leering demonic faces.  A strange thing to find in a home
of law.

name: Wings of Fiery Feathers
longdesc: A pair brightly burning wings float here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pair of wings looks to have come straight from a mighty celestial
angel (without the bloody stumps where they have been cut off of).
Each wing is blackened, feathers dripping ash as flames dance across
them ferociously.  The stumps are clean and seem to be covered in a
velvet-like cloth that would make attaching them to your shoulders or
back quite the comfortable experience.  There is no doubt you would 
look fly in them.

name: fetters of imprisonment
longdesc: A pair of thick iron fetters have been dropped here.  They sparkle mysteriously.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thick iron fetter has been made to contain the powerful Elven prince
Nuahlon.  They look very powerful!

name: manacles of imprisonment
longdesc: A set of very heavy manacles have been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thick iron manacles has been made to contain the powerful Elven prince
Nuahlon.  They look very powerful!

name: an old Battledress
longdesc: An old moth-eaten battledress has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This old and rather tatty dress has been made for battle with lots of splits
for ease of movement.  It would also look quite comfortable were it not for
the myriad of holes and tears in it.

name: an old Battlerobe
longdesc: An old moth-eaten battlerobe has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This old and rather tatty robe has been made for battle with lots of splits
for ease of movement.  It would also look quite comfortable were it not for
the myriad of holes and tears in it.

name: Ring of Angelic Might
longdesc: A brightly glowing rings glows here.  Funny that.

extra_descriptions.description:
One of the famed rings of Prince Nuahlon, this delightfully glowing
band of pure mithril has seen battle with the Dwarfs of Fortrum.  It
was thought lost when Nuahlon was defeated by Fortrus, the High King
of the Dwarfs.

name: Ring of the Angelic Devastator
longdesc: A ring of red-glowing power lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from an unknown material and imbued with the life-essence of Prince
Nuahlon himself, this ring has all the potential to level mountains.  Be
careful with it, for it is quite unique.

name: Light of the Angelic Avenger
longdesc: A burning gland has been discard here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This light source looks like a halo of brightly glowing mithril.  And that
is exactly what it is!  Well done you!

name: Wings of the Fallen Angel
longdesc: A pair of red-tinged angelic wings is here, floating in the air.

extra_descriptions.description:
These wings are made up of white feathers that appear to have been
dipped in blood at the tips.  They drip continuously all over the
floor in a slow, but never-ending, flow of life.  They appear to be
organic in origin, possibly ripped from an angel that fell from its
place in the heavens.

name: Protector of the Angelic Avenger
longdesc: A full body-set protector has been left here to rust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This full body-covering armour has been forged from overlapping plates
of glowing mithril.  Each plate has been delicately inscribed with tiny
runes of power for countering spells and enhancing the wearer.  This is
probably something you want to store in a museum, not on your odorous
self.

name: Belt of Woven Angel Feathers
longdesc: A belt made woven angel feathers glitters happily here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has been expertly made from the moulted wing feathers of an
angel.  Each feather has been woven in to the next and then overlapped
and accentuated with mithril filigree and fasteners.

name: Argus
longdesc: The mighty shield Argus is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is Argus, the Shield of Fortrus.  It was made to battle the elves
in the great wars, countering magic and bolstering the power of the
Dwarfs.

name: a black halberd
longdesc: A broad-bladed halberd with a long black haft has been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This halberd is masterfully made, the blade fitted flawlessly 
into the haft and as keen as any sword.  Along the blade a 
series of pretty flames have been engraved along with the
number 3.

name: a gigantic stone club
longdesc: A huge stone club has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This massive club has been formed somehow out of a single piece of stone.
Its balance and heft are perfect, although its size is intimidating.

name: a huge stone breastplate
longdesc: A breastplate seemingly formed from stone lays on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This extremely heavy breastplate has somehow been formed, joints and all,
from gray stone.

name: a pair of spiked iron sleeves
longdesc: A pair of sleeves, formed from thick iron with protruding spikes, lay here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These thick sleeves are obviously intended for one of impressive physical
stature; they're far too heavy for a typical man to wear.

name: a shimmering white bracelet
longdesc: A white bracelet shimmers on the ground, here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bracelet glows with an inner light that seems to wash over whomever
holds it.

name: a wide black hammer
longdesc: This wide-headed black hammer has been coldforged from iron.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hammer is chill to the touch, and has been coldforged by a powerful
hand without need of a furnace.

name: an expertly made silver hammer
longdesc: This beautiful hammer is forged from silver, though for function over decorative value.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hammer is beautiful, but its primary purpose remains clear.  There
is no ornamentation, simply the work of a master smith.

name: a burnt and blackened warhammer
longdesc: A massive warhammer, blackened and burnt, lays upon the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This warhammer is a piece of masterwork, although the scorch marks upon
its head help to conceal that fact.

name: a finely wrought sabre
longdesc: A fine sabre wrought of steel lays glimmering on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sabre has been impressively forged; light wavers and glimmers with
the folds of the steel, and the edge is razor-sharp.

name: an amber pendant
longdesc: An amber pendant dangles upon a silver chain, here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Amber often contains impurities such as trapped flies or droplets of
blood; the impurity in this piece cannot be easily seen, but seems to
be moving.

name: a wolfskin cloak
longdesc: A cloak woven from massive wolfskins sits here, growing dusty.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak is formed of various giant wolf pelts, stitched together
expertly.  Mystic runes appear upon the lining.

name: a wolfskin headdress
longdesc: A headdress of carefully stitched wolfskins is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This headdress is formed of wolfskin intertwined with lengths of cloth
bearing mystical runes.

name: a heavy iron battleaxe
longdesc: An extremely large iron battle axe lays here menacingly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This huge axe has a blade that must weigh at least three thousand decim.
Its haft is iron, as well, and it must be capable of striking with
considerable force.

name: a thick iron belt
longdesc: A thick belt of iron gathers dust, here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thick belt is forged from interlocking plates of solid iron.  It
weights a tremendous amount, but likely offers excellent protection.

name: a spiked iron shield
longdesc: A heavy shield of spiked iron, blood still fresh upon it, lays here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This huge shield has protruding spikes across its face, with blood both
old and new crusted and dripping from them.

name: an ashen javelin
longdesc: A javelin of ashen wood sits here, emitting a humming noise.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ashen javelin is carved with mystical runes, and emits a humming
noise.  The point is exceedingly sharp.

name: a cloak of dancing colours
longdesc: A beautiful cloak of shifting colours has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak has somehow been woven of pulled strands of gemstone. It is
exceptionally beautiful.

name: a thin black scimitar
longdesc: A thin-bladed black scimitar lays here, shimmering.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thin black scimitar has a blade that seems to shift as shadows
caress it.

name: a black-bladed bastard sword
longdesc: A huge bastard sword with a blade black as night lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This massive sword has a broad hilt engraved with runes that are somehow
darker than the inky blackness of the blades themselves.

name: a smouldering ring
longdesc: An iron ring lies here, smouldering and smoking.

extra_descriptions.description:
This small band of black iron smoulders and smokes as though fresh from
the forge. It is inscripted with tiny runes.

name: a small doll
longdesc: A small doll, trampled in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This small doll is traditionally made for Iy-Tarigan shamen and priests.
It is a slightly grotesque representation of a humanoid creature.

name: a coyoteskin headdress
longdesc: A coyote skin headdress lays here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This headdress has been woven from the skin and fur of a coyote. Mystic
runes are visible where the fur parts.

name: a pair of flaming black boots
longdesc: A pair of black iron boots lie on the ground, shrouded in flame.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged of black iron, these boots bear intricate runes in the form of
shrouding flames.

name: a heavy chainmail cloak
longdesc: A heavy cloak of chainmail lies in a bundle.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak is made of interlocking rings of steel, and seems very
sturdy.

name: an elfskin cloak
longdesc: A cloak tanned from elf flesh lays here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak has been tanned from the skin of an elf.  From the looks of
it, the elf who provided the raw materials was heavily tattooed with
mystical runes before the process.

name: a tarigan totem
longdesc: A small totem lays on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This small totem features an oversized, tusked head atop of a thin body.
The face depicted is grinning mischieviously.

name: a mystical ceremonial skirt
longdesc:
A ceremonial leather skirt, covered in mystic patterns, lays upon the
ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This black leather skirt is imprinted with indigo symbols that shift
and warp as the wearer moves about.

name: a glowing shard of crystal
longdesc: A glowing shard of crystal spins about in mid-air.

extra_descriptions.description: This shard of crystal glows brilliantly and hovers of its own volition.

name: a cloak of shadow and flame
longdesc: A cloak somehow formed from shadows and flames lays here, burning brightly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak is somehow formed from solidified shadow and flame. It is
cool to the touch, and molds itself to the wearer perfectly.

name: a blood-encrusted trident
longdesc: A bloody trident lays in a pool upon the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Blood covers the three prongs of this trident, and drips down the haft
constantly, even in absence of a wound to freshen it.

name: a glowing white handaxe
longdesc: A shining white handaxe stands mighty upon the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This handaxe emanates a light so brilliant that it is nearly blinding.
Though the details of the weapon can't be made out, it hefts with a
superior balance and the blade is amazingly sharp.

name: a razor-sharp shard of crystal
longdesc: A razor sharp shard of crystal glimmers brilliantly, here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This razor sharp crystal shard is about the length of a shortsword.
The barbs of crystal protruding from the blade seem capable of tearing
into flesh with ease.

name: a barbed flail
longdesc:
A barbed ball of iron connected to a rod by a length of chain lays
here, bloodied.

extra_descriptions.description:
The head of this flail is wicked; hooked barbs extend from it.  The
chain has been forged perfectly, the links exceptionally flexible and
strong.

name: a white-fringed green cape
longdesc: A green cape fringed in white lies in a crumpled heap.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cape is beautiful, the main of it being a deep and shimmering
green, and a white fringe curling around it.

name: a spiked iron breastplate
longdesc:
A massive iron breastplate covered in protruding spikes is here,
coated in blood.

extra_descriptions.keywords: spiked iron breastplate breast plate massive
extra_descriptions.description:
This thick breastplate is coated in spikes of iron.  It's exceptionally
heavy.

name: a spiked iron belt
longdesc: A thick iron belt, covered in spikes, gathers dust on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: This spiked iron belt is very thick and heavy.

name: a pair of spiked iron gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of iron gauntlets, covered in spikes, has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description: These gauntlets are forged from black iron and covered in vicious spikes.

name: an obsidian handaxe
longdesc: A handaxe of chipped obsidian gleams darkly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This handaxe has been formed from carefully chipped obsidian. The blade
is sharper than a razor.

name: a thin iron circlet
longdesc: A circlet of blackened iron lays on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: This iron circlet is thin, but remains very heavy.

name: a jeweled longsword
longdesc: A longsword with a jewel-encrusted hilt has foolishly been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This longsword is made of the finest steel, and has multiple, cut
gemstones planted into its hilt.

name: a jeweled belt
longdesc: A belt inset with glittering jewels bound with strands of gold sparkles in the light.

extra_descriptions.description:
Thick strands of gold weave in and out of fantastic gemstones in this
finely formed belt. A faint blue glow eminates from it.

name: a black iron spear
longdesc: A spear forged from a single length of black iron lays heavy on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spear has been forged from a single length of black iron.  The
barbed tip is exceedingly sharp, and a faint humming noise is emitted
by it.

name: a thin black spear
longdesc:
A long shaft of charred wood mounted with an iron spearhead lays
here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spear consists of an iron spearhead mounted atop a long shaft of
black wood.

name: a set of elf scalps
longdesc:
A set of elf scalps looped around a twisted leather belt lay upon the
ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
A dozen elf scalps dangle from a twisted leather belt, still bloodied
from their originators.

name: a blue-fringed black cape
longdesc: A black cape fringed in royal blue lies in a crumpled heap.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cape of inky black is fringed in royal blue, and glows with a
magical light.

name: a glowing white halberd
longdesc: A shining white halberd stands mighty upon the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This halberd emanates a light so brilliant that it is nearly blinding.
Though the details of the weapon can't be made out, it hefts with a
superior balance and the blade is amazingly sharp.

name: a basement key
longdesc: A key to the basement of the ork shrine.

extra_descriptions.description: This key will open the basement 25 times.

name: Battle-Marred tempered vambraces
longdesc: The best work of the Orc Blacksmith, specifically made for the king. These are far more intricate and of better material than what the other orcs are wearing.

name: Finely polished spiked wristguard
longdesc: A multicolored bracer forged of muliple types of metals for maximum strength, and then enchanted by the shaman by order of the king.

name: Orkbane Breastplate
longdesc: a very heavy Orkbane breastplate lies here in the dirt.

name: Orkbane Threads
longdesc: A set of very heavy Orkbane threads has been lost here.

name: Orkbane Leg Guards
longdesc: A set of very heavy Orkbane leg guards have been abandoned here.

name: Balmek's black heart
longdesc: A black and vile heart has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{black}Balmek's black heart skips a beat....#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the heart of Balmek.  It is black and vile and oozes something
that smells like a cross between a hobo's gusset and boiled cat urine.
Enjoy!

name: the crystal pillar for travel to the nexus
longdesc: A white marble pillar with a warmly glowing crystal on top stands here.

name: the crystal pillar for travel from the Nexus
longdesc: A white marble pillar with a warmly glowing crystal on top stands here.

name: a bulletin board
longdesc: The Nexus noticeboard is floating serenely in the air, unsupported.

extra_descriptions.description:
Use "Look AT board" to see a listing of the messages. Use "Read
<message number>" or "Remove <message number>" to read or remove
  a message, respectively. Use Write <header> to write a message.

name: a bulletin board
longdesc: The Nexus Board of Laws is floating serenely in the air.

extra_descriptions.description:
Use "Look AT board" to see a listing of the messages. Use "Read
<message number>" or "Remove <message number>" to read or remove
  a message, respectively. Use Write <header> to write a message.

name: a bubble of water
longdesc: A large bubble of water floats around the room, wobbling in the air.

extra_descriptions.description:
The bubble of water seems to have no support nor
source for in-flowing water...

name: A light-absorbing black Crystal of Decision
longdesc: A deep-black crystal stands on a pillar with the word CLASSIC beneath.

name: A light-absorbing black Crystal of Decision
longdesc: A deep-black crystal stands on a pillar with the word CHAOS beneath.

name: A light-absorbing black Crystal of Decision
longdesc: A deep-black crystal stands on a pillar with the word REALPLAY beneath.

name: A wall full of dark Crystals
longdesc: A large cabinet of soul crystals stands behind the black crystals.

name: the glowing green crystal
longdesc: A glowing green crystal lies suspended in the air in front of you.

name: the glowing red crystal
longdesc: A glowing red crystal lies suspended in the air in front of you.

name: the glowing light blue crystal
longdesc: A light blue crystal lies suspended in the air in front of you.

name: the glowing dark blue crystal
longdesc: A dark blue crystal lies suspended in the air in front of you.

name: a devil mask
longdesc: A devil mask has been thrown to the ground.

name: a ghoul mask
longdesc: A ghoul mask has been left on the ground.

name: an zombie mask
longdesc: An zombie mask has been trampled into the ground.

name: a wraith mask
longdesc: An wraith mask has been left on here.

name: a mummy mask
longdesc: A mummy mask has been thrown to the floor.

name: a werewolf mask
longdesc: A werewolf mask has been left on the ground.

name: a frankenstein's monster mask
longdesc: A frankenstein's monster mask has been trampled into the ground.

name: a vampire mask
longdesc: A vampire mask has been left here.

name: a creature from the black lagoon mask
longdesc: A creature from the black lagoon mask has been left on the ground.

name: a ghost mask
longdesc: A ghost mask has been left on the ground.

name: a scarecrow mask
longdesc: A scarecrow mask has been trampled into the ground.

name: a skexie mask
longdesc: A skexie mask has been left on here.

name: a gelfling mask
longdesc: A gelfling mask has been thrown to the floor.

name: a princess mask
longdesc: A princess mask has been left on the ground.

name: a package of Chuckles (TM)
longdesc: A package of Chuckles (TM) has been left on the ground.

name: a Snicker's (TM) bar
longdesc: A Snicker's (TM) bar is lying here.

name: a Mr. Goodbar (TM) bar
longdesc: A Mr. Goodbar (TM) bar has been dropped on the ground.

name: a Milky Way (TM) bar
longdesc: A Milky Way (TM) bar is laying on the floor.

name: a package of Reese's Pieces (TM)
longdesc: A package of Riece's Pieces (TM) has been left on the ground.

name: a Kit Kat (TM) bar #{o}#{cyan}[full heal]#{o}
longdesc: A Kit Kat (TM) bar is laying on the floor.

name: a Chunky (TM) bar
longdesc: A chunky (TM) bar is laying on the floor.

name: a 1000 Grand (TM) bar
longdesc: A 1000 grand (TM) bar has been left on the ground.

name: a Clark (TM) bar
longdesc: A Clark (TM) bar is lying here.

name: a package of M&Ms (TM)
longdesc: A package of M&Ms (TM) has been left on the ground.

name: a package of peanut M&Ms (TM)
longdesc: A package of peanut M&Ms (TM) is lying on the ground.

name: a package of Hot Tamales (TM)
longdesc: A package of Hot Tamales (TM) is here.

name: a Mound's (TM) bar
longdesc: A Mound's (TM) bar is lying here.

name: an Almond Joy (TM) bar
longdesc: An Almond Joy (TM) bar is lying here.

name: a shining, yellow key
longdesc: A shining, yellow key is sticking out of the ground.

name: a thorny, green key
longdesc: A thorny, green key is sticking out of the ground.

name: a translucent key
longdesc: You can barely see a translucent key sticking in the ground.

name: a dirty, black key
longdesc: A dirty, black key is sticking out of the ground.

name: some neck bolts
longdesc: Some thick machine bolts have been left on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: Some thick machine bolts seem to spark with electricity.

name: the pumpkin scepter
longdesc: An orange scepter with a glowing pumpkin at the top is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The scepter has a brownish orange color and is mostly glass.
A small glass, glowing pumpkin sits at the top of the staff.

name: a pumpkin pie
longdesc: A sweet and spicy smelling pie has been left on the ground.

name: a slice of pumpkin pie
longdesc: A sweet and spicy smelling piece of pie has been left on the ground.

name: an orange pumpkin
longdesc: An orange pumpkin grows out of the ground.

name: an odd tree branch
longdesc: An odd tree branch sticks out inconspicuously.

extra_descriptions.description:
You barely notice an odd tree branch sticking out from
the tree.  It is as if one second it is there, then the next it is gone.
When it does appear, it looks rather worn, as if it has been touched
many times over the years.

name: A cloak of Deth
longdesc: You see something bloody uder the rubbage here.

extra_descriptions.description: desc would you like it with a side of mortalizer?

name: A hell spawns breast plate
longdesc: A burnt looking silver breast plate lies in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description: A breast plate from one of hell's most dangerous minions.

name: A straight jacket
longdesc: You see a white jacket with heavy restraints almost hidden in the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description: This jacket makes you wonder what kind of mad man they could have been locked away in it.

name: A glowing black cape
longdesc: A black cape with a strange glow is here capturing you attention.

extra_descriptions.description: You feel as if the glow upon this cape is beckoning you to it.

name: blood smeared hocky mask
longdesc: blood smeared hockey mask

extra_descriptions.description: This mask freightens you as you feel the still sticky blood on it.

name: A thick interwoven wire wrist restraint
longdesc: Some thick woven wire is sticking out of the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description: This restraint looks strong enough to hold even the strongest giant in the realms.

name: A set of devil horns
longdesc: The horns broken from the skull of a devil have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: As you pick ur these pulsating horns you feel them binding to you

name: A spiked ring of chaos
longdesc: You see a wicked spiked ring half buried in the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: This ring burns with hate and chaos.

name: A set of dismanteled jeweled leg plates
longdesc: A twisted set of leg plates have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: As you look upon these dismanteled leg plates you can only imagine how impressive they were before the horrific battle they must have been through.

name: A ripped blood drinched trench coat
longdesc: You see a long bloody coat laying on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: You see nothing special.

name: A wicked red silk hood
longdesc: A pile of red silk has been left on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: You sense a strange aura from this beautifully designed silk hood.

name: A pair of translucent flaming gloves
longdesc: You see a set of flames formed in the shape of gloves here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: If it were not for the flames you would have never seen these truely amazing magical gloves.

name: A faintly glowing thick green belt
longdesc: You see a faint green glow emitting from beath the dirt here.

extra_descriptions.description: This belt is glowing with a powerful green aura.

name: A bloody gore knife
longdesc: You see a bloody knife made for killing laying on the ground here.

name: A silver crossbow
longdesc: You see a finely crafted silver crossbow leaning against the wall here.

name: A sharpened spike
longdesc: You see a fierce looking spike sticking out of the ground here.

name: A giant femur bone
longdesc: A giant bone has been left laying on the ground here.

name: A razor tipped rapier
longdesc: One of the sharpest rapiers you have ever seen has been carelessly left leaning against the wall here.

name: The soul binder
longdesc: A blade imbued with lost souls has been dropped here.

name: Apollos' Toga
longdesc: A pristine white toga has been folded up neatly and left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made of lightweight, pristine white cotton, this toga barely covers
you.  It might be great for keeping you cool in the hot summer?

name: Silver Laurels
longdesc: A set of beautiful silver laurels gathers dust in a corner.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wreath of silver-filigree leaves has been designed to sit upon
your head and hold your hair back from your eyes, allowing you to
glare at the world no matter how much the wind is blowing.

name: the Epirus Bow
longdesc: The powerful Epirus Bow has been propped against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a silvery bow made of pale, ghostly birchwood.  It has been
formed with a straight central handle and identical upper and lower
limbs that curve forward from the handle and then backwards at the
recurve creating an elongated 'S' shape.  The bowstring has been
attached via notches a few inches away from the tips, allowing for
beautiful looks with no lack of performance.

name: Artemis' Sandals
longdesc: A pair of pretty green sandals lies forgotten on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
These pretty green silk sandals belonged to Artemis.  They have delicate
little flowers embroidered on them.  They are very comfortable, but are
probably not the right footwear to be wearing when tracking through bush
and field.

name: Leto's Laced Slippers
longdesc: A pair of comfortable and practical laced slippers have been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These slippers are made of a leather sole, instep cover and heel.  Long
laces of the same leather allow the slippers to be secured to the foot
by wrapping the laces around the ankle and calf, allowing them to be
comfortably tied off.  The toes are left uncovered for some reason.

name: a Silver Filigree Hairnet
longdesc: A pretty hairnet of silver filigree has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{cyan bold}The Silver Filigree Hairnet glows with a bright light momentarily.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This hairnet is a mesh of very fine silver filigree.  It sits on the
head and keeps your flowing locks in place whilst you're running
around doing things that would otherwise mess up your fine barnet.

name: Zeus' Thunderbolt
longdesc: A glowing, crackling thunderbolt of pure lightning has been accidently dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a length of crackling energy.  It glows white and yellow.
You feel like you can hit people with it and have a lot of fun
watching the fall out.

name: a Horrible Green Robe
longdesc: A horrible green robe has dropped here.  It should probably be destroyed!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a horrible silk robe in a ghastly green colour that puts
you in mind of boogers and vomit.  It is stained and smells like
rotting cabbage.  I'd burn it if I was you.

name: the Staff of Ariadne
longdesc: A long staff has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{magenta}The staff of Ariadne writhes like a snake for a moment!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This staff is made of blackened and burnt oak.  Bright cyan runes glow
in a snaking pattern around the weapon, from base to tip.  You can 
almost read them... Here the evil wraith Vulcan is imprisoned, and 
never shall it be released for his will be a plague upon this world...
Odd.  It seems that this staff is host to an ancient wraith by the name
of Vulcan.  Probably not a good idea to break it and release the wraith.

name: a set of golden links
longdesc: A set of golden links has been left here for anyone with sticky fingers to run off with.

extra_descriptions.description:
Each link in this set has been perfectly forged to represent a rune of
power.  The gold has been beaten wafer thin and hardly weighs anything,
yet you can feel the magic flowing in to you at the lightest touch.

name: Apollo's Manly Beauty
longdesc: A charm representing Apollo's Manly Beauty has been discarded here.
item_ability_msg: #{green}Apollo's Manly Beauty looks ugly for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is a small figurine carved from... Yuck... Is that flesh?!  Eww!

name: Leto's Nippy Minnow
longdesc: A bright and daring little minnow has been left out of water here.
item_ability_msg: #{cyan}Apollo's Manly Beauty looks ugly for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is a small and very pretty silvery minnow.  It looks fast!

name: Zeus' Powerful Bull
longdesc: A powerful-looking carving of a bull has been placed here.
item_ability_msg: #{yellow bold}Zeus' Powerful Bull looks hard as diamond briefly.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is a gorgeous carving of a bull in all its majestic power and beauty.

name: Artemis' She-Bear
longdesc: A roaring and defiant figurine of a she-bear is here.
item_ability_msg: #{yellow bold}Artemis' She-Bear figurine transforms in to a human momentarily.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pretty figurine of a she-bear standing majestic and proud on her hind legs
and roaring in defiance at the world.

name: the Domus Key
longdesc: A small key to a domus has been dropped here

extra_descriptions.description: This small key appears to open the door to a domus.

name: a slender wooden key
longdesc: A wooden key has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This key has been carved from oak into a funky spiral shape that
looks like it will break after just a few uses...

name: a hardened oak key
longdesc: An amazingly well made oak key has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This key has been made from aged oak and hardened with fire and
varnish making it much less likely to break immediately.

name: an Elven Cirma
longdesc: a long, silver Cirma knife is here, waiting for you to steal it.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Cirma is an elven knife formed from a single slither of dark red
oak and used exclusively for fighting.  It is around 12 inches long
and curves inward from the mid-point of the blade up to a needle-point
tip.  It has been perfectly balanced, with a knot of rough wood forming
a cross-hilt above a soft leather-wrapped grip.  Cirma are said to be
excellent stabbing weapons...  You'd never have guessed.

name: a green silk cloak
longdesc:
A beautifully well crafted green silk cloak lies on the
floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
The cloak is beautiful.  You can tell it would be excellent
camouflage in the forest.

name: A pair of green silk pants
longdesc: A pair of green pants lie here, shimmering in the light.

extra_descriptions.description:
The green silk pants let off a green glow as you examine
them, while they shimmer in the sunlight.

name: a green silk jacket
longdesc: A beautiful jacket lies in a pile on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The jacket is beautiful.  It has been expertly crafted.  It
has runes stiched in a darker green running up the sleeves.

name: A humming, green key
longdesc: A green piece of metal is vibrating in the dirt.

name: a silver and gold belt
longdesc: A belt gleams brightly in the the light.

extra_descriptions.description:
The belt has been expertly made.  Gold and silver have
actually been weaved into the leather.

name: a runed silver sword
longdesc: A silver sword lies here, emitting a humming sound.

extra_descriptions.description: The sword appears to be very well crafted.

name: a elven body cloak
longdesc: You see a an elven body cloak slightly glimmering on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The cloak shimmers in the light as you hold it up, giving off
a magical glow.

name: a ceremonial robe
longdesc: A beautiful white robe lies here getting dirty.

extra_descriptions.description:
This robe is made of beautiful white silk.  It is of the
rarest quality.  Why any one would part with it is beyond you.

name: a runed silver hammer
longdesc: A silver hammer lies here shining in the light.

extra_descriptions.description:
The hammer has runes running all over it.  It hums with
magical power.

name: a crystal amulet
longdesc: A crystal shines brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
A crystal amulet looks very fragile, but it glows brightly
from within.

name: a green quiver
longdesc: A green quiver lies on the floor collecting dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
The quiver has been expertly crafted to be of such a light
weight.

name: a green belt
longdesc: A pile of leather lies on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: This belt is very slim.  It looks like it is very durable.

name: a pair of green boots
longdesc: A pair of green boots lie here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pair of boots, although well worn, seem to have alot of
wear left in them.

name: a multi-hued cloak
longdesc: A glimmering cloak lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Even holding it, you can barely make out a cloak in the
light.

name: a green-tinted sword
longdesc: A green sword lies here humming softly.

extra_descriptions.description:
The sword, although tinted a green colour, still has a razor
sharp edge to it.

name: a dark green bracelet
longdesc: A very well crafted looking bracelet has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bracelet was made by a expert wood-smith.  Although
lightweight and made of wood, it seems to be very durable.

name: a ceremonial breastplate
longdesc: A breastplate gleams brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This breast plate has been expertly crafted and has alot of
gemstones placed in it.

name: a jewelled belt
longdesc: A beautiful belt lies here gleaming away.

extra_descriptions.description: The belt is made entirely of gems.  It looks very expensive.

name: a pair of jewelled leggings
longdesc: An expensive looking pair of leggings lie on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Although the leggings look quite ornate, they seem like the
have been crafted for more than just show.

name: a purple silk robe
longdesc: A pile of purple silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This robe has some very ancient looking runes running up the
sleeves and looks to have been crafted by a very skilled artisan.

name: a runed oak rod
longdesc: An old runed wand lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The wand looks ancient.  It has runes all over it and emits
power like it once belonged to a very powerful mage.

name: a purple silk hat
longdesc: A small pile of purple silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The hat has been crafted by a skilled artisan. It has runes
all around the hat.

name: an ancient sword
longdesc: A runed sword lies here humming.

extra_descriptions.description:
The sword appears to be very well crafted.  Ancient runes
cover the entire blade.  Although the sword appears to be ancient, you
can tell the blade still has a very sharp edge.

name: a mithril helmet
longdesc: A helmet lies here shining in the light.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helmet would be worthy of a great warrior or a king.  It
has be made be a very skilled artisan.

name: a gold cloak
longdesc: A pile of gold silk lies glittering on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The cloak looks very expensive.  It gliters as the light
catches it.  Although thin it is made of the finest silk and is very
strong.

name: a silver chainmail shirt
longdesc: A very well crafted mail shirt lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shirt looks like it would be a warriors best friend.
Although lightweight, it has been expertly crafted to help turn the
blows of almost any weapon.

name: a mithril ring
longdesc: A mithril ring has been left on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: At first glance it seems to be just a simple band of mithril.

name: a runed battleaxe
longdesc: A dusty axe lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The battleaxe has runes running around shaft and blade.
Although it looks like it might have been a ceremonial weapon, it still
looks like it would hold a good edge.

name: a flaming rod
longdesc: A flaming rod sticks out from the ground, bursting in flames.

extra_descriptions.description:
The rod has ancient runes all over it.  The flames seem to be
of a magical nature, as the rod is cold to the touch.

name: a chord of red silk
longdesc: A pile of red silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is very fine silk, woven into a chord.

name: a pair of red silk boots
longdesc: A pile of red silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The boots have been woven out of fine silk and look like they
would be very comfortable.

name: a pair of red silk sleeves
longdesc: A pile of red silk lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: The sleeves have been woven of very fine silk.

name: a crystal bracelet
longdesc: A thin circle of crystal lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: The crystal bracelet is thin yet it glow with a magical light.

name: a golden dragon scale
longdesc: A scale from a golden dragon lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: The scale is big enough and sturdy enough to make a very nice shield.

name: an odd tree branch
longdesc: An odd branch sticks out inconspicuously.

extra_descriptions.description:
You barely notice an odd tree branch sticking out from the
	tree.

name: Ringil
longdesc: Ringil, heirloom of the Elven Kings, sits here humming softly.

extra_descriptions.description:
Ringil is a sword unlike any other.  Forged aeons ago by the Elven Smiths at
the height of their power, it glows with an inner light and is as light as
feather. Its edge is razor sharp, un-dulled by the millennia of use it has
seen in the hands of the Elven Kings.

name: an unseen cloak
longdesc: a mysteriously hard to see cloak is here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak is made of some kind of silky-smooth material that appears
to bend light around it, rendering the wearer invisible...  How cool!

name: a set of blue stones
longdesc: A set of three dull, blue stones is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The set of three stones shine brilliantly in your hand. As you wrap your fingers
over them, you can feel a strange yet welcoming warmth ebb outward from
the palm of your hand. The Elves tell stories of these ancient relics but no
story can do the beauty and sensation justice. The glistening reflecting in your
eyes reminds you of the stars and heavens in the clearest of night skies.

name: Baetylus of Stone
longdesc: A stone baetylus has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This intricately carved stone disc depicts a man kneeling before a mountain with
what looks like a sunburst at the top endowing the worshipper with strength and
courage. Looking closely at the sunburst, you notice a hint of green behind a
crystal that looks familiarly like jelly.

name: Aendriarta's hasty hammer
longdesc: A pocket-sized, jittery hammer lies here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}The hammer pants heavily as it peters out.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This delightfully small hammer fits entirely within the palm of your hand
and has itty-bitty runes written on it that, while too small for your
eyesight, are as powerful as any.

name: shimmering gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of gauntlets rest here shimmering with a faint glow.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pair of gauntlets made out of mismatched bits of plate and steel.
They have a magical glow and fit any hand! Provided said hand had fingers
like sausages. Bratwurst ones.

name: shadow breast plate
longdesc: A breastplate writhed in shadows is lying on the ground here.

name: gloves of assassination
longdesc: some strange gloves have been dropped here.

name: cloak of the night
longdesc: a cloak as dark as night has been dropped here.

name: hood of darkness
longdesc: a hood that seems to suck up all light has been left here.

name: sleeves of stalking
longdesc: a pair of sleeves have been discarded here.

name: pants of the elves
longdesc: some interesting pants are lying on the floor.

name: belt of the elements
longdesc: a multicolored belt is lying here.

name: socks of silence
longdesc: some crumpled socks are lying here.

name: shield of the black widow
longdesc: a shield spun by a black widow has been dropped here

name: mark of the widow
longdesc: the mark of the widow lies here, a non-assassin wearing it would be sure death.

name: a bag of curiosities
longdesc: A random bag has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This unassuming bag emanates a blue glow as you open it's maw. You can't help
but wonder how will you find anything you've stuck in it's belly but as you
think of the item you are in need of, it simply pops into your hand.

name: a scroll of passage
longdesc: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The scroll has letters written all over that seem to create a melodic hum as
you start to sound them out.

name: A great white oak
longdesc: A large, sturdy oak tree grows along the bank.

extra_descriptions.description:
The great oak shines with almost a pearl-like sheen. It stands
about eight stories high and appears quite climb-able with how
the branches are reaching out from the trunk. The leaves, too,
shine as if they are made from pearl. You wonder what it would
be like to touch it.

name: Elven sleeves of stealth
longdesc: a pair of sleeves have been discarded here.

name: a set of green stones
longdesc: A set of three dull, green stones is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The set of three stones shine brilliantly in your hand. As you wrap your fingers
over them, you can feel a strange yet welcoming warmth ebb outward from
the palm of your hand. The Elves tell stories of these ancient relics but no
story can do the beauty and sensation justice. The glistening reflecting in your
eyes reminds you of the lushest forests on a sunny day following rains.

name: Baetylus of Metal
longdesc: A metal baetylus has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This intricately carved stone disc depicts a man kneeling before a mountain with
what looks like a sunburst at the top endowing the worshipper with strength and
courage. Looking closely at the sunburst, you notice a hint of green behind a
crystal that looks familiarly like jelly.

name: a simple forging hammer
longdesc: A scuffed up hammer lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: A simple forging hammer likely used by apprenticing smiths.

name: Marlebryn's Forging Hammer
longdesc: Marlebryn's hammer rests here with a glowing aura surrounding it and singing to you.
item_ability_msg: #{white}Flames engulf the hammer as you can feel it's might course through you#{o}.

extra_descriptions.description:
This forging hammer was made by Marlebryn, the master forger, and gifted special abilities by 
the Elven Magi. One must transcend alignment to wield this masterful tool.

name: A blue heron marked blade
longdesc: A longsword with a blue heron stamped into the pommel lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
You are looking at the sword for a blademaster. The blue heron mark is unmistakable in
it's meaning and for whom it's intended. The blade is long and unblemished, with an edge you are
certain could slice steel like butter. As you look closely at the blade, you can see a strike
of lightning eminating at the handle and running the length of the blade to the tip as if ready
to burst.

name: A red heron marked blade
longdesc: A longsword with a red heron stamped into the pommel lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
You are looking at the sword for a blademaster. The red heron mark is unmistakable in
it's meaning and for whom it's intended. The blade is long and unblemished, with an edge you are
certain could slice steel like butter. As you look closely at the blade, you can see a burst
of fire eminating at the handle and running the length of the blade to the tip as if ready to erupt.

name: Anchlachel
longdesc: An well-crafted shortsword lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
You are holding a blade that feels as old as time but the exquisite
craftsmanship belies it's age. The slightly curved blade has groves 
running the length like smooth waves in a pond. Elvish symbols decorate 
the pommel and blade describing it's origin and purpose.

longdesc: A scroll of knock lies here.

name: Smote
longdesc: There is a mighty weapon here.

longdesc: A studded leather eye patch has been left on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
The eye patch is constructed very well.  There are leather
straps stitched into the eye patch that tie around the back of the
head.  Five studded spikes adorn the front of the eye patch.

name: a studded leather breast plate
longdesc: A studded leather breast plate is lying on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The studded leather breast plate appears to be the pinnacle
of the warg villager's worksmanship.  It appears to be very sturdy and
has an intricate pattern of studded spikes on the front and back.

examine it.  Holding it up to the light, you find it strange that very
little light is able to pass through it, despite its clear appearance.

tell its wearer did not enjoy being collared.

longdesc: A large furnace rests against the wall, glowing warmly.

extra_descriptions.description:
The furnace glows with a warm yellow energy.  There is no
heat eminating from the metal, yet your body seems to warm up as you
lay your hand on its metal casing.  Glowing yellow tubes rise up from
the back of the furnace and into the ceiling.  This furnace must be
providing power to the entire castle!

Someone has not taken very good care of this sword.  However,
there still seems to be a deadly aura about it.  Better throw it away.

name: a dirty shield

Man, somebody take a sponge to this thing.  Whiping away some

probably take quite a bit of damage.

and clean, no reflection can be cast upon it.  It looks like very
sturdy armor.

extra_descriptions.description:
The dwarven breast plate seems is the most breath taking
piece of craftsmanship you have seen in a long time.  A picturesque
scene scrawls the front and back of the breastplate, in gold and silver.

name: A slender longsword
longdesc: A slender longsword lays flat on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
What marvelous craftsmanship.  The blade glows with the
pride of the artisan that molded it.  The cross-guard splits out like
a holy cross, guarding the wielder from evil.

This is a soft and cuddly toy version of Berk!  Being an oviform
