a cuddly toy just for you!  This stuffie includes boot-lace worms and
woolly eyeballs ready to be popped in to a pot and cooked up!
Snuggle cuddle!

name: an old VHS tape of Hocus Pocus
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This old VHS tape has a faded hand-written label showing that this
copy is likely to be one of those special '90s pirates that is fuzzier
than Fozzie Bear's bottom.  And much less funny.  Wocka wocka!

name: an old VHS tape of Child's Play
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This old VHS tape has a printed label showing everyone's heroically
murderous doll, Chucky, with his tell-tale red and white striped shirt
and hair copied straight from Sideshow Bob.  Won't that be a fun watch.

name: a VHS tape of Nightmare on Elm Street
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.keywords: vhs tape nightmare on elm street
extra_descriptions.description:
Someone has written in crayon on the label, colouring in Freddy's
face and ruining that gruesome visage with an image of a tomato and
the legend, "Mister Smiff Smells of Poo". It's quite likely that the
child artist in question watched this movie and turned in to a normal,
well-adjusted adult.  Which just goes to show that you can think Mr.
Smith smells of something horrible but still be a functioning member
of society and not a DnD-playing mass-murderer.

name: a VHS tape of Friday the 13th
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
Here is a real masterpiece.  The label is peeling, but the glue is still
tacky enough to make your fingers stick together.  Coffee (or worse) has
left a patina of stains across the graphic label, and a brown ring testifies
to this tape being used as a coaster.  What a life it's had.

name: a faded VHS tape of Halloween
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This old VHS tape appears to have been left out in the sun for
a good decade or more.  The once bright blue of the plastic is now
almost white, the label is clean but almost unreadable.

name: a VHS tape of It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
namelist: VHS tape great pumpkin charlie brown
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.keywords: vhs tape great pumpkin charlie brown
extra_descriptions.description:
The handwitten label (in pencil) reveals this to be a recorded-
from-television production, probably including adverts from the 80's
proclaiming how you can get whiter-whites in your whites and how all
small children of the male variety want a Scalextric Set for 
Christmas.

name: an old VHS tape of IT
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
Tim Curry in scary clown make-up on the label proclaims this VHS tape
to be less about fixing your computer ("Have you tried turning it off and
on again?") and more Why-Did-I-Watch-This-I've-Had-Nightmares-For-Months.
	Enjoy!

name: a VHS tape of Nightmare Before Christmas
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
Tim Burton at his best.  But you won't be able to play this one because
someone has decided to poke holes in the tape using a pencil.  That was not
very nice of them...

name: a VHS tape of Sleepy Hollow
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
Christina, Johnny... What more could you ask for?  You want it on
DVD at least but you'd prefer a digital copy?  Huh.  Some people are
never happy!

name: a VHS tape of Bram Stoker's Dracula
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This tape has been completely covered in stickers of Teenage
Mutant Ninja Turtles.  Completely, even the tape has been the
subject of a sticker-crazed terrorist out to show off Leonardo,
Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo in a plethora of poses.  The
black marker pen across the front helps identify the tape as
Bram Stoker's Dracula.

name: a VHS tape of Casper
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This tape of the adorably sickening ghost is in great
condition.  Clearly nobody watches this drivel...

name: a VHS tape of The Craft
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This VHS tape is covered in grubby handprints like it has been
watched and watched and watched over and over again.  And who can
blame the former owner?  For this is one of the greatest movies
ever made!

name: a patchwork Bob
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Bob has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This patchwork doll has been stitched together into the likeness of Bob.
It has big lumpy muscles, an oversized club for clubbing enemies, and for
some reason a weirdly small head.

name: a patchwork Celesta
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Celesta has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This patchwork doll has all the hallmarks of Celesta.  It's eyes are
closed, it's little hands stretched out wide with fists balled, and
its mouth is open in a big wide yawn.  You can even see some tonsils in
there...  Quick, call the Yawning Police!  Wee-woo-wee-woo!

name: a patchwork Dirk
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Dirk has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a badly stuffed patchwork Dirk.  The stuffing has moved
and formed lumps in all the wrong places. In particular, all the
fingers look like they've been taking steroids and working out at
the local gym for 8 hours a day 7 days a week for a year.

name: a patchwork Viller
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Viller has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a patchwork doll of Viller.  In one hand it holds a book
entitled 'Chivalry: A Knight's Guide', and in the other is a lumpy
wool simile of a giant sword still dripping blood, brains and gore
from it's latest victory.

name: a patchwork Uma
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Uma has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This doll looks to have been filled with marbles and loose
change.  It certainly rattles as its moved!  It comes complete
with cheeky kilt-on-a-string that can be pulled to 'moon' other
patchwork dolls, your friends, enemies and mother-in-law.  It
is a very special doll...

name: a patchwork Desmo
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Desmo has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
Desmo is a legend in the patchwork doll community.  It has been
known to accept bribes in the form of cheap beer and broken promises.
In return the lumpy little thing with stringy wool hair will wave
its Desmonator around like a crazed caveman on acid.  Of course, this
only happens when no one is looking at it...

name: a patchwork Tasha
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Tasha has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a lumpy and poorly stuffed Tasha patchwork.  It is wearing all
of the best red and pink eq, and looks ready to beat anyone senseless in
an arena.  At least until Nitemare gives an opponent a Nerf Bat.

name: a patchwork Koral
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Koral has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a lumpy and slightly misshapen patchwork Koral.  It's not
misshapen because Koral is special, rather  it has an inventory with
enough mass to collapse under its own gravity and form a tiny black
hole.  This little Koral juggles all that stuff like a drunken clown,
and like said clown, fails to find anything due to the sheer number
of things it carries.

name: a patchwork Mystina
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Mystina has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
Mystina is a very cool little patchwork.  And like every cool person
we all know, it fails to arrive on time.  There have been bunnies with
watches that have dived in to holes because they were running late to a 
magical tea party that would appear long before Mystina ever did at such
an event.  It is busily twisting it's lumpy little hands in to spells
and searching for that much needed potion and scroll before it totters
off to meet it's group mates (whom have all taken naps whilst they
waited).

name: a patchwork Tygen
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Tygen has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This little patchwork Tygen is slightly damp and has mold growing on
it in places.  There are sucker marks criss-crossing it's little lumpy
armour from all the battles it's had with Buntagonamadon.  The lack of a
flaming halo suggests it will go on battling Buntagonamadon for some
time to come.  Mold and all.

name: a patchwork Arturian
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Arturian has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a patchwork Arturian.  It looks great in the best shiny armour,
wielding the shiniest sword, stomping around in the cleanest boots and
wearing the biggest, smuggest grin that cheap stitching and wool can buy. 
Nothing could be better than this little thing.  With it's chest puffed out
and hands on it's hips, it looks ready to burst in to song, much to the
annoyance of Nitemare.

name: a patchwork Spanglore
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Spanglore has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
Lumpy, bumpy, but cuter than a whole box full of kittens.  Little
Spanglore has been posed with one arm outstretched, the other over it's
little lumpy heart, and it's mouth open in glorious song.  It's enough
to make you want to join in and wave flags and stamp your feet in a
marching band.  But not Nitemare, that would be silly.

name: a patchwork Pixilator
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Pixilator has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a rather odd patchwork doll of Pixilator.  Instead of the
usual meaningless lumps and bumps, this one is made up of different
coloured squares that lend a visualisation of the namesake.  It looks
like it is on the hunt for eq and apex points, but keeps missing out
to Bob.

name: a patchwork Calista
longdesc: A patchwork doll of Calista has been left here.  Steal it quick!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a patchwork of Calista.  It has a tiny sword, a tiny shield, and
is complete with a tiny grumpy face.  Little button eyes shine madly in a
face full of red stitching that almost recreates that mess of scar tissue
that gives the real Calista such a sunny disposition.  Everything about the
tiny patchwork screams Calista.  Treasure it, for it is rarer than rocking-
horse poo.

name: a Nitemare plushie
longdesc: A cute plushie, in the likeness of Nitemare, lies on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This plushie has been made in to the perfect likeness of Nitemare.  It has
frizzy blonde hair, a cute pair of shorts, a pair of dancing shoes, and a
t-shirt that states 'Do your shoes dance by themselves?!  Then there's magic
afoot!'  With her fashionable fanny pack and Bunta's tarnished soul hovering
to please her every whim, there's no doubt the only difference between this
and the real Nitemare is the lack of a potty mouth.

name: a Celesta-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Celesta has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Celesta.  It has golden
icing for hair.  Someone has crafted her face so that she looks to be having
a wonderful nap next to some fountain... Zzz.

name: a Pixilator-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Pixilator has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Pixilator.  It is
extra soft and is full of raisins, giving it a strange pixel-like look
that doesn't look like dead flies... Honest.

name: a Bob-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Bob has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Bob.  It is very
thick and crammed full of chocolate chips.  Much like the real Bob.  If
it also had a cheese and onion flavour you'd never know the difference.

name: a Viller-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Viller has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Viller.  It is
made from a vegan recipe that strangely seems to include a lot of vodka
and bashing evil-doers.

name: a Arturian-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Arturian has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Arturian.  It is
double-chocolate with extra chocolate sprinkles and chocolate cream.
It's very sweet.

name: a Dirk-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Dirk has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Dirk.  Whomever
the artist was they did a really good job of capturing the essence of
Dirk.  There's some really *really* big fingers made from #{bold green}S#{blue}k#{green}i#{magenta}t#{red}t#{green}le#{magenta}s#{o}.

name: a Koral-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Koral has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Koral.  Well...
Almost.  It's been built in to the shape of a bottle with a houseboat
inside it but in deference to it being for Koral someone has added a 
candy-cane sword.

name: a Tygen-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Tygen has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Tygen.  It is
replete with huge holy avenger and book entitled 'How to be a great
Paladin'.

name: a Sabor-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Sabor has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Sabor.  It actually
resembles a list of options, much like the options presented to the Terminator
when making decisions on how to proceed.  All of the options are complaints
about this very cookie.

name: an Oscar-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Oscar has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Oscar.  It looks
like one big muscle on top of some other muscles covered in some fur
and swords and spiky stuff.  Very close to the original Oscar!

name: an Sheba-shaped cookie
longdesc: A sweet smelling Christmas cookie in the shape of Sheba has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cookie has been expertly baked in to the shape of Sheba.  Like the
real Sheba is furry and colourful, full of marshmallows and baked beans.
We don't ask.

name: a Cookie bag
longdesc: A large red bag with the word 'COOKIES' emblazoned on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This lovely red bag is made of red felt with green trimmings.  In large
white letters the word 'COOKIES' has been emblazoned on to it for all-
and-sundry to guess at its mysterious contents.  Stolen from Mrs. Claus 
by Mr. Meany, it was once bulging with the tantalising promise of a fresh
baked cookies... Now all you're likely to find in it now are some crumbs
and a hastily scribbled I-O-U.

name: a VHS tape of Hellraiser
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This VHS tape is covered in a pins like someone mistook it for a
pincushion.

name: a VHS tape of The Exorcist
longdesc: An old, battered VHS tape has been dropped here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This VHS tape is rather battered like someone trying to beat a
possession out of it.

longdesc: The -=<<Dragon's Hoard>>=- public trading board is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Use "Look AT board" to see a listing of the messages. Use "Read
<message number>" or "Remove <message number>" to read or remove
  a message, respectively. Use Write <header> to write a message.

name: a small blue collar with a "Shopcat" tag hanging from it.
longdesc: Janey the shopcat has lost her collar here!

name: A OldPort teleporter tag
longdesc: A bright tag is here labelled "OldPort.

name: a glowing sword
longdesc: A glowing longsword sticks out from the ground, it emits a soft humming sound.

name: a rune covered door frame
longdesc: A rune covered door frame is built into a tree.

name: a rune covered door frame
longdesc: A rune covered door frame is built into the tree.

name: halloween hayride
longdesc: A giant black carriage is hitched to six ghostly nightmares.

extra_descriptions.description:
A giant black carriage has come to a stop at the Entrance to the
               Underground.  Six giant nightmares are linked together, in three
               sets of two, at the front of the carriage.  The Headless Horseman
               stands at the stage to the front of the carriage.  His torso turns to
               you and a voice speaks into your head informing, "Just touch carriage
               and you can enjoy the hayride to the graveyard." A manical laughter
               echos in your head as the Headless Horseman turns around and faces his
               nightmares. The entire back of the carriage has been cut off and the
               contents of the carriage cleared out. The carriage is now filled with
               barrels of hay, both stacked and spread on the floor.  What fun, a
               hayride!

name: a floating snake head
longdesc: A floating, disembodied, translucent snake head is here, watching you...

extra_descriptions.description:
This snake head is disembodied, translucent and floats lazily in the 
air.  It's not static, instead it moves, it's mouth opening and closing
slowly, it's dead black eyes following you and it's see-through bright
blue tongue seems to taste the very air you breathe.  Touching it might 
be a bad idea, but as you're underneath a complex full of half-man half-
snake people and in the den of some strange tentacle beast, I'd say all
your good ideas have amounted to the same thing.

name: A Playtester Teleporter button
longdesc: A small button. Tell Nitemare about it immediately.

name: Santa's Sleigh
longdesc: Santa's Sleigh has been parked here, just begging to be touched!

extra_descriptions.description:
This is Santa's Sleigh.  It is made of highly polished wood that has been
painted in golds, greens and reds.  It is missing a jolly fat man, a sack
of presents and many reindeer.  You would love to touch it! Go ooooon!

name: the Fists of Dracthyr
longdesc: The Fists of Dracthyr glow with an inner power here.
item_ability_msg: #{red bold}The aura surrounding the Fists of Dracthyr fades away.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
These gauntlets are made of red titanium and have been lobstered in such
a way that they offer protection from the mid-forearm all the way to the
tips of the fingers.  The palm and undersides of the wrist and fingers
are made from the same titanium but this time coloured a pale, creamy
white.  Across the knuckles spiked have been attached that curl over the
back of the hand, whilst two gem sockets on the upper segments of the
ring and middle fingers give the impression of luminous eyes staring
forward.  Each and every spare surface has been inscribed with swirls
and runes, and if you look hard enough, you can see they spell out the
words #{bold}Touch#{o} and #{bold}Fists#{o}... Strange.

name: a bright golden mirror
longdesc: A golden mirror faces the dias here, allowing the resident gaze upon Herself.

extra_descriptions.description:
As nice as this mirror is, it is covered in smudgy finger prints.

Yuck!

Fetch a cloth!

name: a generic teleportation device
longdesc: A glowing sphere of light hovers in the dank air.

name: a PR(tm) newbie map
longdesc: A map for newbies is here, discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
Perilous Realms Newbie Informational Guide

This map will provide you with directions to some areas
to get you started on your journey as an adventurer of
Perilous Realms.  Listed below are some tips for you on
your adventure.
1)  Use the "consider" command often (usage: consider <mob>)
     This command will provide you with some insight as to your
     chances against the specified mob.
2)  Recall scrolls are extremely useful if you find yourself lost.
      You have been supplied with two of these scrolls, and more
      can be purchased from Zinab's shop (directions below).  To
      use a scroll simply type "recite recall" and you will be safely
      transported back to midgard.
4) Perilous Realms has some rules that govern gameplay.  Type
   "Help Laws" to read them, also check the board in the Tavern
   for any amendments to these rules.

Directions
1) The Chessboard (good place to start).  From above fountain
     simply go 5 west, 4 south, 2 west, and Up.  You will only be able
    to use this area until level 50.
2) The Shire.  From above fountain simply go 5 west, 6 south, 6 west,
     "Enter gate", 2 west, "Enter thicket", 3 west, 1 south, 2 east, 2 north,
     "Enter Hole" (beware of the rabbits!), 1 north, "Enter Forest", 1 west,
     and as far north as you can!.
3) Zifnabs magic shop. From above fountain simply go 5 west, and 10 south.
   then "enter shop".  Once inside type 'list' to see a list of goods
   for sale.

name: a map to the bayou

extra_descriptions.description:
Tours Inc. Presents:
        The road to the bayou

Step 1: Go north from the camp ground.
Step 2: Travel fifteen rooms to the east.
Step 3: Go south until you meet Russel the skiff salesman.
Step 4: Russel will sell you a skiff for the journey.

Points of interest-
-Some rare and beautiful manatees float along the bayou.  If you have
 a kind heart they may even let you pet them.
-The monkey and baboon reservation has saved and raised several
 generations of the species.
-Botany:The exotic sundew flower blooms deep within the swamp and no
 where else on Pharsica.

Beware:

-There can be untold and powerful evil within the depths of the bayou

-Whirlpools are a sign of evil magic do not float above them long

name: a map to the hot springs
longdesc: A map to the hot springs lies here, discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
Tours Inc. Presents:
        The road to the hot springs

Step 1: Go north from the camp ground.
Step 2: Travel twenty rooms to the east.
Step 3: You should be able to see the hot springs just to the north.

Points of interest-
-hot water geyser: The beautiful Amnos geyser goes off every ten
 minutes.  Please be careful to not get too close.  The water is
 scolding hot.
-The hot springs: Enjoy a long, steaming bath to sooth your nerves and
 revigorate your soul!  The best hot springs in Pharsica

Be warned:

-Do not wander too far from the paths in the hot springs.  You may wind
 up in a place you never intended.  It is rumored that King Gilfor's
 kingdom was once powered by the energy from the hot springs.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the fruiting body of a subterranean fungus.  They are commonly found by boar
in mushroom-rich country, where the conditions are just ripe for them to flourish.

name: Hogger's oversized boar tusk
longdesc: An oversized boar tusk has been jammed into the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: This tusk has come straight from the mouth of Hogger, legendary boar chief.

longdesc: A shiny ticket rolls across the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a shiny gold ticket with the words 'HOUSE OF MIRRORS - ADMIT 1' printed
on it.

This is a black ticket with the words 'FERRIS WHEEL - ADMIT 1' printed 
on it.

name: a bigtop ticket

extra_descriptions.description: This is an animal-print ticket with the words 'BIGTOP - ADMIT 1' printed on it.

name: a deadly throwing dagger
longdesc: A deadly looking dagger has been thrown into the grown.

extra_descriptions.description:
This dagger has been designed to fly through the air at incredible speed.
This is possibly a very dangerous thing to do as it could have someone's
eye out.  Tsk.

name: a throwing dart
longdesc: A tiny dart can barely be seen sticking out of the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
Not content with being used for an innocent pub game, this dart has been
sharped to the point it could turn a small bunny in to a colander.

name: a flame breather's wand
longdesc: A red wand is been lies covered in dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wand is 12 inches long.  Sparks of fiery magic crawl around the blackened
tip.  Careful!  It could go off at any moment!

name: some juggling balls
longdesc: Some juggling balls roll all over the floor.

extra_descriptions.description: These colourful balls are soft and squishy, perfect for juggling with.

name: a ring master's hat
longdesc: A black top hat lies alone on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a black velvet top hat.  The inner band is stained with sweat there
appears to be a lot of rabbit hair inside.  How odd.

name: a whipped cream pie made by Millie
longdesc: A pie bowl full of a whipped topping sits in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a pie made of whipped cream.  It was prepared by Millie.  Yum!

name: some cotton candy
longdesc: Some cotton candy lies here, covered in dirt and filth.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pink and fluffy and very very sticky.  It is liable to blow in to your face
in the slightest of breezes.

name: a sack of peanuts
longdesc: A sack of peanuts lies crumpled on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a small hessian sack full of peanuts.  Lightly salted, just the way you
like them.

name: a hot dog
longdesc: A half-eaten hot dog has been thrown in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
Sausage in a bun.  Except the word sausage would be too nice for this
phallic meat product.  Enjoy!

name: some fried dough
longdesc: A sweet smelling snack with a bite taken out of it lies here.

extra_descriptions.description: It is dough.  It has been fried.  What else did you want to see?

name: a hula hoop
longdesc: A grey hula hoop has been tossed to the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a hoop of stiffed grey leather that can be used to hula with.

name: a pink sash
longdesc: A pink sash flies through the air like a piece of paper.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a rather sparkly pink sash.  It will make you look most attractive.

name: some popcorn
longdesc: A bag of salty smelling popcorn lies half eaten on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
Salty, sticky and made of corn.  It looks like someone has been eating it
already!

name: a pint of ale
longdesc: A pint of ale has been thrown to the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: A pint glass of rich, brown ale.  Perfect for quaffing!

name: a glass of colourful liquid
longdesc: A glass of sweet smelling liquid lies half empty on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a glass of sweet, sticky, colourful liquid.  The pessimist in you tells
you that the glass is half empty.

name: contortionist's leggings
longdesc: A pair of red leggings lies in a pile on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pair of red, well used leggings.  The material is extra stretchy so
that is doesn't rip when scratching your ear with your toe.

name: a glowing balloon
longdesc: A glowing balloon flies through the air.

extra_descriptions.description: This a glowing, floating balloon.  Holding it will illuminate your way.  Yay!

name: an engagement ring
longdesc: A pretty piece of metal sticks out from the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a silver engagement ring.  It looks to have been well loved and someone
probably misses it quite dearly.

name: a strong man's vest
longdesc: A pile of mesh steel lies in a clump here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Links of fine steel form a mesh that covers the body from chest to abdomen
and conveniently leaves the arms free.  Wearing this would be make you look
awesome!

name: some clown shoes
longdesc: A pair of colourful clown shoes lies discarded on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
These shoes are a gaudy yellow and red colour and are far too big to be
worn comfortably.

name: some thick leather gloves
longdesc: A pair of long, thick leather gloves lies in a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The leather of these gloves is very thick and strong and stretches half-way up
the forearm.

name: an elephant's hide
longdesc: A thick pile of grey elephant skin lies in a clump here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Once belonging to an elephant, this hide is thick and strong, capable of
absorbing even the most powerful of blows.  Although, that didn't save the
original owner it seems.

name: a glittering scroll
longdesc: A glittering piece of paper has been tossed to the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This scroll is written on black paper that has been liberally sprinkled with
glitter to make it sparkle.

A flowered stencil laiden handle corrodes from the acid
on her hand.  The queen stinger, more barbed and sharred organic fiber,
is the weapon of choice for the ruler of a wasp colony sent to destroy
the magic users of Terberthia.

name: the hardened skin of a wasp
longdesc: A tough piece of wasp skin lies in a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description:
A wasp skin was crafted by a master threader. The
attention to detail and reuse of a dead carcus of a wasp is incredibly
armored and tailored to fit.

longdesc: A pair of ceramic boots seem to wiggle with energy.

extra_descriptions.description:
Created by a powerful mage, these boots hold the wearer
securely to the ground and create a powerful energy boost.

longdesc: A long sceptre has been stuck into the dirt before you.

extra_descriptions.description:
The sceptre is a long staff created by the mages of
Terberthia.  It provides improved vision in dark or dimly lit places.
The sceptre allows the bearer to see true and clear.

name: a pollen sack
longdesc: A sack used to gather organic material is here unused.

name: a wasp skull
longdesc: A bright white skull looks up at you from the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The wasp skull is pretty disgusting. It is made from
hollowed head of a wasp.  The skull bone is pretty thick and looks
like it can withstand a pretty good impact.

name: a pair of wasp wings
longdesc: A pair of wasp wings flies all around the room.

extra_descriptions.description:
The wasp wings look really heavy.  They also appear
to provide really great protection from a rear attack.  The wings
of a wasp allow the wearer to reach great heights.

name: the cloak of a generation
longdesc: A large cloak of crystalline cloth glows ominously in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
The cloak of generation was designed by the mages of
Terberthia.  It is something so rare that it can only be speculated
that it was taken by the Queen wasp when they attacked Terberthia.
The cloak seems to hum loudly.

name: a potion of discovery
longdesc: A greenish black potion lies here discarded.

emitting a loud hum.

name: a power sword

extra_descriptions.description:
The mages of Terberthia distributed these weapons to fight
the wasps.  These swords give extra power to the bearer to cause
as much harm to thier foe as possible.

name: a valuable key

name: a flaming parchment

name: a ring of the sun

A small glinting sun ring bears to its owner an invaluable

A small charm helps ward off poisons, venoms, and other toxins.

name: a flask of blue and yellow mixture

extra_descriptions.description: The flask has a small label on it 'Property of Mogue'.

The fin of a small black and white shark is helpful
when held during battle.

name: the cape of a thousand souls

extra_descriptions.description:
The cape was designed my a master mage to bring death
to the might wasp colony. However it was stolen by the queen and
used against the mages preserving their stolen souls forever.

name: the ring of endless swarms
longdesc: A small ring that hums and vibrates like a swarm of wasps

extra_descriptions.description:
A small ring is here humming with a loud sound that is very distinctive
like the sound of humming wasps.

name: chains of binding
longdesc: Some chains for binding rot on the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Chains for binding are not the most elegant of items, but
Redbourne has set himself free with magic leaving these
available.

name: Staff of Toxic Humors
longdesc:
This gnarled staff exudes horrible fumes. It weakens you to even
be near it.  However if you adapt to its toxins you can probably survive almost
any kind of poison

extra_descriptions.description:
The staff is made to help repel attacks of magic and was
used by the mages to help defeat the evil black wasp queen.

name: Crown of the Wasp King
longdesc: A large platinum crown that is shaped for a wasp head lies here gleaming brightly.

extra_descriptions.description:
The crown has small rubies placed around the base of it.  It
gleams almost with an inner light.

name: a black splintered royal warhammer
longdesc: A warhammer with the royal crest of the Valkyrie is here, a bit splintered but ready to use.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Valkyrie have long since kept this weapon a secret
and use it only for their private training, and to keep the
enemy at bay.

name: Thunderhammer
longdesc: A sparking, ominous looking hammer has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Every Dwarf knows the tale of the Thunderhammer.  How it was forged by the
first King, Fortrus the Founder, in the last fires of an ancient volcano.
How the Founder led the Dwarfs through stoney dell and rocky valley, how he
stood against the might of the rampaging elven nations and, with this very
hammer, smote down the elven princeling and brought peace to the realms.
This hammer consists of a cloudy grey head and simple looking hilt with a
leather grip.  Yet it has not left the halls of the ancestral Dwarfs in many
hundreds of years.

name: Thor's Hammer
longdesc: Thor's hammer rest's here, as immovable as a mountain.
item_ability_msg: #{white}Lightning ceases to crawl over the head of Thor's Hammer.#{o}.
item_ability_desc: #{magenta bold}Strike's a single target with lightning.  Activate for AoE lightning.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Thor was the father of Fortrus.  He ruled the great Dwarven realm of Daltorp in an
age long gone when the elves waged war and the peoples of the world fled before
them.  Daltorp is rumoured to be a ghostly shadow of it's golden glory, with the
shade of Thor still weeping at the centre.  All that is left of that once mighty
city lies now in your hands.  Thor's Hammer is a beautiful creation of ancient
Dwarven artifice.  A barrel-like head of pure mithril has been strapped to a dark
polished haft of fire-hardened cherry wood and wrapped in pale leather.  Runes of
power glow dimly around an embossed sigil of the Dwarven Clans on one side of the
head.  Fortrum legends tell the tale that when this hammer is wield in combat it
has the ability to rain down lightning on all enemies... How true this is, we may
never know.

name: a Dorfbrew Charm
longdesc: A Dorfbrew Charm, in the shape of a keg of ale, has been left here.
item_ability_msg: #{magenta}The sounds of barfights and late night laughter fades as the Dorfbrew loses it's edge.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
The Dorfbrew Charm is a ceremonial keg of ale that commerates all things drinking.
Including; feasting, quaffing, cheering, falling over, brawling, telling your best
friend you love them, hitting people on the back and laughing, dancing, telling
lude stories, and eating something suspicious at 2am.  Only Dorf would have some-
thing like this...

name: Drong's Beardknot
longdesc: Drong's famous beardknot has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}Drong's Beardknot unravels...#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This rather strange-looking thing is a beardknot - a device used by Dwarfs at
the end of braids in their beards.  Traditionally made of leather and embossed
with runes, they symbolise age and wisdom.

name: Mage's gem
longdesc: a mage's gem has been left here pulsating.

name: Dorf's mini valve
longdesc: a tiny fixture for controlling beer barrel flows used by Dorf sits here.

name: Jewel of Odin
longdesc: a jewel lies here emitting a brilliant white light.

name: a crafted gem
longdesc: a well-crafted gem lies here.

name: Arms of the Night Blade
longdesc: A shield with the coat of arms of the Night Blade upon it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sleek black shield seems oddly light, and strange to find in
the keep of Odin.  In his youth, centuries ago, Odin was a lithe
and dextrous dwarf, and this relic is a testament to that age.
It is a sturdy, black kite-shaped shield embossed with the arms
of the Night Blades, the Fortish elite assassins.  It is very rare
indeed to find a member of this mysterious group.

name: the Iron Maid
longdesc: The legendary shield of Fortrus lies here, collecting dust.
item_ability_msg: #{bold magenta}Iron Maids' protective glow fades away. #{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This plain, round shield is known as the Iron Maid, the legendary shield
of Fortrus.  It is made of solid meteoric iron, and was forged by Fortrus
long ago.  The only adornment to the grey, rust-free metal is a stylised
representation of a naked Dwarven maid, with pigtails and armed with two
heavy hammers.  No one knows who she was, or what she was to Fortrus,
only that she was clearly important enough to capture forever on the face
of his shield.

name: an ancient forged steel battle band
longdesc: A tough looking ancient forged steel battle band has been placed here.
item_ability_msg: #{bold green}The battle band spins for a moment and then stops. #{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This band is made of a loop of ancient forged steel around another,
thinner loop of the same material such that you can spin the thinner
loop freely of the thicker one but they still lock in place.  The
inner loop has been engraved with secret Dwarf Runes of Power.  What
do they do?  Well that's a question for the bards to sing about.

name: an ancient forged steel battle axe
namelist: ancient odin forged steel battle axe
longdesc: The ancient forged steel battle axe that belongs to Odin has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hand axe has been made of ancient forged steel.  There is a single-
bladed head that has been honed to a sharpness far beyond most weapons.
The other side of the head ends in a lethal-looking spike, perfect for 
driving through your opponents helm and impaling the brain in a death-
stroke.  The haft has been made from a single fire-hardened length of
apple wood that has been inscribed with Dwarf Runes of Power that are
sure to add an expected to kick to this already mighty looking beast.

name: a chunk of Dorfs ear on a chain
longdesc: A bit of Dorfs ear has been threaded on to a chain and left here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This isn't just a chunk of ear - it looks like a whole ear!  It is thick
set and cauliflowered from multiple beatings in many bar brawls.  It has
been threaded by a golden chain so that it can be worn around the neck.
There is a legend that tells the tale of one brave and hardy lass, who
took on Dorf and, in her berserker state, bit off a chunk of his ear.
Known now as Mad Vorta, even Dorf respects this crazy, red-haired dwarf
who wears his ear as a medal of honour.

name: a Bottle of Dwarven Axegrinder Beer
longdesc: A bottle of beer labeled 'Axegrinder!' has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bottle of beer is a reddish-brown in colour that can range to
a blood red in some lights.  It has a strong floral meadow scent,
which is odd considering where this is brewed.  It tastes slightly
sour and has a sweaty finish.  It has been known to increase levels
of belligerence and cause the imbiber to take offence at even the
smallest of slights.

name: a Bottle of Dwarven Hophammer Lager
longdesc: A bottle of lager labeled 'Hophammer!' has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bottle of lager is a golden yellow in colour with visible, floating
particulates tumbling inside.  It strangely has the scent of fresh-baked
bread, which would explain the hops, but leaves you the feeling that you
are about to drink a sandwich.  The dry taste of mushrooms and hops does
nothing to abolish this belief.  It has been know to cause an imbiber to
break out in raucous singing and laughing.

name: a Bottle of Dwarven Rockbiter Cider
longdesc: A bottle of cider labeled 'Rockbiter!' has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bottle of cider is a crystal clear golden brown in colour, like a
lightly toasted marshmallow.  It has a warm, hearty cinnamon scent that
pairs with sour apple taste perfectly.  It has been known to cause an
imbiber to become shameful and embarrassed for drinking a cider when all
the other dwarfs are quaffing ale.

name: Dorf's Beer-Powered Gyrocoptic Contraption
longdesc: A really -really- strange contraption has been dropped off here by a friendly Dwarf engineer.
action: #{cyan bold}The sound of gears grinding and crunching fills the room as the Gyrocoptic Contraption shudders for a moment!#{o}
item_ability_msg: #{red bold}A crunching of gears from the Gyrocoptic Contraption signals a moment of uncertainty... Will you explode or not?!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This strange contraption was constructed for Dorf by Mad Vorta.  A whirling
gizmo of moving iron, pistons and bits that go clank!  It straps to your
back where two long shafts rise up at thirty degree angles away from the
head and end in two strange looking propellers that face upwards.  A hole
in the top of the device, between moving parts that appear determined to
trap a finger, allows for it to be fuelled by the aptly named 'Mad Vorta's
Rocket Fuel' - a highly alcoholic drink that burns with a blue flame and
is guaranteed to remove eyebrows and make even the stoutest of Dwarfs so
drunk they'll proclaim their love for you loudly in the nearest bar.

name: a Flask of Mad Vorta's Rocket Fuel
longdesc: A flask labelled 'Mad Vorta's Rocket Fuel' steams in the cool air here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This flask is made of thick, reinforced clay and is about the size of a
pint bottle.  It tapers at one end where a screw cap keeps the liquid
inside from spilling and allows for easy application to something.  With
Mad Vorta being famed for her non-lethal Dwarf brews, you can be assured
that whatever liquid is hidden within this container will not only taste
delicious, it will also kill off a few thousand brain cells.  Hic!  Woo!

name: a long black truncheon
longdesc: A long black truncheon gleams with recent polish.

extra_descriptions.description: This truncheon is made a dark polished wood.

name: a night watchmans lamp
longdesc: A shuttered lamp is here, emitting light.

extra_descriptions.description: The lamp is a standard brass shutter affair but the light appears to be extra strong.

name: a blackjack
longdesc: A leather cosh full of lead shot is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a long tube of leather full of lead shot. It would hurt to be hit by it!

name: a fireant carapice
longdesc: The red carapice of an ant is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This carapice has a convient slot in the middle for holding. It would make a fine shield!

name: the eye of a wraith spider
longdesc: The mandible of a large spider is glistening here.

extra_descriptions.description: This eye once sat proudly in the head of the wraith spider.  This gory thing now rests in your hands... And you feel your luck and accuracy rise!

name: a pair of wasp-hide shoes
longdesc: A pair of yellow and black shoes have been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Created by a powerful mage, these shoes hold the wearer
allow for deft movement and higher stamina.

name: one of the heads of a hydra
longdesc: A single, severed, reptilian head is rotting here.

name: a blue opal ring
longdesc: A gaudy blue ring has been left here ready for the jumble.

extra_descriptions.description: A small ring with a gaudy blue opal inset. You doubt this will fetch a high price.

name: a ragged silk cloak
longdesc: A disgusting mound of ancient silk is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This cloak likes like it was spun before even your grandpa was born and then used to clean the tops of bars.

name: a shocking electrum sword
longdesc: A shiny sword made of an unknown metal sparks and sizzles here.

name: a scarred wolf-pelt
longdesc: An ancient pelt is here, attracting flies... And worse!

extra_descriptions.description: Inexpertly skinned, this pelt is attracting all manner of flies... But it looks thick and might be good armour.

name: a spider bracelet
longdesc: The husk of a dead spider is here... Eww!

extra_descriptions.description: This is a cunningly crafted bracelet in the likeness of a spider. The legs wrap around your wrist the long, cold, metallic body sits snug against your skin... It makes your skin crawl.

name: a pair of web-covered pants
longdesc: An ancient pair of pants are here, covered in cobwebs.

extra_descriptions.description: They are made of a dark material that is remarkably quiet for how heavy the things are!

name: a piwafwi cloak
longdesc: A rather nice cloak has been hung up neatly on a peg here.

name: a tiny hand-crossbow
longdesc: A crossbow, so small it could fit in the palm of your hand, has been left here.

name: an elaborately embroidered robe
longdesc: A robe covered in fine embroidery has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: The embroidery on this robe actually depicts and an epic struggle between a magician and some kind of strange demon. You follow the story as best you can but it is so elaborate that you're soon lost. All you can work is out is that the magician was destroyed by the demon and this cloak was spun from the dead spell-casters skin.

name: A blue elemental wand
longdesc: A long wand the colour of summer sky is here.

name: a green elemental wand
longdesc: A long wand the colour of the ocean has been left here.

name: a red elemental wand
longdesc: A long wand the colour of the sun has been left here.

name: a brown elemental wand
longdesc: A long wand the colour of clay has been left here.

name: an old, dented and rusty breastplate
longdesc: An old breastplate splattered in mud has left here.

name: a worn, nicked and rusty sword
longdesc: A sword, in terrible condition, has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: The dirt and rust covering this sword would likely make it very poisonous!

name: a mud-splattered tabard
longdesc: An ancient tabard has been dug up and left here.

name: a spectral helm
longdesc: An ethereal helm has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This helm is made of a spongy ethereal material you have never seen before.

name: a spectral focus
longdesc: An odd amulet has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This odd amulet is made of a strange spongy material the likes of which you have never seen before. It glows with a strange power.

name: A white pointy hat
longdesc: A small pointy white hat is here.

name: A glowing white pointy hat
longdesc: A small pointy glowing white hat is here.

name: a pair of ornamental sleeves
longdesc: A pair of delicate elven sleeves are here.

name: a potion of clarity
longdesc: A potion full of eyes is here.

name: a seaweed potion
longdesc: A potion full of seaweed is here.

name: a potion of minor healing
longdesc: A potion that looks very healthy has been left here.

Roaming the streets of New Thalos the half-man-half-beast atrocities that
are known as Lamias are aggresively evil creatures that, at some point in
the dim and distant past, were cursed by something even more malign than
they and so they wander the ruined streets intent upon destruction.

However, not all is so gloomy, for the Lamia's are known to possess an
incredible array of oddly magical stones.  Some of which are sought after
by mages and clerics for use in their spell casting!

New Thalos can be found out of the west gate of Midgard by following these
directions from above the Underground Tavern:

extra_descriptions.description:
The Skexies are a bird-man-like race of creatures that have proven to be
a popular sport for adventurers and explorers from the town of Midgard
for more years than can be counted.

Even though the Skexies have endured countless years of abuse from the
town of Midgard they have never responded in kind.  Instead, they seem
to have turned a blind eye to all the injustices they have suffered over
the years.

The Skexies can be found outside of the west gate of Midgard by following
these directions from above the Underground Tavern:

go 5w 6s 6w gate w thicket 3w s 2e 2n w s river 8e 17s

DIFFICULTY: LOW-HIGH

name: A brass plaque
longdesc: A brass plaque is here, begging to be read.

extra_descriptions.description:
Gelflings are a benign group who live next to the Skexie population and
live under constant guard against their neighbours (even though there has
never been evidence that the Skexies even know the Gelflings exist).

The Gelflings are another race that has suffered years of attack from the
town of Midgard, even though in recent years the number of attacks have
lessened somewhat with the discovery of the mushroom and goblin kingdoms.

The Gelflings can be found outside of the west gate of Midgard by follow-
ing these directions from above the Underground Tavern:

go 5w 6s 6w gate w thicket 3w s 2e 2n w s river 8e 18w 2w fireplace 2d

DIFFICULTY: LOW - MID

extra_descriptions.description:
The Drow are an evil race of elves who live in darkness under the earth.
Although they have not yet been known to crawl forth from their vile hole
the Drow are considered so evil that explorers in their area take the pre
-caution of stealth.

The Drow follow a matriarch and worship some unknown villainous god, the
evidence of which is a terrible demon that resides in the area and has
been known to destroy explorers with vile magic.

Explorers all report that the entrance to the Drow underground world can
only be reached via the lair of an evil dracolich.

The Drow can found outside of the west gate of Midgard by following these
directions from above the Underground Tavern:

go 5w 6s 6w gate w thicket 3w s 2e 2n w s river 2e n d darkness city

extra_descriptions.description:
The Goblin Kingdom is but one place where the spiteful goblins and their
kin live.  It is a place of traps and terrors that can surprise all but
the most stalwart of explorers.

It is in the Goblin Kingdom that the true and disgusting nature of these
horrid little creatures comes to light.  Here, the evil trolls force the
goblins to submit to their will and bring them humans for food.  And worse
the evil god Apep resides ready to poison anyone who appraoches his lair.

The Goblin Kingdom can be found outside of the west gate of Midgard by
following these directions from above the Underground Tavern:

go 5w 6s 6w gate 7n

name: a potion of healing
longdesc: A potion that looks extremely healthy has been left here.

name: a potion of neutralise poison
longdesc: A potion that looks good for snake bites has been left here.

name: a sizzling potion of power
longdesc: A potion that bubbles with power is here.

name: a potion of peace
longdesc: A very peaceful potion lays here, looking relaxed.

name: screaming maiden
longdesc: A large warhammer with a maidens face carved in to the head has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: The face of this warhammer has been carved in to the likeness of a young maiden in mid-scream. No doubt this would scare your enemies silly.

name: a dragonbone club
longdesc: A long and heavy dragonbone club has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is the massive thigh bone of a long dead dragon. There is a small inscription at the base of the bone that reads, "Property of Midgard Museum and Conservatory.

name: an adamantium scimitar
longdesc: A dark-bladed scimitar has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is well crafted scimitar of the type favoured by elves.

name: a mithril scimitar
longdesc: A light-bladed scimitar has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is well crafted scimitar of the type favoured by elves.

name: dragonbone breast plate
longdesc: A breast plate formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone sabatons
longdesc: A pair of sabatons formed from interlocking dragonbones have been left here.

name: dragonbone cuisses
longdesc: A cuisses formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone rerebrace
longdesc: A rerebrace set made from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone vambrace
longdesc: A vambrace formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone gauntlets
longdesc: Some gauntlets formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone bascinet
longdesc: A bascinet helm formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone aventail
longdesc: An aventail formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: dragonbone shield
longdesc: A shield formed from interlocking dragonbones has been left on the floor.

name: a Sword Spider leg
longdesc: A dismembered spider leg twitches on the floor.

name: A brass plaque
longdesc: A brass plaque is here, begging to be read.

extra_descriptions.description:
Your esteemed curator, August Arcana, is currently in negotiations with
representatives from the Yuan-Ti.  Once these talks are concluded, it is
the great hope of this museum that the Yuan-Ti will open their doors to
visitors from outside.  Until then, this exhibit has been created for
your learning pleasure.

name: a pair of abyssal wings
longdesc: A pair of leathery abyssal wings are here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These leathery wings look like they belong to a creature from the deepest,
darkest Abyss.  And maybe they do!

name: A mounting spike
longdesc: A large spike has been embedded in the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spike has been created from the trunk of large oak tree.  It stands
over 7 meters tall and has been reinforced with iron rails and hoops.
The top of the spike has been sharpened and 4 large iron prongs point
out the compass directions.  Clearly this spike is meant to hold some-
thing big and heavy.  But what that is the Midgard Council have yet to
reveal.

name: a skeletal figure
longdesc: A skeletal figure slouches against the wall where it was killed.

extra_descriptions.description:
The corpse itself is positioned in such a way that it looks like its
finger is pointing to some oddly logical scratches on the wall next to 
it.  Whoever this was they took a mighty beating in some long ago time.

name: the Key to Tartarus
longdesc: An evil-looking black key floats an inch above the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This evil-looking black key has been crafted from a solid lump of obsidian
mined from the deepest depths of the realms.  It will open the dark kingdom
of Tartarus.

name: a Cruciform key
longdesc: A Cruciform key with Tarnkak's initials on it lies here.

name: some rags
longdesc: Some filthy rags are here.

extra_descriptions.description: These rags are filthy!

name: a shackle
longdesc: A heavy-looking shackle is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is one of set of wrought iron shackles for the wrists. The metal is strong
and unlikely to be broken easily.

name: a rod of mind control
longdesc: A curved rod decorated with 1000 eyes has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This rod has been formed from some kind of purple-green organic material.
The entire length has been decorated with exactly 1000 eyes.  Yes, you
can even count them.  Each of the eyes seems to move and blink all by
themselves!

name: a ring of hold life
longdesc: A dull grey ring has been trampled into the mud here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring is a dull grey band of steel, but you get the feeling it might protect
you from draining attacks!

name: a wraith spider robe
longdesc: A light-weight black wraith spider robe has dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Stitched from light-weight, black wraith spider silk and adorned with powerful
Drow symbols, this robe would lend you a fancy and rich look at any mages ball.

name: a breastplate of the underdark
longdesc: An black, evil-looking breastplate has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Formed from flexible interlocking wafer-thin plates of adamantium this
breastplate covers the breast from sternum to shoulders and down the
back, with the metal ending in dangerous points that never seem to
pierce or prick the body of the wearer, almost as if it increases
flexibility.

name: a belt of the underdark
longdesc: A black, evil-looking belt has been coiled up here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has formed from thirteen adamantium wraith spiders,
linked together by their front two and back two legs.  The
other four legs stretch out towards their respective cousins,
making it look like a matching chain of arachnids that parade
around the waist.

name: sleeves of the underdark
longdesc: A black and evil-looking set fo sleeves has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These adamantium sleeves have been formed of strips of wafer-thin
adamantium. The inside has been lined with the softest leather.
Even with all those spikes and points, the sleeves feel light as
a feather.

name: adamantium leggings of the Underdark
longdesc: A black and evil-looking set of leggings are here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These leggings have been formed from interlocking scales of wafer-thin
adamantium that have been secured over soft, flexible leather.  The
plates are so light that they hardly feel like they are there at all!
Yet the leggings give you a feeling of increased speed.

name: a wrist guard of the underdark
longdesc: A black and evil-looking wrist guard been piled placed here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wrist guard has been formed from a single, wafer-thin sheet of adamantium.
A rather stylish, and very fancy, wraith spider has been etched in to the metal
and then filled with mithril to make it gleam.

name: a helm of the underdark
longdesc: A black and evil-looking helm sits here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helm has been formed from a single wafer-thin sheaf of adamantium.
The inside has been lined with the softest leather and it fits over the
skull perfectly, offering better protection that the strongest steel.
You feel your IQ increase just wearing it.

name: Warsinger
longdesc: The glaive Warsinger is singing softly to itself at the very edge of hearing.
action: Warsinger roars out a rousing song of battle and victory!!

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from a single, almost white deposit of pure mithril, Warsinger is no
masterpiece of the Drow.  It is clearly Elven in origin, with the swirling
runes and patterns of the ancient elven tree forests.  Perhaps it was even
once part of King Coringor's arsenal.  Either way, it is a magnificent thing
to behold and lives up to its name, for if you listen carefully, you can
hear the rousing chorus of thousands of voices singing songs that will aid
the elven mages in their miriade of battles.

name: A runed adamantium mace
longdesc: A mace lies here, blistering sparks and smoke shoot out from the runes etched on it.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mace is around 90cm long, it has a thin haft formed of adamantium that
has been engraved with fine spider-webs, no more than a hairs breadth across,
and then filled with a highly polished silver that makes them appear to be
real.  In stark contrast, the dark adamantium of the flanges have been rudely
etched with glowing, evil-looking red runes of power that spark and blister
and pop before your eyes.  The handle is a supple, delicate leather, made for
the smaller grip of a female.  This is the weapon of a Drow.

name: a thin black mantle
longdesc: An almost invisible, thin black mantle has been forgotten here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mantle has been made from the thinnest, most lightweight silk you have
ever found.  It is so light that when you put it on, it feels as if you are
wearing air.  Yet when you are hit, it absorbs damage as well as any dwarf-
made iron gorget!

name: a Drow wizard spell pouch
longdesc: A beautiful spell pouch has been dropped here, decorated in spiders and webs.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pouch has been crafted by the Drow for their wizards.  It is roomy, holding all
the books you will need and decorated with tiny jet and ruby spiders that run over
black silk in a random, yet beautiful, distraction.

name: a red beholder central eye
longdesc: A giant eye with a red iris has been left here, it watches your every move.

extra_descriptions.description:
This eyeball has been forcefully ripped from what we hope is the corpse of
a beholder (as opposed to a live one).  It seems to have a life and vitality
all of its own... Creepy.

name: a belt made from human skin
longdesc: Ewww! A belt made from human skin is here! Ack!

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has been made from human skin.  Although gross, it looks
incredibly tough.

name: boots of human skin
longdesc: A very beautiful pair of boots made from a familiar leather have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots have been made from human skin.  Although gross, they look
incredibly tough.

name: Razors Edge
longdesc: A thin silver blade with an ivory handle lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Razors Edge, the name given to this finely made dagger.  The blade has been
forged from a single piece of high-grade silver and hardened somehow to stop
it bending when thrust in to another's rib cage.  The handle is a decoratively
carved piece of whale ivory, depicting several Sahuagin kowtowing to a large
frog-like thing on a throne.

name: a wraith spider skirt
longdesc: A skirt that resembles a wraith spider has been foolishly taken off here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skirt has been made from the leathery corpse of a wraith spider. The legs,
still intact and connected by thin, almost translucent sheets of the spiders
hide, hang from the waist band and flare out viciously when the wearer twirls.
The fangs of the beast have been made in to clasps at the back, and still drip
with venom, warning off any would-be suitor.

name: a wraith spider kaftan
longdesc: A revealing wraith spider kaftan has been crumpled up here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This kaftan consists of an armless robe that is open at the front and fastens
at the waist.  The material has been embroidered with lavish little wraith
spiders that swarm around the bottom in spirals and waves.

name: a polished bronze xiphos
longdesc: A bronze xiphos has been stuck point first in to the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This xiphos is very lavish, if crude in its design and make.  Square-patterned
runes depict a race of sauropods worshipping a frog-like thing under a hill.

name: a polished bronze gorget
longdesc: A highly decorated bronze gorget is turning green with verdigris here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Were it not for the verdigris that mars this gorget, it would be a beautiful
work of art.  Thick, heavy and protective, it is engraved with stories and 
tales of the lizardfolk that made it.

name: the blade of power
longdesc: A sword has been left here.  It appears to fizzle and spark occasionally.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword once belonged to a mighty demon!  The demon stood twelve feet tall
and would kill barbarians for its breakfast.  It's little wonder this weapon
weighs a massive 42 pounds!!  If you can wield it, doubtless you too are a 
barbarian eating fiend from the deepest pits.

name: the Emperor's laurel wreath
longdesc: A wreath of laurel leaves floats here, inches above the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
These laurels have been made in such a way that they actually float above the head.
This seems to lend them a lot of stopping power when it comes to armour coverage.
But don't let that fool you, it seems like it wouldn't take many blows to the head
to destroy them.

name: a pile of corpses
longdesc: Some dead humans have been piled here as food for the beholders.

extra_descriptions.description: There are around 7 corpses in this pile. Maybe they have something you can loot?

name: a bloody cane
longdesc: A blood-splattered cane has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This cane looks like it would be perfect for beating monsters to your will.

name: Horns of the Balor
longdesc: A set of horns have been cleverly crafted in to a helm and dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Although it looks like two horns have been used to the make this helm
on closer inspection you can see that it is actually a single black horn
that has been carefully split down the middle.  The natural curves of
the horn have then been used to merge it with a magnificent adamantium
helm that has a red-enamelled face guard moulded in to that of a snarling
balor demon. It is clearly Drow in origin, and highly magical.  It also
looks like you can open a door with it...

name: the flaming whip
longdesc: A demonic whip burns here, as if on fire!
action: slash

extra_descriptions.description:
This whip is the real extension of a demonic being.  Once owned by a powerful
Balor, it burns with the fiends' life energy, causing it to sear the flesh of
enemies and leave the air reeking with the smell of burnt meat.  Be very care
-ful when holding this, for you can be sure that the Balor it belonged to is
seeking it from its dark pit.

name: a mithril bracelet
longdesc: A mithril bracelet of some old Drow design has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This delicate band of mithril would look amazing adorning your arm. Why not 
try it on?

longdesc: A giant eye with a purple iris has been left here, it watches your every move.

extra_descriptions.description:

name: an emperor beholder central eye
longdesc: A giant evil eye has been left here, it watches your every move.

extra_descriptions.description:
This eyeball has been forcefully ripped from what we hope is the corpse of
a beholder (as opposed to a live one).  It seems to have a life and vitality
all of its own... Creepy.

name: a Drow piwafwi cloak
longdesc: A Drow piwafwi cloak has been left crumpled in a heap here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The cloak can be made in every possible shape with just about
every type of fabric. The most common forms are a circular
piece of fabric with a hole in the center for the head, and
fabric draped from neck, connected by a chain, brooch, cord,
or pins. Talented drow weavers have woven strands of
adamantine into this cloak, thus rendering it useless if
exposed to the light -- the effect of which will turn the
cloak to dust.

name: a sigil of House Misraria
longdesc: A small sigil has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sigil is a thin disc of adamantium on a leather thong.  
It is engraved with the symbol of House Misraria.

name: Gauntlets of the Pit
longdesc: A pair of darkly runed gauntlets have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Specially made to enhance the strength of something physically weak, magical
runes flare hotly over the wrist guards and the back of the hand, never quite
touching the black metal.

name: a Link of the Pit
longdesc: A circular link spins here, endlessly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This circular band of silver seems to be forever in perpetual motion.  When
you put it over your wrist you can feel it pressing in to your flesh, as if
it tries to feed off you or something you are doing.  There is an uncanny
feeling that it is sentient and understands what you are saying...

name: a smokey grey potion
longdesc: A smokey grey potion lies here discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
From outside the bottle, this potion just looks like a mess of swirling
clouds, like those found in the very heart of a thunderstorm.  Looking
closely, you can see tiny flashes that illuminate the clouds for a micro-
second, like bolts of lightning.  Still want to quaff this?

name: a gloopy brown potion
longdesc: A gloopy brown potion lies here discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
Whatever is in this bottle, you sure hope it isn't what it looks like.
Thick, brown, gloopy.  There's a familiar smell to it as well.  You are
seriously not going to quaff it, right?

name: a translucent-white potion
longdesc: A translucent-white potion lies here discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
This potion seems to be filled with some sort of translucent-white
fluid.  It reminds you of snot without the green tinge.  I bet you
want to quaff it now.

name: a sin black potion
longdesc: A sin black potion lies here discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
The only reason this potion is coloured sin black is because the
bottle itself has been dyed that colour.  It's almost impossible
to tell the colour of the liquid inside, but you can at least take
a whiff of it's odour...  Blackberries, oats, a hint of sage.  Even
though you can't see inside, it smells like a dream.  Yum!

name: a demonhide cloak
longdesc: A rugged but spectacular-looking cloak of demonhide has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The leather of this cloak is gloriously purple that fades to a light,
grassy green at the edges.  It should be hideous but something about
it catches the eye and the soul.  Inlaid with the finest spider-silk
and hemmed in the most expensive cloth-of-gold, it is a wondrously
lavish item to behold and will make you the star of Midgard's high
society balls.

name: an Amulet of Eternal Darkness
longdesc: An amulet of eternal darkness lies forgotten on the floor.

extra_descriptions.description:
This amulet is actually just a disc of strange, dark stone that has been
engraved with magical runes that glow an eerie blue just above the surface
of the disc.  It's probably not going to help you in a fight, but it might
be a comfort in times when there isn't much light to be had.

name: Banded Leather Boots
longdesc: A pair of banded leather boots have been kicked around here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots have been made from highly polished bands of toughened leather.  For all
their impracticality, they sure do make your feet look good.

name: a large barrel
longdesc: A large barrel is here, full of stuff for playtesters to test.

name: The Eye of Naxxramas
longdesc: A glowing, evil-looking, eye is here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}The Eye of Naxxramas stares wildly around for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Naxxramas was once the most powerful beholder to walk... ermm... Float in the
darkness beneath the world.  Legend has it that Naxxramas lives in a floating
ziggurat somewhere below us... Legends are great, aren't they?

name: The Mindbender
longdesc: A writhing, horrible-looking tentacle has been dropped here.  Yuck!
item_ability_msg: #{yellow}Mindbender digs deep in to someone's brains for a moment and then grows still.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
The Mindbender looks like a tentacle severed from the face of a mind flayer.
Whatever its origins, it is a disgusting slimy thing covered in more goo and
snot than your average three year old kid.

name: a token good for one extra permenant strength point
longdesc: A quest winner has carelessly left a token good for one strength point here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: Bring this token to any Implementor or Asst. Implementor to claim your prize.

longdesc: A quest winner has carelessly left a token good for one intelligence point here on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description: Bring this token to any Implementor or Asst. Implementor to claim your prize.

extra_descriptions.description: Bring this token to any Implementor or Asst. Implementor to claim your prize.

extra_descriptions.description: Bring this token to any Implementor or Asst. Implementor to claim your prize.

name: a belt of golden discs
longdesc: A fine belt made of golden discs sparkles in the dirt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt is made up of many golden discs, each one 5 inches in
diameter and linked together by an ingenious system of hooks and
claws.  The only indication that this was made by the skinks of
Dark Horn Hill are the crude rectangular engravings that each of
the discs and pronounce Krocoatl to be the one true Goddess.

name: a wicked-looking spike
longdesc: A strange spike has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This spike seems to be the last few tail bones, along with the
muscles and tendons, of a doomed lizardman.  The bones seem to
have been fused somehow in to a very hard substance that does
not appear to have the same consistency as normal bone.  Along 
with the muscles and tendons that are still attached and still
able to work, the spike is also very flexible, allowing it to
bend and move around kinks in armours that other knives might
not find.  The handle is wrapped in the bright green and cyan
belly scales of the same creature this was originally taken
from.  Yet the craftsmanship is such that the scales are smooth
and supple, giving the wielder a sure grip.  It is unlikely to
a very accurate weapon, but it looks like it will cause severe
damage when it does find the mark.

name: A sash of colourful scales
longdesc: Some green, blue and cyan scales have been heaped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sash is around 4 inches in diameter and is long enough
to slip over one shoulder and ring around the opposite waist.
An ingenious set of scales that divide and and tighten to fit
the wearer allows the sash to sit comfortably on all frames,
snug and secure. It is composed of the scales of lizardmen
(plural).  How many of those creatures had to die to create
this is unknown, but in its own way, it is a beautiful thing.

name: Biter
longdesc: A crude iron cleaver is here with the name B I T E R scratched in to the blade.

extra_descriptions.description:
At first glance Biter appears to be nothing more than a crude
handaxe or cleaver.  The blade is iron and is connected to a
wooden and leather haft where an old hessian rope acts like a
grip.  The iron though... There is something special about it
(aside from the fact the previous owner scratched his name deep
in to metal); it almost glows blue and seems free of rust.  It
also seems to be hungry for something.

name: layered and patched steel sabatons
longdesc: A pair sabatons made of mishmash steel have been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These sabatons have been made from a mishmash of ancient steel that
has been bent in to shape by something strong.  It has been patched
and then layered over and over to make it very, very strong.  The
process (for want of a better word) looks crude but effective, as
if the maker understood the importance of plate, but not the forging
of it.

name: Ring of the Master Dragonslayer
longdesc: A ring of green and red scales lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
There is a legend, and it goes a little something like this; there was
once a lizardman hero who was so powerful that he created an empire that
spanned the world.  As the empire grew so the number of challenges
dwindled until he heard tale of a mighty dragon Goddess who resided deep
inside Mount Pyragaard.  Taking his blade Windfury he set forth to slay
the beast.  But the Goddess was too powerful and, after a lengthy
struggle, she towered over him ready to take the kill.  But she stopped,
for some reason.  "Take this ring," She told him, "in exchange for your
blade, for you have come close where all others have failed.  He took the
gift, the ring you hold now, and left the dragon Goddess to sleep in her
mountain.

name: Helm of the Lizardman Champion
longdesc: A chitinous helm in the shape of a lizardman skull has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helm is actually the skull of a bipedal dinosaur adorned with
colourful feathers and beads that rattle and clack and generally
draw attention to the wearer.  It is impressive, and even though
it is made of bone, seems to over some amazing protection.  Some
kind of powerful magic has been used in its construction.

name: a lizardman fetish
longdesc: A small straw and cloth fetish has been left here - it looks like a little lizardman.

extra_descriptions.description:
This fetish has been crafted from straw, cotton and wood.  At first
glance it looks worthless, a child's toy that has gotten lost and
soggy.  But a closer inspection shows that this ins't some mere item
to play with.  Magic entwines it, bonds it, strengthens it.  This
little doll would likely be a powerful talisman to whomever wore it
in battle.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pair of gauntlets made out of mismatched bits of plate and steel.
They have a magical glow and fit any hand! Provided said hand had fingers
like sausages. Bratwurst ones.

item_ability_msg: #{red}The token of the Red Strider pulses like a heart for a moment!#{o}

This token is a disc of greenish, verdigris-stained bronze with a stamp of
a frog's head on one side and a likeness of the Red Strider* on the other.

*The Red Strider is the famed mount of Qing-Qong, greatest of the Lizardmen 
 Heros.

item_ability_msg: #{cyan bold}The heart strings make a last hopeful tingle before falling silent.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
These are the ancient and withered heart strings of a long dead human.  The only
way they could have survived for so long would be if they were taken from the
fetid remains of a wight.

And when it is worn on your finger it looks like a hole in space.

item_ability_msg: #{magenta}The staff of True Night fades out of existence for a moment!#{o}

carved in to the face of young woman... But as you watch, her face
contorts and screams, mutating in to a foul and terrible visage.
