lobstered guards that extend down the arms, thighs and up
around the neck to provide excellent protection all round.
The mithril has been carved by an expert hand and beautiful
silver fish leap and dance around a stylised Saguagin head
that proudly sits in the dead centre of the chest area.

name: intricately detailed silver shield
longdesc: A highly decrotive round silver shield has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shield is made from a thick, yet light, layer of mithril
that has been expertly fashioned in to a shield. The inside is
covered in red satin and is padded where your arm attaches to
provide maximum comfort. The outside is embossed with beautiful
silver fish that leap and dance around the circumference and a
fiercely stylised Sahuagin head snarls in the centre.

name: a skirt of intricately detailed silver pleats
longdesc: A highly decrotive skirt of silver pleats has dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skirt is made of dark leather pleats with thick strips of
mithril expertly attached to give the impression of incredible
flexibility. Each pleat is made of twenty
strips of mithril. Each strip of mithril has also been decorated
which, individually, looks random, but when combined with the
gives the effect of hundreds of beautifully glittering silver
fish leaping and dancing around the hem in a swirl of water. The
effect is so good you can almost feel life flow from the skirt.

name: intricately detailed silver armguards
longdesc: A set of highly decrotive silver armguards have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These armguards have been fashioned from interlocking lobstered
bands of mithril, cunningly attached to each to allow freedom of
movement and maximum possible protection. Each band is cleverly
detailed with leaping and glittering fish and, as the bands move
and interlock with each other, waves rise and sway and retreat
again in an endlessly beautiful oceanic dance.

name: intricately detailed silver crested mask helmet
namelist: helmet mask crested silver detailed intricately
longdesc: A highly decorated crested helmet with a full face mask has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.keywords: intricately detailed silver crested mask helmet
extra_descriptions.description:
This mask has is a work of art in itself. Formed from three cunningly
connected pieces of mithril, each lined with the softest of red satin;
a crest, running from forelock to neck, the helmet itself and a mask
that has been so cunningly created it clings to the wearers face and
moves like real skin. The crest has been styled like a dolphin riding
a wave, it's tail flippers fanning out and protecting the neck. The
helmet has been decorated to look like waves swirling and rising in
the dolphins wake and the effect is such, as you move the item, the
waves rise and fall and spray seems to fly in a blur of motion. But
the mask takes your breath away; it is a stylised rendition of a
Sahuagin. Made from hundreds of tiny hexagonal panels it clings to
your face and mimics your expressions... Scary!

name: the Unholy Avenger
longdesc: There is a big, gleaming sword here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged by the Elven smiths in times long past, the original name of this
mighty weapon was Quel-de'lar.  Wielded by the mightiest heroes of the
Elven nations, it was thought lost during Prince Nuahlon's assault on
the Realms.  Renamed the Unholy Avenger, this hand-and-a-half sword has
a long, red- tinted and double-edged blade that flares at the base and
again just above the midsection, putting you in mind of a delicate, 
feminine figure.  The cross piece is an asymmetric curve of bright red
metal, stylised with  oses and thorns that come to a needle point. 
Wrapped in soft, supple red leather, the hilt provides a sure grip and
leads the eye down to the pummel where a circle of the same red metal
as the cross piece plays host to two gem slots.

name: a jagged wand
longdesc: A jagged wand looks to be disrupting the very air here.

name: a glowing, sickly white mushroom
longdesc: A glowing, sickly white mushroom is growing here in the damp, fetid cave.

name: Commandants' sash
longdesc: A fine silk sash lies crumpled in a heap here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sash is the decorative wear of the Yuan-Ti Commandant. It
is a rare honour for any Yuan-Ti to adorn this sash.  It is said
that the item was woven by the Elves long ago as a peace offering 
with the Yuan-Ti and contains many potent magical enchantments.  
But unless you pull it off of the cold dead corpse of Quee'Quee, 
you're not going to have much luck confirming that.

name: Commandants' tail ring
longdesc: A wide gold ring has been left here for you to take.

extra_descriptions.description:
This golden ring has been crafted to resemble a Yuan-Ti tail
that wraps around and around in what appears to be a never-
ending coil.

name: Commandants' warhammer
longdesc: A fine warhammer with gold etchings on the head and spike has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This war hammer is actually delicate enough to be wielded in
one hand like a normal hammer, but with all the explosive
energy you'd come to associate with a warhammer.  The head
and tail are made of a red iron that seems to glow when you
grip it.  Etched in to the metal is a series of swirls and
glyphs, filled with gold, that gleam and shine and make the
weapon appear to have a lift of it's own.  The handle is a
single piece of cedar wood, fire-hardened and treated with a
lacquer that leaves the wood gleaming orange.  The grip is
made of red leather, possibly from a lizardman, that moulds
to your grip and keeps you sure and balanced.

name: a gold and silver tiara
longdesc: A beautiful gold and silver tiara lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This delicate gold and silver tiara belongs to Queen Agamagdon.
What are you doing with it?

name: a gold and silver crown
longdesc: A magnificent gold and silver crown lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This magnificent gold and silver crown belongs to King Surrekh.
What are you doing with it?

name: the captains harness
longdesc: A bundle of leather straps have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
At first glance these leather straps look like they are just haphazardly
put together, the leather clasped and bound by heavy gold discs.  However,
once this has been worn correctly, it actually provides a lot of protection
whilst allowing the wearer to move with grace and ease, unburdened by the
weight of heavier, less effective armours.

name: a sword bracer
longdesc: A heavy iron bracer has been dropped here engraved with a sword.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bracer is heavy.  It appears to have been forged of high-grade iron.
There is a rather fetching engraving of a sword on it, picked out in gold
filigree.

name: a hammer bracer
longdesc: A delicate iron bracer has been dropped here engraved with a hammer.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bracer is delicate and light.  It appears to have been forged of 
thin strips of high-grade iron. There is a rather fetching engraving 
of a hammer on it, picked out in gold filigree.

name: a white wimple
longdesc: A lovely white wimple has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wimple has been sewn from a soft, white fabric that would
delicate brush your face and forehead and leave you feeling at
peace with your fashion choices.

name: a grey wimple
longdesc: A lovely grey wimple has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wimple has been sewn from a soft, grey fabric that would
delicate brush your face and forehead and leave you feeling at
peace with your fashion choices.

name: a black wimple
longdesc: A lovely black wimple has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wimple has been sewn from a soft, black fabric that would
delicate brush your face and forehead and leave you feeling at
peace with your fashion choices.

name: a splattered apron
longdesc: A used apron has been left here.  It appears to be covered in vomit.

extra_descriptions.description:
This apron has been used by a matron to raise Yuan-Ti young.  It is
covered in gooey vomit.

name: an orarion
longdesc: A lovely orarion has been carefully folded and left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This orarion is made of silk.  It is about six inches wide and around
six feet long.  The material has been finely decorated with runes and
glyphs of the Yuan-Ti religion, showing a six-armed goddess with the
head and torso of a human and the body of a snake.  Every depiction
of the goddess on the orarion has a matt-black background that looks
like a multi-tentacled beast in a starburst formation.

name: ring of arcane power
longdesc: A powerful looking ring has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring is made of the living flesh of a sacrificed Yuan-Ti wizard.
The scales have been bent and twisted and then woven together whilst
the victim was still alive and then powerful magics have made it so
that the ring writhes and constricts around the wearers finger, like
it fights to be removed.  No doubt full of powerful properties, it is
not the nicest thing to put on.

name: sorcerous band
longdesc: A powerful looking band has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band of powerful magical energies has obviously been forged
by the Drow of the Underdark.  Made of adamantium, it has been
inlaid with gold and jewels that seem to move and swirl on the
surface in a never-ending, ever-repeating dance.

name: belt of ancestors
longdesc: A beautiful belt has been coiled up here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This lovely belt is an heirloom of the Yuan-Ti royal family.  It has
been embossed with depictions of past Kings, each displaying their
accomplishments.  It ends at the current King, Surrekh, opening the
Yuan-Ti home to outsiders for the first time in a millenia.

name: crown of ages
longdesc: A beautiful gold crown has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This loop of gold is almost an inch thick and weighs so much that
you would need a potion of giant strength to just keep it on your
head for a day, let alone a life time!  It has been inlaid with
diamonds, pearls, sapphires and rubies, creating a beautiful yet
gaudy symbol of Yuan-Ti authority.

name: king's mantel
longdesc: A purple and red silk mantel has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mantel has been finely sewn from the most delicate sheets of red
and purple silk.  Only a king would wear such a garment... Or a filthy
murdering adventurer who has invaded another's home and killed their
leader.

name: a fountain
longdesc: A decorative snake fountain gushing with refreshing water is standing here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This fountain has been built in to the sandstone walls using the same
precision chiselling as the rest of the cavern.  Snakes have been made
to writhe and slither all over every surface, culminating in a knot at
the very centre that sends a jet of water up a few feet in to the air
so that it comes splashing down playfully in to the water.  The water
looks lovely and fresh.

name: a greasy burger in a bun
longdesc: A very greasy burger in a bun is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This looks like it will give you heart burn and seriously greasy
fingers.

name: a wilting ham sandwich
longdesc: A ham sandwich is here, the bread just starting to curl.

extra_descriptions.description: This will give you the farts...

name: a slice of pepperoni pizza
longdesc: A slice of pepperoni pizza has been dropped here, cheese side down.

extra_descriptions.description: This looks oddly edible for one of Al Boggins' culinary masterpieces.

name: a bowl of goblin stew
longdesc: A bowl of what looks like green bogey's has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: It looks like a bowl of bogey's.  Straight from a goblins nose.  Yum!

name: a bowl of fiery-hot chilli
longdesc: A bowl of what looks like lava steams gently here.

extra_descriptions.description:
It looks hot... There's that... But going to the toilet the next day will
be... Interesting.

name: a bowl of curried eyeballs
longdesc: A bowl of what looks like eyes has been left here to gross people out.

extra_descriptions.description:
Goats eyes, not human ones.  They've been curried so the whites are now
yellower than a smokers ceiling.

name: a plate of spicy Zurt slices
longdesc: A plate of wobbling, fatty mass is here.  Looks like it belongs to Zurt.

extra_descriptions.description:
This plate of wobbly purple bits might once have belonged to Zurt.  It is fatty,
full of sugar and bad for you.

name: a red-hot kebab
longdesc: A kebab, liberally covered in hot-sauce, has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This kebab consists of a pitta bread sliced open, stuffed with some kind
of nameless meat, garnished with diced lettuce, onions and tomatoes and
then covered in copious amounts of hot-sauce to the point at which one
may ask, 'May I have some kebab with my hot-sauce, please?'.

name: a bag of chips
longdesc: A bag of chips has been left here...

extra_descriptions.description:
In a distant world, two clans fought over the chip.  For the former the 
chip was a thickly allumette-cut deep fried potato.  But the latter 
called these culinary delights the French Fry.  To the latter, the chip
was a deep-fried, very thin slice of potato that was crunchy.  But the
former called these equally awesome culinary delights crisps.  Centuries
long wars were fought over this.  Luckily in this land the chip is an
oily, sodden baton of potato that has been deep fried until it is softer
than a gelatinous cube, soaked in vinegar and lashed with more salt than
your average sea-side town in a gale.  Your arteries will thank you for
not eating it.

name: a Scooby snack
longdesc: A portion of fried dog has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a portion of dog that has been fried and seasoned with herbs.
At least, you hope they are herbs.  They are green anyway.

name: a festive orange
longdesc: This is a lovely, plump orange given to you as a gift at Christmas.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a beautiful festive orange.  Perfect for a stocking filler.

name: some festive nuts
longdesc: This is a lovely selection of nuts given to you as a gift at Christmas.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a beautiful selection of nuts.  Perfect for a stocking filler.

name: some chocolate coins
longdesc: These are some gold-foil wrapped chocolates given to you as a gift at Christmas.

extra_descriptions.description: These are some beautiful gold-foil wrapped chocolates.  Perfect for a stocking filler.

name: Bob's festive scarf
longdesc: A green and red scarf with 'BOB' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This scarf has been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Pixilator's festive mittens
longdesc: A green and red pair of mittens with 'PIXILATOR' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: These mittens have been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Celesta's festive pillow
longdesc: A green and red pillow with 'CELESTA' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This pillow has been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Lance's festive socks
longdesc: A green and red pair of socks with 'LANCE' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: These socks have been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Uma's festive shorts
longdesc: A green and red pair of shorts with 'UMA' embroidered across the butt has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: These shorts have been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Thrash's festive spliff
longdesc: A green and red spliff with 'ThRAsh' written in sharpie on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This spliff looks soggy but also looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Arturian's festive bobble-hat
longdesc: A green and red bobble-hat with 'ARTURIAN' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This bobble-hat has been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Villers's festive candle
longdesc: A green and red candle with 'VILLER' written on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is what you get instead of coal for being on Santa's bad list.

name: Vivi's festive sweater
longdesc: A green and red sweater with 'VIVI' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This sweater has been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: Koral's festive blanket
longdesc: A green and red blanket with 'KORAL' embroidered on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This blanket has been knitted from brightly coloured wool.  It looks like it was lovingly made.

name: a Christmas present
longdesc: A wrapped Christmas present, with a bow on top, sits on the ground.

name: a festive fireplace
longdesc: A fireplace made from stone is set against the east wall.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made from roughly cut stone and decorated with a long, heavy timber mantle-
piece, with a welcoming, roaring fire in the hearth, this fireplace is an
ideal candidate for hanging up those festive stockings during the holiday
period.

name: Bob's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Bob hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Bob.

name: Celesta's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Celesta hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Celesta.

name: Arturian's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Arturian hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Arturian.

name: Arturian's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Arturian hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Arturian.

name: Arturian's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Arturian hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Arturian.

name: Arturian's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Arturian hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Arturian.

name: Arturian's festive stocking
longdesc: A stocking for Arturian hangs here.

extra_descriptions.description: A stocking of presents for Arturian.

name: a pretty pet kitten
longdesc: A little pink kitten is here, just begging to be picked up and kept as a pet. Mew! Mew!

extra_descriptions.description:
This little kitten has vibrant pink fur.  The name "Pinkie" can be seen on
her adorably pink collar. She paws at you, begging to  be picked up and
held and loved forever and ever. Mew! Mew! Purr!

name: an essence of doom
longdesc: A gooey essence of a doom has been left here for someone else to clean up. Huh! Some people are so rude!

extra_descriptions.description: This is the gooey remains of a doom.  Give it to an immortal.

name: a tattered cloak of power
longdesc: An old and tattered cloak has been left here.  It looks to be half eaten!  Yuck!

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak comes complete with high collars that surround the wearers head,
giving that age-old 'I'm A Sorcerer' look to all who wear it.  The material
is tatty and shredded, much like it has been eaten by insects and then left
at the bottom of the laundry basket to fester.  No doubt there's a zombie
somewhere who would look dapper in this once-fancy piece of outerwear.

name: Buntagonamadon's Breadth
longdesc: A horrible, slimy, writhing tentacle belonging to Buntagonamadon is here... Writhing.
item_ability_msg: #{yellow}Buntagonamadon's Breadth clings to you with its suckers for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This is one of the tentacles of the legendary god, Buntagonamadon.

name: a Bob-shaped top hat
longdesc: A top hat shaped like Bob has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a black cloth top hat with a fancy buckle.  It is in the shape of
Bob.  That's very surprising!

name: a Nicholaa-shaped top hat
longdesc: A top hat shaped like Nicholaa has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a black cloth top hat with a fancy buckle.  It is in the shape of
Nicholaa.  That's very surprising!

name: a Viller-shaped top hat
longdesc: A top hat shaped like Viller has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a black cloth top hat with a fancy buckle.  It is in the shape of
Viller.  That's very surprising!

name: a Tyro-shaped top hat
longdesc: A top hat shaped like Tyro has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a black cloth top hat with a fancy buckle.  It is in the shape of
Tyro.  That's very surprising!

name: a Bob-flavoured Guiness
longdesc: A pint of Bob-flavoured Guiness has been left here.  Sounds... Earthy...

name: a Nicholaa-flavoured Guiness
longdesc: A pint of Nicholaa-flavoured Guiness has been left here.  Sounds... Yum...

name: a Viller-flavoured Guiness
longdesc: A pint of Viller-flavoured Guiness has been left here.  Sounds... Yum...

name: a Tyro-flavoured Guiness
longdesc: A pint of Tyro-flavoured Guiness has been left here.  Sounds... Yum...

name: a Four-Leafed Clover
longdesc: A sparkling four-leafed clover has been left here for you to pick.  Lucky!

extra_descriptions.description:
This four-leafed clover is actually an exquisitely-cut emerald of very high quality.
Each leaf is thin as a hair, and all are connected by a perfect translucent stem in
the middle.  This would be an amazing adornment.

name: a coded message
longdesc: A message, written on velum, has been left foolishly left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Strangely the letters seem to be dispersed as if to form words yet they
seem to be encrypted in some manner... Strange...

name: Dream Stinger
longdesc: The stinger cut from Tiamat's tail is here, dripping with dangerous venom.

extra_descriptions.description:
Dream Stinger is actually the barbed, venomous stinger from the tail
of Tiamat.  Although it was once a part of the Dragon Goddess' body,
it is now a rather useful dagger, replete with bone and sinew handle
for comfortable wielding.  The only issue is the venom that continu-
ously leaks from the needle-pointed barb at the tip.  Licking this
weapon would be extremely silly.

name: the key to the Mountain Pass
longdesc: A huge key with a crude mountain embossed on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This large, heavy key appears to have been made to open something big.

name: the key to Helsengard
longdesc: A huge key with a long house symbol embossed on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This large, heavy key appears to have been made to open the long house know as Helsengard.

name: the key to Mount Pyragard
longdesc: A huge key with a moutain symbol embossed on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This large, heavy key appears to have been made to open the gates to Mount Pyragard.

name: the key to the Pyragard Prison
longdesc: A huge key with a prison symbol embossed on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This large, heavy key appears to have been made to open the prisons inside Mount Pyragard.

name: The Bindings of the Stormreaver
longdesc: The Bindings of the Stormreaver have been left here for some reason.

extra_descriptions.description:
This looks to be part of a sword, but its hard to tell
what part or even how it will be used.  There is no handle
and the blade, which seems to be curved but only half formed,
as if there is a whole other part to it, looks like it would
break under the least strenuous of conditions.  There is a
small inscription at the base of the blade.

They came from Dark Horn Hill.  Pouring over the bog and
spilling out in to the world.  I knew that which they sought
and so I rendered it in to two, the bindings and the core.
The core was lost in the battles with them, but I have the
bindings.
- Knutt.

name: The Core of the Stormreaver
longdesc: The Core of the Stormreaver has been left here for some reason.

extra_descriptions.description:
This looks to be part of a sword, but its hard to tell
what part of even how it will be used.  There is a handle,
and part of the blade, which seems to be curved up and over
as it to hook around something.  It seems to be only half
formed though, and likely to fall apart under even the best
of conditions.  There is a small inscription at the base
of the handle.

He broke it.  But it might salvageable if only we can find
him.  He has been defeated by a new King, a lesser King,
without the knowledge of the smiths, with that cursed five
headed dragon protecting their mountain.  We have waited a
millenia to get hold of it.  We can wait a while longer.
- Written in the language of the Slaadi.

name: Chromed Scales of Tiamat
longdesc: a chromed dragon scale glimmers brightly on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
The scales seem to be meshed into a perfect pattern giving them
a chrome-like appearance that glimmers in the light.

name: Chromed Sleeves of Tiamat
longdesc: chromed dragon scales lie in the form of sleeves here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The scales seem to be meshed into a perfect pattern giving them
a chrome-like appearance that glimmers in the light.

name: Chromatic Claws
longdesc: A set of Chromatic dragon scale lies in the form of a pair of claws here.

extra_descriptions.description: the claw is bloodstained and has been used to carry endless victims.

name: The Red Dragon Head of Tiamat
longdesc: The bloody and severed red dragon head of Tiamat makes a mess on the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the severed and bloody red head of Tiamat.  It steams in the
air as if its red hot.  You could probably eat it if you wanted.

name: Sword Breaker
longdesc: Sword Breaker has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Sword Breaker is a shield unlike any other.  It is rectangular and
curved for better defence.  It has strange spiky beaks dotted across
the front and a soft and supple leather lining and arm strap that
is comfortable to hold and protects the wearer from shocking impacts.
The beaks themselves all look alive, like tiny Wyvern beaks ready to
snap and rend anything that touches them.  Coloured a creamy green,
this shield would probably clash with your really cool outfit.

name: a Dragon Hound tooth
longdesc: A tooth from a Dragon Hound has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This tooth appears to be a canine extracted from the mouth of a Dragon
Hound.  It's a little bit blackened and discoloured, probably from all
the sugar the Dragon Hound was eating during early life...   It looks
like it will make an excellent weapon.

name: stone striking hammer
longdesc: A large hammer for splitting apart boulder's has be dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This large hammer would be perfect for striking and smashing stones.  It has a
large, square granite block for a head and an oak haft reinforced with leather
and twine.  Runes have been carved in to the head in an attempt to give it a
mystical appeal, but clearly there was a typo because whatever magic it was
supposed to call upon hasn't worked.  Still, this hammer is so instinctive that
even a babe could wield it (if they could pick up a 20 pound hammer).

name: Hausakljufr
longdesc: The axe Hausakljufr is sticking in the wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Hausakljufr is not just an axe.  Hausakljufr is an axe with a name, and a
history, and a power far exceeding your own.  The head is formed from high
grade steel and embossed with snowflakes (cute).  The haft is made of dark
blackberry wood, reinforced with oiled leather and decorative straps.  The
owner of this axe has certainly taken care of it over the years.  No wonder
it has such a cool and easily pronounced name.

name: the severed hand of King Harald
longdesc: A giant severed hand has been left here.  Gross.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the severed hand of the Fire Giant, King Harald.  Why was it severed,
you may ask?  Well, in the Perilous Realms, people don't need an excuse to do
gory things with corpse parts.  So best not to ask, really.  Perhaps the wise
August Arcana will be able to tell you something about it?

name: Chromatic Sash
longdesc: A chromatic sash lies in a tangle on the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sash has been formed from the Chromatic scales of the Draconic Goddess, 
Tiamat.  Each scale is a different shade of red, blue, green, white and black,
perfectly matching the multiple hues of the Terrible Deity.  You certainly feel
like those magic competitions down the Silver Feather Tavern will go your way
now!  No more bunny stuffed in a hat for you, it's sawing ladies in half and
eating swords all the way now!

name: Chromatic Vestments
longdesc: Some rather nice chromatic vestments have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These vestments have been made from the Chromatic Scales of the dragon
Goddess Tiamat.  Like a sleeveless robe, these vestments shimmer with
all the different colours of the Chromatic dragonkin - black, white,
green, red and blue.  You can feel a sense of power just from donning
this very fine garment, as if all those hours spent alone in your room
with a deck of cards and a poster of David Blaine will now be worth it.

name: Chromatic Slippers
longdesc: A pretty pair of Chromatic Slippers has been left here for all and sundry to wear.

extra_descriptions.description:
These multi-coloured Chromatic scale slippers are just the most darling
little things ever seen.  The overlapping scales start around thumb-
size near the ankle and get smaller and smaller as they taper down to
the toes and end in a long, fashionable curl.  These slippers are the
the must-have accessory for the cat-walk ready wizard.

name: Wings of the Chromatic Dragon Goddess
longdesc: A large pair of chromatic wings are here, fluttering in the breeze.

extra_descriptions.description:
These are the wings of Tiamat.  They are surprisingly light for something so
large.  They are covered in tiny, almost translucent, chromatic scales that
shimmer like oil on water, sometimes red, sometimes black, or green, or blue
or white.  When they are worn they flare out wide and flap like a dragon
taking to the air, occasionally knocking foes to the ground.

name: the Spike Collar
longdesc: A large red collar with gleaming yellow spikes on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The collar is made from a wide strip of very heavy, very thick red
leather.  It doesn't so much go around your neck as hang around your head
like a deflated tyre.  Punctuated along the centre of the collar is a row
of gleaming yellow spikes.  Strangely, the spikes are not made of gold.
It probably belonged to a big dog; the type of dog that would take the
side of a little brown mouse and punch a blue furred cat for fun.

name: Runed Boots of Burning Shadows
longdesc: A pair of deep black boots covered in burning runes stand here neatly.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pair of sleek, black leather boots that come to up just below
the knee.  The leather has been embossed with runes that glow a dull,
dark red and give off a living shadow-like aura that rises up and melts
away in to the air.  They are clearly of Drow origin, and are likely to
be very, very magical.  I'd go and get an identify scroll right now and
find out what goodies you've just picked up!

name: the Basilisk Strike
longdesc: A very fine black stiletto has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a delicate, thin stiletto made from a sliver of perfectly carved
onyx.  The blade has been etched so that near the hilt a howling, baying
basilisk raises its head and sends curling, smoking lines of acid towards
the needle-tip of the blade.  The hilt looks hollow, like it contains a
thick liquid that will filter down those very lines and stab and burn the
flesh of anything it touches.

name: the Salamander Kiss
longdesc: A very fine red stiletto has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a delicate, thin stiletto made of a dark red ruby that glows with
its own, eerie, inner fire.  The blade has been carved in such a way that
it is reminiscent of a wavering candle flame.  Dark, ghostly smoke swirls
and poofs from its length, and the occasional ember falls from the cross-
hilt as if the weapon is in a perpetual state of burning.

name: the Wyvern Sting
longdesc: A very fine green stiletto has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a delicately curved sliver of emerald that has been shaped in to
a wyvern's stinger.  A set of bubbles in the emerald near the hilt act
like venom glands, feeding a thick, viscous goo down a set of channels
on each side of the blade, culminating in a nasty-looking drip that hangs
from the needle-like tip.  Being stabbed with this would surely be bad
for ones health.

name: the Spectral Embrace
longdesc: A very fine white stiletto has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a pale, ghostly blade that seems to to be as insubstantial as air
and yet as tactile as steel.  Made from icy-clear diamond, the chill of the
grave seems to rise from it, causing the air around it to steam in little
puffs and billows.  It is as if the soul of a spectre was condensed down
and trapped in the form of a stiletto, eager to freeze the flesh of the
living.

name: the Stormrager Heart
longdesc: A very fine blue stiletto has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a twisted, spiralling, length of razor sharp sapphire that has
been carved in to the likeness of a great and powerful elemental.  The
cross-hilt has been shaped like claws made from lightning, that fork out
and rake at the very air whilst the blade zigs and zags up to a needle-
like point.  Tiny sparks, jolts, and crackles of electricity run up and
down the blade, promising a shock to anyone unfortunate enough to be
stabbed with it.

name: the Crown of Embers
longdesc: A crown of sparking, fiery embers has been set aside here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This crown has been made from a loop of Drow-forged adamantium. It has been
inlaid with precious gemstones that form a cascade of fiery flames rising
from the loop all the way from the ears to the forehead.  The gemstones --
glowing yellow opals, fiery rubies, deep orange ambers, and cool-white
diamonds -- each spark and sputter with magic, causing a veil of embers to
fall in front of the wearers face.

name: Ironfel
longdesc: The legendary hammer Ironfel is displayed magnificently here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is Ironfel, the foe-hammer, the iron-death, the reaper of the elves.
And well earned are each of the names given to this magnificent hammer.
The head is formed from a single block of lunar iron, forged with the
skill of the dwarfs, and inlaid with sacred runes and sigils for momentum.
The haft is a simple fire-hardened length of dwarfish-apple wood wrapped
in ancient leathers for grip.  Wielding this rarity will turn you in to a
heroic-psychopathic-tyrannosaurus-killing-machine... Maybe.

name: Hide of Fenris
longdesc: Fenris' thick hide has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thick hide of brownish-red fur fits snuggly around your entire body.
Wearing it you feel like you could stand as Warden of the North, vigilant
to the horrors beyond the wall... Whatever that may be.  It is very warm
and has lots of leather straps for you to buckle up and look like a real
hero.

name: Yeti fur cloak
longdesc: A cloak of super-warm Yeti fur has been hung on a peg here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made from the hide of a yeti, this cloak imbues the wearer with all the
things that make the Yeti so scary.  Also, the Yeti probably isn't so
scary now as you have blatantly killed it!!  You murdering fiend!

name: the Skull of Gnatt
longdesc: A wyvern skull has been hung on the wall as a trophy here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the skull of the Wyvern known as Gnatt.  She was a mighty beast, and mother
to a whole new generation of wyverns ready to terrorise the world.

name: a peridot-green potion
longdesc: A peridot-green potion lies here discarded.

extra_descriptions.description: This potion is filled with a lovely-looking peridot-green mixture.

name: a pitted iron shortsword
longdesc: A corroded sword has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword has seen better days.  It has a corroded and pitted blade as if
it has been dipped in acid repeatedly.  It's an ugly old thing.  Throw it
away!

name: Balgor's lost knapsack
longdesc: A useful leather knapsack with 'BAD MUDDAH FUDDAH' stitched on to it is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This rather large and fancy knapsack once belonged to the famed orc hero Balgor.
It has 'BAD MUDDAH FUDDAH' stitched on to a large patch on the front.  Whomever
the illiterate artist was, they captured the essence of mighty Balgor perfectly.
Balgor lost this one drunken night when he was out looking for mountains to
brawl with.  Don't ask...  Anyway, it looks like it will hold a lot of junk...
I mean, useful adventuring-related items!

name: a Goblin finger sandwich
longdesc: A delicious-looking sandwich of goblin fingers has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sandwich is made of 2 slices of gritty white bread around a selection
of goblin fingers.  It's a real delicacy in Moria, dontchaknow!

name: a crysknife
longdesc: A slender crystalline knife is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This knife, known as a crysknife, has been formed from a single slice of moulded
glass.  It is incredibly sharp!!

name: Orky Powah Rune
longdesc: A circular stone disk with a crude rune painted on it has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a circular piece of stone with a rune painted on it in red paint.
Or possibly red crayon - you never know with orcs.  It has all the style
you'd associate with Balgor.  I.e. none.

name: the Lightning Charge
longdesc: A strange charge has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This strange object seems to crackle with trapped power.  Perhaps you can use it
in some way?

name: a Witches Hat
longdesc: A crooked witches hat is here, hanging neatly from a nail in the wall.

extra_descriptions.description:
This hat is black.  It is made using a stiff brim and supported by a willow
wreath structure on the inside.  Unfortunately the structure has broken and
now the tip is all bent and crooked, giving it that evil-crone appearance.

name: a Smiths Focus
longdesc: A smiths focus has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This small object is a smiths focus.  It is used by crafters to give extra power
to their creations.  It's a shame that all you can create is an uncomfortable
silence.

name: the Cloak of Fenris
longdesc: A cloak made from the hide of Fenris is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak has been made out of the hide of Fenris.  That means the mighty
Fenris is dead.  You bastards.

name: Pouch of Dragon Fire
longdesc: A fiery glowing pouch of dragon fire has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pouch has been enchanted to hold the power of dragon's fire.  It looks
really hot to the touch!

name: Red scale of Tiamat
longdesc: A scale from Tiamat's red dragon head is here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}The red scale glows hotly for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This small diamond-shaped scale once adorned the red dragon head of Tiamat.

name: Blue scale of Tiamat
longdesc: A scale from Tiamat's blue dragon head is here.
item_ability_msg: #{blue}The blue scale crackles with static for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This small diamond-shaped scale once adorned the blue dragon head of Tiamat.

name: Green scale of Tiamat
longdesc: A scale from Tiamat's green dragon head is here.
item_ability_msg: #{green}The green scale pulses with disease for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This small diamond-shaped scale once adorned the green dragon head of Tiamat.

name: White scale of Tiamat
longdesc: A scale from Tiamat's white dragon head is here.
item_ability_msg: #{white}The white dragon scale sparkles with frost for a moment.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This small diamond-shaped scale once adorned the white dragon head of Tiamat.

name: Black scale of Tiamat
longdesc: A scale from Tiamat's black dragon head is here.
item_ability_msg: #{black}The black dragon scale fizzles and hisses as it melts.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description: This small diamond-shaped scale once adorned the black dragon head of Tiamat.

name: A fleck of Tiamat
longdesc: a tiny fleck from the body of Tiamat rests here.

name: Hardened brimstone
longdesc: a shiny black gem with a dark red hue glimmering within has been left here.

name: Soul Crusher
longdesc: The ebony-black mace Soul Crusher has foolishly been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Soul Crusher is a true Drow-made weapon, forged in the fires beneath the
Temple of Lloth deep in the Drow city of Rakdagor, with it's filigree-
like platforms that connect pillar to stalagmite to wall to stalactite
in a way the leaves you feeling like you're in the middle of a spider's
web.  Wrought from adamantium, each of the three flanges of the weapon
look like a spider rearing up.  The handle is wrapped in soft human-
skin leather and a single gem can be fitted in to the pommel.

name: Gunhildes' Draught
longdesc: A smoking draught has been left here to gurgle and bubble by itself.
item_ability_msg: #{green bold}Gunhildes' Draught bubbles alarmingly, over-flows and then suddenly goes still..#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This draught has been distilled in to a small potion bottle where it has
been enchanted and the bottle covered in glowing runes.  The green fluid
inside sloshes and bubbles and occasionally smokes... Drinking this will
likely spell your doom.

name: a hidden trap
longdesc: A hidden trap is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This trap seems to be built in to the very room.  From what you can work
out it magically scans anyone entering and if they are not on a pre-
determined list, then they will be hit by some kind of magical blade or
blades that materialise when the trap is triggered.  There does not
appear to be any way of disabling it.

name: an encoded message
longdesc: A message, written on velum, has been left foolishly left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Strangely the letters seem to be dispersed as if to form words yet they
seem to be encrypted in some manner... Strange...

Eqbkp,

Jzqvo gwcz bwemz bw bpm cvlmzkqbg ib wvkm, em pidm vmml wn gwcz uioqk bw
nczbpmz wcz kicam.  Gwc eqtt jm kwuxmvaibml eqbp atidma nzwu Uqloizl ivl
Nwzbzcu bw jwtabmz gwcz pwizl.

Aqovml,

Uibzwv Uwbpmz Tmitm Cuzqa Ihzqvim, Nqzab Pwcam, Uwab Jtmaaml wn Ttwbp.

name: the remnants of a journal
longdesc: The last remnants of a journal has been dropped here to rot.

extra_descriptions.description:
This journal is falling apart, rotting away.  You can't pick up but maybe
you can read it...

There are only a few pages of the journal left.  It seems to have been
written in the spidery hand of a Duergar.  But luckily for you it is all
in common.  The first page that is legible only has a few disjointed
sentences left:

'... The army has increased in size ... Powerful enough now that towns
are being raised in the honour of my ... I took his head and I bound
his spirit to me so that he will forever rage in agony.'

Perhaps the second page will prove more bountiful?

[hint: read 2 for the next page, and so forth.]

This page has at least a whole paragraph intact:

'With the sunsetting I opened the main tower doors and let my minions
flood forth.  They spread out like a plague upon the land, a black mass
of glorious death that was greeted with screams of horror by the farmer
and his family.  I watched from the fields as they brought the mortals
to me.  There the humans sat in wide-eyed terror as one by one I took
their hearts and devoured the meat.  The children were sweetest of all.'

There seems to be yet more gruesome entries for you to read...

This page is in no better state than the one before it:

'That blasted orc has returned.  Damn his trickery.  Damn him to rot
in eternal agony!  I have sent my guards to capture him but he evades
them somehow.  He even has the power to destroy them.  This one insect
must not distract me any longer, I have purpose.'

Yet more pages await your viewing pleasure...

This page is missing most of the paper and what remains is mostly 
charred.  You can still make out some words:

'... His name is Ba ... Curse the golems! ... Activated the tower
protocols to trans ... Lower level invaded by the green sk ...
Have to draw him out in to the ...'

There is one last page left to read...

This page is the most intact of them all, but sadly it appears to have
been written in a rush and a lot of it is illegible:

'... Moved the hoard to the fields near the Lyceum.  There they will
hide until need for them arises.  In the mean time that blasted orc
has managed to follow the tower again.  It is like he can teleport or
create a magical portal of some kind.  I shall tear his heart out and
stuff it ...

... Defences have been compromised and the trap avoided!  A pox on
this green-skinned devil!  The ghouls have been released and now
roam freely on the levels below.  I keep my guards close ...

... He is outside!  I have gathered what forces I have left and
will deal with him myself!  He is done for now - no more stalking
me, toothy runt.  Your heart will be mine!'

Here the journal ends.  It seems that the author rushed out of the
tower and never returned to finish the lovely writings herein.

name: an over-sized, wide-brimmed black hat with a crooked point
longdesc: The largest witches hat you have ever seen is laying on the ground gathering dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a traditional black witches hat and belonged to a very evil
and very powerful Duergar by the name of Millicent Soulforge.  What
is most striking about the hat is its size.  It is enormous.  There
are giants with heads who would be swamped by this thing.  Yet when
worn by Millicent it sits strangely just above her brow where the
brim flops rakishly over one eye.  The material is tatty and worn
around the brim, and the willow wreath lining is broken and crooked.
Yet, even though it is black and over-sized, and creases and cracks
make it appear that it is has a face, you still feel that urge to
wear it.  Almost as if it is alive...

name: a traditional black Duergar dress
longdesc: A lovely black dress has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This traditional black Duergar dress is the very thing to wear to a
funeral.  It is has a narrow waistline and a bustle so that the skirt
flows fully out and down to the ground.  It has long sleeves that end in
points over the back of the hand.  It is also complete with a very low V-
cut bust allowing any lady to show off her assets.

name: an old weather-worn black shroud
longdesc: An old and tatty black shroud has been dropped in the dust here.

extra_descriptions.description: This shroud is very odd looking - it is made of dark, black material that heavy and almost leathery in feel.  It sits over the shoulders and seems to flare out like a huge set of bat wings whenever you walk.  How strange!

name: a long silver chain
longdesc: A long and pretty silver chain has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This chain is quite long and made of silver links.  Although quite plain to look at it is none-the-less pretty for that.  It looks like it can be cinched at the waist to act as a belt.

name: a beautiful silver-filigree spider
longdesc: A beautiful spider made from silver-filigree sparkles in the dust.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a beautifully made silver-filigree spider with ruby-red eyes and an etched widow marking on the abdomen.  It is very clearly Drow in origin.

name: a Duergar ice cake
longdesc: A chunk of grey-looking cake sparkles here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a chunk (for Duergar cake is never sliced) of the world famous
Duergar Ice Cake.  The recipe is known only a few of the Master Bakers
of the Duergar city of Morkrike.  It is a soft, grey cake with a sponge-
like texture and contains mushroom stalks and dongerweed eyes (whatever
that is).  Rumour has it than just a single bite of this cake can heal
you for ages to come.

name: some fingerless lacy gloves
longdesc: A pair of fingerless lacy gloves lay abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description: These dainty gloves are fingerless and have been made from the finest lace.  They make your hands look very feminine.

name: a cruel sickle
longdesc: A cruel, rust-spotted, sickle has been thrust in to the ground here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sickle is a genuine farming instrument for reaping crops like wheat.
It can also be used to lop-off heads should one feel so disposed.  It has
a well used leather-and-wood grip and a very sharp blade that is covered
in little spots of rust.  You could certainly ruin someones day with this
thing.

name: a slab of rubble
longdesc: A chunk of rubble is here.
action: The tower shakes and shudders causing a cloud of dust to fall from the ceiling for a moment.

extra_descriptions.description: This is some rubble.  You don't want it.

name: a slab of rubble
longdesc: A chunk of rubble is here.
action: The tower makes a groaning, rocking sound as if trying to move and then settles in to silence once more.

extra_descriptions.description: This is some rubble.  You don't want it.

name: a pair of ruby slippers
longdesc: A beautiful pair of ruby slippers are here, sparkling.

extra_descriptions.description:
These slippers are beautiful!  They are sparkly red, glowing from within,
with a neat little bow and cute kitten heels.  They would be just the thing
to wear as you skip gaily down a yellow brick road.

name: a bulls nose ring
longdesc: A wide ring of metal, perfect for placing in a cows nose, is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a thick iron ring typical of the sort found in a bulls nose.  It
could be worn on one of your big sausage-like fingers.

name: a barbarian muscle band
longdesc: A band of tough looking leather is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band of tough-looking leather is generally worn by barbarians on their
arms, right above their bicep, to increase how 'muscly' they look.  This is
often not needed as they tend to have muscles on their muscles anyway.

name: an ebony staff
longdesc: A short ebony staff is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This short staff is just an inch too long to be called a rod.  It is
made from pitch-black ebony and has been carved with the Duergar symbols
related to rest:

    \\>|>\//

name: Omshomnargar
longdesc: The mighty staff Omshomnargar floats here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the powerful wizard's staff known as Omshomnargar (which in Orcish
Gutterspeak translates rather loosely to 'stick').  It is about 5 feet in
length and is made of wood.  It belongs to Bashgar - so the immortals-only
know how YOU got hold of it.

name: a wizard's hat
longdesc: A wizard's hat is here, muttering to itself.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a wizards hat.  You can tell it is a wizards hat because it has
the word 'W I Z A R D' embroidered on it along with a few too many stars,
moons, and sequins.

name: a pouch of fairy dust
longdesc: A pouch full of fairy dust is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a lovely green pouch full of fairy dust.  Isn't it magical?!

name: a wizard's robe
longdesc: A wizard's robe is here, hugging itself.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a wizards robe.  You can tell it is a wizards robe because it has
the word 'W I Z A R D' embroidered on the back along with a few too many
stars, moons, and sequins.

name: a handful of sand
longdesc: A handful of sand has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a handful of sand.  It does not look clean.

name: the control room key
longdesc: A dumpy iron key with the words 'Control Room' on it is here.

extra_descriptions.description: This key appears to open the control room in the strange tower in Moria.

name: Duergar dowager diamond
longdesc: A black diamond glints in the filth of the floor here.
item_ability_msg: #{green bold}The Duergar dowager diamond flames a hot green before returning to normal.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This rare diamond is a Duergar heirloom given to females whom have survived
their husbands.  Strangely not many Duergar females outlive the males as in
this dark and secretive society, women hold the most of dangerous of roles;
they are the explorers of depths, the clearers of caverns, the seekers of
new holes and dwellings.  Many die to the creatures in the deep, or in the
oft-numerous explosions of mine gas that seep up from the bowels of the
world.  It is rare to see a Duergar female with wrinkles on her perfect,
gossamer-pale skin.

name: Enchanted Shield of Dragon Turtle Scales
longdesc: A shield of enchanted dragon turtle scales is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a shield made from the shell fragments of a dragon turtle shell.
It has all the hallmarks of a master crafter.

name: a dark iron helm
longdesc: A black and sturdy dark iron helm has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helm has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  It has a padded skull cap and open face, allowing the
wearer good visibility and protection.

name: a dark iron breastplate
longdesc: A black and sturdy breastplate has been left on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This breastplate has been forged by the Duergar deep within the
city of Morkrike.  It has a double layer of thick leather and
strong plate, making it very good at preventing damage.

name: a dark iron shield
longdesc: A black and sturdy shield lies half-hidden in the dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shield has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  The iron has a dark, but very sturdy feel to it, offering
plenty of protection.

name: a dark iron wristband
longdesc: A dark iron wristband is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wristband has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  It extends from the back of the hand all the way up to the
elbow, offering excellent protection.

name: a pair of dark iron leggings
longdesc: A solid pair of dark iron leggings has been left here to rust.

extra_descriptions.description:
These leggings have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  They are well padded, providing comfort and some excellent
protection.

name: a pair of dark iron boots
longdesc: A pair of dark iron boots has been forgotten here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  They are lined with thick, fire-retardant wool and leather,
making them very comfortable and offering amazing protection.

name: dark iron gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of black and sturdy gauntlets has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These gauntlets have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  They are very well made but have the look of a pair of oven-
gloves, offering excellent protection but making you feel a little silly
wearing them.

name: dark iron armbands
longdesc: A fine pair of dark iron armbands lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These armbands have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike.  They are articulated and extend from the elbow up to and over
the shoulder, offering excellent protection.

name: A perfect dragon turtle scale
longdesc: A gleaming red scale has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the perfect scale of a dragon turtle.  There is no damage to
it at all - a rare find!

name: A broken dragon turtle scale
longdesc: A broken, dull red scale has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a broken scale of a dragon turtle.  It is shattered in many
places, rendering it useless.

name: a deep-forged dark iron helmet
longdesc: A gleaming black and sturdy dark iron helmet has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This helmet has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: a deep-forged dark iron breastplate
longdesc: A gleaming black and sturdy breastplate has been left on the ground.

extra_descriptions.description:
This plate has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: a deep-forged dark iron shield
longdesc: A gleaming black and sturdy shield lies half-hidden in the dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shield has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: a deep-forged dark iron wristband
longdesc: A gleaming black and sturdy dark iron wristband is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wristband has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city
of Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: a pair of deep-forged dark iron leggings
longdesc: A pair of gleaming dark iron leggings has been left here to rust.

extra_descriptions.description:
These leggings has been forged by the Duergar deep within the city
of Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: a pair of deep-forged dark iron boots
longdesc: A pair of gleaming black and sturdy dark iron boots has been forgotten here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city of
Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: deep-forged dark iron gauntlets
longdesc: A pair of gleaming black and sturdy gauntlets has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These gauntlets have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city
of Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: deep-forged dark iron armbands
longdesc: A pair of gleaming black and sturdy dark iron armbands lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These armbands have been forged by the Duergar deep within the city
of Morkrike on the legendary black anvil.  Only the mightiest of the
Duergar warband would wear such grand armour.

name: the lava key
longdesc: A red-hot key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The key is made of iron and glows from within.  It is red-hot and quite
painful to hold - it probably won't last long being used.

name: a dark iron axe
longdesc: A black and menacing axe has been dropped here

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged in the depths of Morkrike, city of the Duergar, this axe is the
standard military equipment of the dark hoard.

name: dark iron sword
longdesc: A black-bladed dark iron sword has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged in the depths of Morkrike, city of the Duergar, this sword is 
the standard military equipment of the dark hoard.

name: Drow Cleaver
longdesc: The axe Drow Cleaver has been propped against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Drow Cleaver is a highly illegal weapon in the deep city of Morkrike.  It
goes against the current peace treaty the dark dwarfs have with the Drow
and could, if the Drow discover it, cause a fresh war in the underdark
with ramifications in the surface realms.  Why the Duergar would flaunt
such a thing is unknown.

name: Snoligoster leather boots
longdesc: A pair of boots made from thick Snoligoster leather have been dumped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The Snoligoster is a type of predatory amphibian that lives in deep, dark lakes
far beneath the surface of the realms.  The leather of these boots is blue-black,
and very thick.  A series of glowing, cyan runes run up the back from the heel to
the tip of the ankle, providing some very good magical properties to the wearer.
Only the Duergar of Morkrike know how to fashion such things.

name: a Snoligoster leather skirt
longdesc: A skirt made from thick Snoligoster leather has been dumped here.

The Snoligoster is a type of predatory amphibian that lives in deep, dark lakes
far beneath the surface of the realms.  The leather of this skirt is blue-black,
and very thick.  A single glowing, cyan rune sits at the end of each pleat, so
that if the wearer twirls, they flare out like an angry mushroom.  It does seem
to provide some very good magical properties to the wearer. Only the Duergar of
Morkrike know how to fashion such things.

name: Forgoraren
longdesc: The Duergar ring of power 'Forgoraren' has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forgoraren is one of the five famed rings of power crafted by the Duergar. 
Each of the five rings has it's own unique properties, and is a burden and
a blessing to whomever wears it.  Forged by the Dark Empress herself, these
rings are rumoured to become one ring when all are gathered together.

name: dark iron hammer
longdesc: A hammer made from dark iron has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged in the depths of Morkrike, city of the Duergar, this hammer is 
the standard equipment of the darkforger elites.

name: enchanted Snoligoster boots
longdesc: A pair of enchanted Snoligoster leather boots have been neatly put aside here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made from Snoligoster leather, known for it's intrinsic magical properties, these
boots are as black as midnight on a starless night.  Not only are they comfortable
to wear, they also possess the ability to mask the wearers thermal signature.  The
Duergar of Morkrike are well know for crafting such things.

longdesc: A pair of enchanted Snoligoster leather gloves have been neatly put aside here.

longdesc: An enchanted Snoligoster leather bracelet has been neatly put aside here.

extra_descriptions.description:

name: enchanted Snoligoster leggings
longdesc: A pair of enchanted Snoligoster leather leggings have been neatly put aside here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made from Snoligoster leather, known for it's intrinsic magical properties, these
leggings are as black as midnight on a starless night.  Not only are they comfortable
to wear, they also possess the ability to mask the wearers thermal signature.  The
Duergar of Morkrike are well know for crafting such things.

name: Gnaddlefus
longdesc: The famed warhammer Gnaddlefus has been propped against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is Gnaddlefus, the giant warhammer of the Duergar God Ondeld.  It appears
to have been forged from a single lump of lava-hot iron from the very core of
the realms.  The haft and head are covered in spiky protrusions that range in
size from a marble to a fist.  It looks like it *should* weigh in excess of many
hundreds of pounds, yet when it's held, it seems to fill you with incredible
strength.  It steams in the cool air, and takes both hands to wield!  But it's
power can wielded by all and sundry!

name: a red Ankheg cloak
longdesc: A cloak of Ankheg leather lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cloak has been expertly stitched together from tough and supple
Ankheg leather.  The wonderful thing about this leather is how rare it
is, as it is only found between the armour-like plates of the Ankheg,
and the best of that leather is only found on the underbelly.  A deep
red in colour, it is highly desired by the industrious Duergar of the
deep city Morkrike.

name: red Ankheg boots
longdesc: Some boots lie here, red in color and covered in tough chitin.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots have been expertly crafted from red Ankheg chitin and a
tough, nameless black leather.  The plates of chitin have been smoothed
and shaped to wide, flat feet of the dwarf peoples, with a minumum of
weak points.  Extra spikes and blades have been formed from the chitin
with the idea that they will turn a blade or spear point and offer the
wearer an extra bit of oomph when kicking a foe in the fork.

name: a pair of red Ankheg gloves
longdesc: Some gloves lie here, red in color and covered in chitin.

extra_descriptions.description:
These gloves should really have the moniker of 'gauntlet'.  Crafted from
supply, black nameless leather and fitted with shaped and rounded plates
of Ankheg chitin, they are offer far more armour than your normal set of
gloves.  Made in the secret city of Morkrike, these are a favoured wear
of the dark Duergar.

name: red Ankheg shoulder plates
longdesc: Some red chitinous shoulder plates have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These shoulder plates are made from the large, smoothed and rounded
scales of an adult Ankheg - a dangerous and terrible beast that tends
to spend most of it's life far beneath the surface world.  Shaped to
form arches that curve inwards and up so as to offer extra protection
to the face, they are some of the most sought-after armours favoured
by the Duergar of the deep city of Morkrike.

name: a red Ankheg belt
longdesc: A chitinous plated belt has been left here..

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has been crafted from overlapping plates of tough Ankheg
chitin on a nameless black leather strap.  These objects are among
the most sought after armours in Morkrike.  It looks like it will
be a comfortable wear.

name: enchanted Ankheg boots
longdesc: A fine pair of enchanted Ankheg boots have been stored neatly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These fine boots have been made from an inlay of fine, red Ankheg
leather with interlocking plates of enchanted Ankheg chitin over
the top.  The chitin has been finely inscribed with tiny runes of
power, enhancing the already potent magics it holds.  These boots
are the speciality of the Duergar of Morkrike.

name: enchanted Ankheg gloves
longdesc: Some fine gloves made of enchanted Ankheg chitin lie here, discarded.

extra_descriptions.description:
These gloves have been made from an underlay of fine red Ankheg
leather with lobstered plates of intricate Ankheg chitin that
protects the whole hand down to the wrist.  Each plate of chitin
has been inscribed with intricate runes that enhance the already
potent magics.  A speciality of the Duergar forgers of Morkrike,
these gloves would fetch a handsome price on the surface.

name: enchanted Ankheg shoulder plates
longdesc: Some enchanted Ankheg shoulder plates have been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These beautiful shoulders have been master-crafted from overlapping plates
of smoothed Ankheg chitin and then reinforced with dangerous spikes and
protrusions guaranteed to take someones eye out.  The plates have been
expertly attached to soft and supple red Ankheg leather and then subtly
enchanted.  Only the dark dwarfs of Morkrike would make such things.

name: enchanted Ankheg cloak
longdesc: An enchanted cloak made of red Ankheg leather is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This beautiful cloak has been made from multiple strips of soft red
Ankheg leather cover in over lapping discs of highly polished Ankheg
chitin, giving it a shimmering look whenever the wearer moves.  Each
tiny disc has been inscribed with a rune of power, giving the whole
thing a powerful enchantment to help protect the wearer.  It is well
known that the Duergar of Morkrike are master craftsmen of such works.

name: an enchanted Ankheg belt
longdesc: A belt made from enchanted Ankheg leather has been folded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This belt has been made from a single strip of red Ankheg leather
that has been studded with spikes of Ankheg chitin.  It is quite
the site probably makes sitting down a treacherous task.  You can
bet that the Duergar of Morkrike manufactor such things.

name: a shirt of Ankheg brigandine
longdesc: A shirt of red Ankheg brigandine has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Brigandine is the art of making armour out of a sheet of cloth,
canvas or leather and attaching small oblong plates via rivets
to it.  In this case, the shirt has been expertly crafted from a
nameless black leather that is strong and supple and has polished, 
convex plates of Ankheg chitin riveted in place.  Each plate has
been attached so that it perfectly aligns with all of its sister
plates, leaving no obvious points of weakness.  However, there are
points under the arms and near the neck line that a skilled fighter
could take advantage of.  All said and told, this is a wonderfully
crafted piece of Duergar technology.

name: an enchanted shirt of Ankheg brigandine
longdesc: A shirt of enchanted Ankheg brigandine has been hung neatly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Brigandine is the art of making armour out of a sheet of cloth,
canvas or leather and attaching small oblong plates via rivets
to it.  In this case, the shirt has been expertly crafted from
beautiful, soft red Ankheg leatherand has spiked,  convex plates
of Ankheg chitin riveted in place.  Each plate has been attached
so that it perfectly aligns with all of its sister plates,
leaving no obvious points of weakness.  Only the Duergar of the
deep city of Morkrike craft such things.

name: a ring of excommunication
longdesc: An ugly-looking ring has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This rings looks like it was once a ring of holy power, but has been
defiled with a red brand across the signet.  Originally smelted from
mithril, it still contains some of the once-beautiful engraving.

name: a defiled ring
longdesc: A black and horrible ring has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ring was once a holy ring of Fortish origin, but it has been defiled
with a red, evil-looking brand.  Whatever this ring was once, it is now
a corrupted and evil thing.

name: the ring of the faithless
longdesc: A evil-looking ring has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a defiled ring originally of Fortis design.  At some point in
the past it has been deconsecrated, defiled and purged of it's former
magics and re-imbued with dark and evil tidings.

name: a band of dark faith
longdesc: A band denoting the worship of Ondeld, dark God of the Duergar, is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This band of dark mithril fits perfectly around the wrist.  It has been inlaid
with runes and symbols related to Ondeld, the evil God of the Duergar, a hate-
ful spirit of lava and fire.  The runes tell how the ancient Duergar delved in
to the core of the world and found Ondeld, down there, in the deep places, and
how Ondeld gave them the power to rise up, to challenge the other races.  Only
in Morkrike would you find smiths capable of fashioning such an evil band.

name: a band of sinful deeds
longdesc: A band of unholy original lies here, smoking darkly.

extra_descriptions.description:
Forged from a single strip of mithril, darkened in the fiery pits of Morkrike,
enchanted by master forgers and blessed by the Ruinous One himself, this band
is worn by only the most trusted disciples of Ondeld, the dark God of the
Duergar.  Red runes spit angrily around the wrist, raised above the metal by
powerful magics, and tell the tale of Rian Ashbeard, first dark emperor of
the Duergar, founder of Morkrike, and how His mighty clan rose by virtue of
Ondeld to become the first Duergar dynasty.  This band would only be worn
by the most trusted servants of Ondeld.

name: a red Ankheg skirt
longdesc: A skirt of red Ankheg leather has been placed here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skirt has been made from many (more than you can count) diamond-shaped
cuttings of red Ankheg leather.  Reaching down to the knees it offers some
excellent protection for the discerning Duergar.

name: an enchanted Ankheg skirt
longdesc: A skirt made of encanted Ankheg chitin is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skirt has been made from soft and supple strips of red Ankheg
leather that has been reinforced with rivets and plates of Ankheg
chitin.  Each plate has been smoothed and polished until it is
wafer-thin, and yet still has the stopping power of sheet steel.
The skirt is split at the hip on each side, allowing the wearer
free range of movement and maximum protection.  Extending down to
the ankles, this piece of outer wear would be highly prized by
most Duergar fighters.

name: Aodhan's Stopwatch
longdesc: A masterfully crafted stopwatch has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{cyan bold}Aodhan's Stopwatch ticks faster for a moment!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This beautiful watch has been crafted by a master smith and forger
in the deep, secret city of Morkrike under the explicit instructions
of the famed General Aodhan.  Rumour has it that this watch enables
the dark General to move so fast he becomes a blur!  Circular, and
encased in gold, the delicate mechanisms can be viewed through a
transparent glass window under the dials in the upper portion.  A
gold button on the side is probably what is pressed when the watch
is used.
