longdesc: a fiery hot turtle scale sits here smoldering.

name: Valek's Jewel
longdesc: a precious jewel of from Valek sits her collecting dust.

name: the Rift key
longdesc: A black iron rift key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This a large iron key.  It looks like it will grant access in to a
rift.

name: Deepspeakers' Mantle
longdesc: A thick, dark-grey mantle has been folded up neatly here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This thick woollen mantle fits over the shoulders and hangs half-
way down the back.  It would be just the thing to wear in a cold,
dark cavern.

name: Bhaldor's Forlorn Song
longdesc: A subtle, yet powerful song is here, vibrating to a gentle rhythm.
item_ability_msg: #{green bold}Bhaldor's Forlorn Song builds to a crescendo before fading away!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This smooth, jet-black rock has travelled all the way from the deepest
parts of the underdark and carries with it the very songs the legendary
Deepspeakers sing as they explore and bless the caverns in the name of
the Duergar.

name: Bhaldor's Golden Circlet
longdesc: A small golden circlet lays half-forgotten in the dust here.
item_ability_msg: #{red}Bhaldor's Golden Circlet glows hotly for a moment and then cools!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This circlet fits over your wrist and seems to grow and expand
to form a protective bracer that looks like it will be very,
very effective at what it does.

name: a neat cell key
longdesc: A neat cell key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the key to a neat cell.  It looks like it could
break at any moment.

name: a comfortable cell key
longdesc: A comfortable cell key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the key to a comfortable cell.  It looks like it could
break at any moment.

name: a plush cell key
longdesc: A plush cell key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the key to a plush cell.  It looks like it could
break at any moment.

name: the key to the commandants' office
longdesc: The key to Commandants' Office is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the key to the Commandants' Office.  It looks like it
could break at any moment.

name: the corpse of the Commandant
longdesc: The mangled and mutilated corpse of the Commandant is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the corpse of the Commandant of the Midgard Stockades.  She was a
a great swordswoman, capable and quick witted.  Something beat her to a
pulp, stabbed her multiple times, and by the looks of the ragged tears of
flesh, pulled the bottom-half of her left leg clean off.  She grips some
thing in her left hand that looks like a rag of leather.

Held in the left hand of the Commandant, and gripped tightly, is actually
a patch of leathery, thick skin.  On one side it has been tattooed with
strange markings that seem to make no sense:

Cruvkd,

Wkh irxqgulhv ri Prunulnh ehofk wkhlu dfulg vprnh gdb dqg qljkw dqg wkhlu
vslhv lqilowudwh Iruwuxp.  Uhyhdo brxuvhoi wr rxu djhqw lq Plgjdug dqg
nloo khu.  Xqohdvk fkdrv dqg frqixvlrq.

Vljqhg,

Pdwurq Prwkhu Ohdoh Xpulv Dculqdh, Iluvw Krxvh, Prvw Eohvvhg ri Oorwk.

name: a mask of impersonation
longdesc: A strange, flesh-coloured mask has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mask of leather is really strange.  The leather looks like it could be
real human skin... But no... That would be gross!  It includes a short bob
of blonde hair in the style of the Midgard Thieves Guild. It seems to fit 
around your head and face perfectly, and blends in with your skin.  Wearing
it, you don't feel that much different, so it probably doesn't do anything
fun, like scare the crud out of unsuspecting strangers.

name: a human leg
longdesc: The lower half of a well-cooked human leg has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a fresh human leg (is there such a thing?!) that has been cooked
over a hot fire until the juices run clear.  It looks strangely delicious
and probably tastes like chicken.

name: a dark iron warfan
longdesc: A warfan made of dark iron has been folded up and placed here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This object is known as a tessen, a weapon developed and perfected by
the peoples of Kyoto village, near to Midgard.  However, the elegant
and stylish shaping that is the hallmark of Kyoto is completely lost
on this tiny worker of death.  With a stunted ebony handle, studded
with dark iron rivets for grip, the fan is flicked open in times of
danger to reveal a series of sharpened ribs connected by a wafer-thin,
flexible sheaf of dark iron.  The fan cuts through the air with a
short, sharp hissing sound, leaving no doubt that its bite is not to
be tried.

name: a crude shank
longdesc: A crude shank has been dropped here, waiting for you to pick it up and murder someone with it.

extra_descriptions.description:
This shank is actually a sharpened tin fork from the Stockades.  The prongs
have been cut off, and the narrow tip sharpened on the solid stones walls
of the prison until they glimmer.  If this doesn't kill you, the tentanus
you're likely to get from the filthy metal surely will.

name: the azure oculus
longdesc: A large, round oculus floats a few inches above the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This oculus is a circular slice of mithril that has been enchanted and
imbued with powers of the soul.  It is rumoured to grant great strength
and flexibility to any who use it to light their way.

name: a bottle of prison wine
longdesc: A suspicious-looking bottle of wine is here, smelling faintly of urine.

extra_descriptions.description:
This bottle of wine has been 'brewed' prison-style in the Stockades of Midgard.
The bottle is made of cheap glass, and reuse has seen it chipped and marred by
many different hands.  However, the liquid inside is a heady mix, promising at
the very least a hangover proportionate to the size of the realms.

name: a wooden storage chest
longdesc: A wooden storage chest squats here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a wooden storage chest of the type used by prisons the world
over to store inmates' belongings during their stay.

name: a simple chest key
longdesc: A key to a storage chest has been dropped here, accidentally.

extra_descriptions.description: This is the key to a Stockades storage chest.

name: a stained mithril band
longdesc: A circular band of stained mithril lies here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This circular band of silvery-metal looks quite innocuous at first glance,
with it's slightly tarnished feel and several pits in the metal formed by
what on first impressions seems to be imperfections in the metal.  It is
certainly not something a casual observer would look twice at.  However,
this band has been forged by a master crafter, recreating the mundane to
hide the fantastic, with each mar and burr and imperfection a carefully
arranged masquerade.

name: a fur-lined cloak
longdesc: A rather plush-looking cloak has been hung up on a peg here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Made to keep the wearer warm in colder climates and times, at
first glance there does not appear to be anything special

name: a pair of lined leather pants
longdesc: A pair of lined leather pants lie in a heap here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These pants 'look' like they are cheap and the usual fare that
one would purchase from a seedy market stall in Midgard.  On a
closer inspection you can see that the pants have been well made
with soft, breathable lining and strong, waterproof outer layers.
A set of pockets down one leg allows for a plethora of objects to
be hidden from sight.  There's a certain quality to these that
extends far beyond the mundane.

name: a sleeveless leather tunic
longdesc: A standard sleeveless leather tunic is here, covered in dust.

extra_descriptions.description:
This tunic looks like something a dock worker would wear to during
their work.  On closer inspection though, you can see that the item
is actually very well made, with tight, uniform stitching, a soft
lining, and tough outer layers.  This would cost much more any dock
worker could afford.

name: some dark leather boots
longdesc: A pair of dark leather boots lie in a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These boots look like the kind of thing you'd expect a peasant to
wear.  They are made of a dark leather and lined with a soft and
breathable fabric.  The souls are thin enough to allow you to feel
the ground beneath your feet, yet strong enough to stop every stone
and pebble from making you wince from standing on them.  The cheap
look of these boots is clearly manufactured and there is more than
meets the eye to them.

name: the Eye of Auruch
longdesc: an eye of auruch sits here staring at you.

name: the key to the Border Tower
longdesc: A large iron key with a tower embossed on it has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This large iron key clearly opens something.  But what?  It looks like
it has been newly forged, so perhaps it opens something that was once
broken?

name: the key to the north exit
longdesc: A simple iron key has been left on a table here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This iron key looks brand new, and hardly used.  It probably opens
the north exit in the border tower.

name: the key to the stairs
longdesc: A small iron key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This looks to be a new key with a little paper tag on it that reads;
'Stairs'.

name: a shiny key
longdesc: A small shiny key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This small key has been buffed to a mirror shine.

name: a hatch key
longdesc: A small simple hatch key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This small key is old and opens a hatch of some kind.

name: a dark pouch
longdesc: A dark pouch has been placed on the floor here, free for the taking.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a dark pouch made of an indeterminate material.  It looks like it will hold
money and prevent that tell-tale clinking of coins.

name: a crimson spell pouch
longdesc: A spell pouch baring the insignia of the Crimson Night has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This pouch is made of crimson silk and bares the insignia of the Crimson Night.  I
wouldn't be seen wearing this if I wear you, it could cause you more trouble than
it is worth.

name: the Choker of the Crimson Lady
longdesc: A delicate choker on a silk ribbon has been dropped by mistake here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This delicate choker consists of a ribbon of fine black silk that meets a dual
fastener and focus of rare black gold from the mines beneath the vast Underdark
City of Rakdagor. It is no more than half inch in diameter.  The front bares the
likeness of a beautiful crowned and winged lady, with sockets for gems in place
of where her tiny eyes should be, and wearing a long dress that has been expertly
enamelled in crimson.  The back bears a simple, and elegant, message:

                                  x- Dear Daethie -x
                       For your support and love of our Order.
                 You have our love, loyalty and friendship in return.
                                       x- LL -x

A rare gift of affection from the Crimson Lady herself to her devout supporter
and ally, it would seem...

name: a dark dire mithril vest
longdesc: A vest of dire mithril is sucking up the light here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This vest has been formed from interlocking rings of dire mithril.  It
stretches from one shoulder, where a toughened plate of adamantium juts
up to protect the neck, down over one breast, leaving the other open,
and over the abdomen.  It cinches tight with thick straps of strong,
dark leather.  It looks like it will provide a lot of freedom when in
combat.

name: a dire mithril cinch
longdesc: A cinch made of dire mithril lies forgotten in the mud.

extra_descriptions.description:
This cinch is a simple set of dire mithril links that can be
pulled through a fastener at the hip to 'cinch' it tight to 
the body.  Each link has been decorated with a tiny piece of
adamantium shaped and coloured like a drop of blood.  Each 
dangles from an inch long leather cord.

name: dire mithril shoulder plates
longdesc: A set of dire mithril shoulder plates have left in a heap here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These shoulder plates strap directly on to the upper arms of
the wearer.  Tough leather straps connect them in a cross over
the back and chest.  They have been formed from interlocking
leaves of dire mithril that sit on the shoulders.  Unlike many
drow-made things, these are free from the tell-tale spikes and
points that makes drow armour a danger to run in for fear of
poking out ones own eye.

name: a dire mithril skirt
longdesc: A skirt of dire mithril has been abandoned here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This skirt has been formed from rings of dark dire mithril linked
together by overlapping bands of tough leather.  The skirt is cut
to the hip on the left thigh, allowing the wearer a full range of
movement even in the tightest of spots.  They have been enhanced
by magic to keep the wearer in peak physical readiness.

name: a dire mithril band
longdesc: A thick band of dire mithril has been discarded here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This simple band is made from angular links of dire mithril.  It
covers most of the forearm from wrist to the back of the hand
and, although it offers excellent protection and flexibility,
it probably won't stop many direct blows.

name: dire mithril boots
longdesc: A pair of dire mithril boots have been kicked off and left to rot here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These are actually a very well made pair of knee-high leather boots
that fit snuggly and securely around the heel, instep and calf.  A
set of dark dire mithril plates provide rigid stability in the form
of a sole, toecap, heel guard and shin protector that reaches up to
the knee.  The effect is all finished off with a 5-inch stiletto
heel - which, alide from making the wearer look more intimidating
than they already do, would also cause some serious problems for
any would-be attacker.

name: Murmuration of the Crimson Night
longdesc: A small trinket representing the internal loyalty of the Crimson Night.
item_ability_msg: #{bold red}A loud tweeting of birds rises and fades as the murmation dispands.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
This trinket has been from tiny little shards of dire mithril shaped in
to birds that rise from the ground and follow each other in a large
murmuration.  Each tiny bird, mere millimeters in size, is adorned with
a crimson crest.  It is indeed the perfect symbol for the Crimson Night,
a Sisterhood of Loyal members who follow each other without question.

name: a death writ
longdesc: A crumpled up writ for the death of someone has been left here...

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a writ that has been composed in the common language using red,
angular text.  It looks to be a simple fill-in-the-blanks form:

        #{red}For an agreed price paid in full to the Sisterhood
                          
                            BALGOR ONETUSK

            Is hereby sentenced to death at the hand of

                       CRIMSON SISTER GRISELD#{o}

You wonder if Griseld ever completed her mission...

name: a Horned Diadem
longdesc: A gorgeous horned diadem has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Formed from high-quality dire mithril, a substance forged only in
Rakdagor, the Dark City of the Drow, this diadem is a flexible
coronet mounted with forward-facing dark horns from the Nezzrian
Spider, a prized pet and ally of the drow.

name: Crimson Commanders Chestguard
longdesc: A stylish, crimson coloured chestguard has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This chestguard is formed from lightweight dire mithril that has
stopping power of famed Fortrum plate.  Covering the chest from
the nape of the neck down to the abdomen, and shaped for a slim,
streamlined body of a fighter, the chestguard is held in place
by thick, dark leather straps that meet at the back on a coffin-
shaped plate of the same material designed to offer protection
to the spine.  It has been painted in crimson and bears the
crest of the Crimson Night.

name: a vial of carrion crawler brain juice
longdesc: A vial of carrion crawler brain juice is here, waiting for you to quaff it!

extra_descriptions.description:
This small vial contains a sticky and membranous liquid. Looking
closely you can see bits of brain floating in it.  It's not going 
to be safe to drink, you might as well junk it right now.

name: a skeletal finger
longdesc: A skeletal fingers lies lost in the dust... It probably dropped from a leprous skeleton?

extra_descriptions.description:
This is an intact skeletal finger of a creature whose digits extended
a good fourteen inches from knuckle to tip.  But it can't be a giants'
finger, because the bone is just too thin.  Whatever it belonged to,
you're glad you don't have to look at it.

name: Fang of the Scintillating Scarab
longdesc: A

extra_descriptions.description:
The Fang of the Scintillating Scarab is a weapon of power forged in
blessed fires of the Sacrificial Pits in Rakdagor.  It is passed from
Crimson Lady to Crimson Lady as a mark of leadership.  It consists of
a bright, almost dazzling blade that sparkles in the oily hues of a 
raibnow, and curves from tip to hilt like the crescent moon.  The
handle is carved from the bone of a pitfiend in to the likeness of
a scarab beetle.  It is very well balanced and looks deadly.

name: Atephyon, the Disruptor
longdesc: Atepyon, the Disruptor, is leaning against a wall here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Atephyon is an ornate-looking mace.  It is around a meter in length
from pommel tip, with eight flanges that resemble the legs of a giant
spider.  The bulbous, bloated body of the arachnid acts as a balancing
weight against that of the haft and grip.  It is the tool of one of
the handmaids of Lloth, the dark servants known as Yochlol, that 
attend to their Mistresses' every whim and need.  In times of war, the
handmaids ascend to the material plane, laying to waste armies with
such powerful, demonic weapons.

name: a spider-silk robe
longdesc: A fine robe of expensive spider silk has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a fine robe made the silk of the giant spider.  Generally reserved for
the elite of Drow society, these robes are known to be highly magical.  They
also look really cool.

name: spectral wings
longdesc: Some spectral wings flutter in the breeze here.

extra_descriptions.description:
These wings are the ghostly remnants of a long dead hero who was
raised up the celestial planes for lost heroics.  They are very
light and intangible, but you sense they'd be a great help to
you in certain ways.

name: Crystallised Spirit of the Damned
longdesc: The crystallised essence of a damned spirit lies forgotten in the dust here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the crystallised essence of a damned spirit, probably that
of a spectre or ghost, that was defeated by heroes.  It resembles
a cube of glowing energy.  It doesn't look like it will do much
more than a provide a light in the darkness for you.

name: the Staff of Veszlarea
longdesc: A vile and evil staff rotates on its axis here.
item_ability_msg: #{magenta}The Staff of Veszlarea tries to eat your soul!#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
Veslarea, in the common tongue, means devourer of blood or power. This 
could refer to the fact that this thing is not all that it seems. For
staff it is quite long, over seven feet in length, and formed almost
entirely of dire mithril from the mines of Rakdagor.  The lower third
is plain and unadorned, whilst thick spider-leather has been added at
the centre to form a comfortable handle for the wielder.  The staff
tapers upwards until splitting in two and forming a stylised spider
at the top that glows with a strange, dark light.  One should be very
careful when using such an evil thing.

name: Bite of the Arachnid
longdesc: A scimitar with a crimson blade and bearing the insignia of the Crimson Night is here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This scimitar has been forged from dire mithril in the Underdark city
of Rakdagor.  It has a stark-white bone handle and blade that has been
dyed a crimson colour.  Etchings along the cross-hilt and blade show
a legion of tiny spiders crawling their way up towards the tip.

name: an elixir of aboleth gastric fluid
longdesc: An elixir of bubbling aboleth gastric fluid is here.  Yuck!

extra_descriptions.description:
This elixir has a tangy, unhealthy smell, glows a luminous yellow-
green and bubbles dangerously! It's probably not safe to drink and
you should junk it.  Yeah junk it!

name: the Eye of the Yochlol
longdesc: A black and evil gem lies in the dust here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a dark, evil-looking gem made of black garnet. It has been cut
in to a trillion shape and polished to a lustrous shine.  Looking deeply
in to the perfect facets you can see the outline of a tiny spider that
changes in to the face of a beautiful woman as you turn it in your hand.

name: a heap of coins
longdesc: A heap of coins is in here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a whole heap of coins, don't spend it all at once.

name: a stack of coins
longdesc: A stack of coins is in here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a whole stack of coins, don't spend it all at once.

name: a mound of coins
longdesc: A mound of coins is in here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a whole mound of coins, don't spend it all at once.

name: a locked safe
longdesc: A safe, the size of a whole wall, has been left locked here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a large safe.  In fact, it is so big that you could almost mistake
it for a wall.

name: some floating, bloated corpses
longdesc: Some floating, bloated corpses are here in varying stages of decomposition.

extra_descriptions.description:
These corpses look to vary in age.  Not physical age per se, but the age
of how long they've been down here.  Some, look to have been in this
place for several weeks, whilst a few others look much fresher. The
newer, fresher ones, also do not have the same build or scarring as the
older ones, almost as if they had different professions.  It could be
that the older corpses are all soldiers and the new ones are scouts -
possibly the very scouts sent by Emilee Starsoul from Thaumlore
Fortress?  Either way, the most prominent thing to note is that some-
thing has been eating them, as evidenced by the large bite marks
covering the exposed fleshy parts...

name: mound of human bodies
longdesc: A mound of human bodies is here, stinking and blackened from decay.

extra_descriptions.description:
This mound of human bodies all look to be soldiers from the Border
Tower that have been unceremoniously dumped out here and left to the
elements.  A few fat corpse flies buzz around them, but otherwise
they have been stripped of anything remarkable.

name: some rotting bodies
longdesc: A few bodies lay strewn around the dungeon, festering and stinking.

extra_descriptions.description:
These bodies look to have belonged to former members of the Border
Tower.  They all appear to have died at the hands of an enemy with
sharp blades and have then had their remains dumped in this prison
to stink and fester and add further misery to the last surviving
soldier.

name: an empty carrion crawler head
longdesc: An empty carrion crawler head sits here ready for you to steal.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the empty head of a carrion crawler.  Looking inside you can see that
the brains have been scooped out and the mouthy-tentacles have been tanned and
tied in such a way that allows you to swing the head over your shoulder and
carry around comfortably.  Aside from the dead-eyed stare you get every time
you look at it, it's a nice little container for your adventuring fun.

name: an empty carrion crawler head
longdesc: An empty carrion crawler head sits here ready for you to steal.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the empty head of a carrion crawler.  Looking inside you can see that
the brains have been scooped out and the mouthy-tentacles have been tanned and
tied in such a way that allows you to swing the head over your shoulder and
carry around comfortably.  Aside from the dead-eyed stare you get every time
you look at it, it's a nice little container for your adventuring fun.

name: a precarious table
longdesc: A round, precariously made table squats in the centre of the room.

extra_descriptions.description:
This round table has been assembled from assorted branches, stones, twigs,
rope and other detritus that could be easily scrounged up or stolen.  It
is about 4 foot in diameter and is piled high with meat.  There is an old
cleaver sticking in it.

name: a rusty cleaver
longdesc: A rusty cleaver has been stuck blade first in to the table here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This rusty cleaver has a thick iron blade and an smooth cherrywood handle.
Although pitted with rust, and currently splattered with blood and meat,
it has been well looked after and actually has a very sharp edge.

name: a slab of steak
longdesc: A large slab of prime steak sits here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This steak looks like it has come from a freshly butchered cow.  It is
about an inch thick and is rich red and marbled with fatty deposits. 
It looks like it would go well on a barbecue after being marinated in
mommas special sauce for a day.

name: The mangled corpse of a Kobold
longdesc: The mangled corpse of a kobold lies in the destruction here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is the corpse of a small, dark scaled Kobold.  It is wearing a red
tunic that has been shredded by claws, spilling the soft fleshy innards
of the poor creature.  It's skull has been crushed, probably killing it
instantly.

name: a shredded red tunic
longdesc: A shredded red tunic has been left here.  It is spotted with dark bloody stains.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is shredded remains of a red tunic.  It has been splattered with
blood.

name: a Rusty Key
longdesc: A large rusty key slowly welds itself to the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description: This very old blob of rust used to be a key, once upon a time...

name: a Common Tomb Key
longdesc: A large iron key looks dull and interesting here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This old iron key has a few patches of rust on it but is otherwise
unremarkable.  Kind of like you.  Right?!  It can be used to open
tombs of commoners.

name: a Royal Tomb Key
longdesc: An ornate gold key sparkles in the dust here.

extra_descriptions.description: The golden key is clearly the key to a royal tomb!

name: a Strange Key
longdesc: A strange looking key has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description: This silver key is very strange, you're not sure what it opens...

name: a red tunic
longdesc: An old but functional red tunic has been left in a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description: This is a red tunic.  It is old but wearable.

name: a wicked knife
longdesc: A wicked knife has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This knife is wickedly sharp.  Sadly it is also in a pretty poor condition
with notches on the blade and rusty blotches here and there.  It even looks
to have been dropped in the dirt and not cleaned off.  The handle looks to
made of wood wrapped in someones old red tunic.

name: XTC Goggles
longdesc: A pair of iron goggles with green lenses has been dropped here.
item_ability_msg: #{green bold}The XTC Goggles power down.#{o}

extra_descriptions.description:
These goggles are the type favoured by mad scientists the Realms over.  
They are made from iron frames attached to leather straps with a ratchet
-and-crank mechanism to secure them to any size head (lucky for you with
a head that small).  The lenses are thick and dark-green in colour and
have been treated with a substance that causes the outside to be mirrored,
allowing you to shave or fix your make up out in the field.  A slot has
been added on the left frame-shield for a single gem.

name: a heavy stenchcoat
longdesc: An old and heavy stenchcoat has been left in a pile on the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description:
The stenchcoat looks like any ordinary trenchcoat except that it stinks
to high heaven.  There are no words for the smell this thing produces.
It is a made from old but functional leather that was once black, but is
now a dark-grey colour with cracks around the elbow-creases, waist,
collar and arm-pits.  The lower half is stained with dark mud as if this
piece of outer-wear has seen good use during its life.  A gem socket on
the lapel allows the garment to be augmented to the wearers desire.  If
it wasn't for the smell of wet rat at low tide, this would finish off
your trendy-post-apocalyptic-steam-punk-goth look nicely.

name: a sonic spanner
longdesc: A strange-looking spanner has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Unlike the tools that adorn the wall of your uncles shed, this
spanner gleams as if freshly polished.  It is around 18 inches
in length.  One half has been wrapped in a functional mahogany
leather and acts as a handle whilst the other end consists of
an adjustable wrench set between several moving cogwheels.  Too
short to be a mace or hammer, you could hold it like a knife
and it looks like it would do a lot of blunt damage when used
in anger.

name: a greasy Kobold sausage
longdesc: A long and greasy sausage has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sausage is made from minced or ground meat.  You can't identify what
type of meat, but it is definitely meat.  The meat has been mixed with fat,
salt and some suspicious herbs that leave green flecks on the outside. 
They are definitely herbs and not boogers... You hope.

name: a silverscale vestment
longdesc: A shining vestment of silverscale lies in a pile here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This vestment resembles a normal scale shirt except that it tapers in
dramatically at the waist.  Created by the Elves of old from the scales
of the deep-water Silverscale fish, famed for the almost-mithril-like
hardness and lightness of its armoured coating, it feels like you're 
wearing the lightest cloth but with the protection of the hardest steel.  
Only the Elves of Efravor know the secret to making these, and no one
has set foot on the remote land for hundreds of years.

name: a silverscale diadem
longdesc: A shining diadem of silverscale gathers dust here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This silverscale diadem is an ornamental headband worn by monarchs and
others as a badge of royalty.  However, before being adopted by those in
power as a symbol of authority, it was an effective piece of armour worn
by generation after generation of Elf.  Whilst it looks delicate, it is
immensely strong like mithril but tarnishes like silver.  This one is
blackened, with only flakes of the silvery splendour still visible under
the grime.  It is rumoured that only the Elves of Efravor know how to
work silverscale.

name: a silverscale paudron
longdesc: A shining paudron of silverscale gathers dust here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Although this is a single paudron for a single shoulder, it has been
designed enable the wearer to face the enemy side on, freeing up the
movement of their other arm and shoulder so that one can move faster
and easier, giving an advantage in one-on-one combat.  Shiny like new,
it is rumoured that only the Elves of faraway Efravor know the secret
to working silverscale.

name: a silverscale gorget
longdesc: A shining gorget of silverscale gathers dust here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This beautiful silverscale gorget has been crafted in to a flute and
rope style, creating the illusion of a silvery batwing encompassing the
neck.  With very few pits and stains, you could mistake this piece of
armour as brand new, and not the hundreds, if not thousands of years old
it actually it is.  It is rumoured that the Elves of Efravor are the
only smiths with the knowledge to work silverscale.

name: the Spear of Naralax
longdesc: The silvery spear of Naralax rests here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Named for Naralax, the Elven Goddess of the Sea whom takes the form of a
gigantic eel-like serpent †hat hunts in the deepest trenches of the seas.
Legend tells the tale of Naralax guiding the elves to create the Naga so
that She would be served in those deep, dark places and, through the Naga,
she could send word to the Elven peoples of her desires.  This spear has
been crafted from Silverscale and carved in to Her likeness, with an eel-
like head forming the double-bladed head, whilst the shaft curves in a
gentle S-shape from tip to stem, and is embossed with thousands upon
thousands of tiny eels, all swimming up towards the head.  Blessed with
mighty magics, this spear is one of a kind.

name: the Horseman's Signet
longdesc: A twisted and ugly ring has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This silver band hosts a raised and flattened surface that has been
monogrammed with the wide-grinned leering face of a jack o'lantern.
To enhance the effect, slivers of an unidentifiable gem have been
used to give the scary face an inner green glow.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Freddy
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Freddy Kruger has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of Freddy Kruger
with a black and red striped jersey, a wrinkled prune-like face, evil red
eyes and gore-covered blades extending from gloved fingers.  It looks like
a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Jason
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Jason Voorhees has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of Jason Voorhees
with a white hockey mask, gore-covered machete, big stompy boots and a set
of blue overalls.  It looks like a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Chucky
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Charles 'Chucky' Lee Ray has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of Charlies 'Chucky'
Lee Ray as a possessed doll, with a shock of red hair, fun stripy sweater,
crazed blue eyes and a gore-covered knife taller he is!  It looks like a
lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Candyman
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of the Candyman has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of Daniel Robitailee
(AKA the Candyman) with waxy yellow flesh, pale-blue lips and tiny glittering
eyes that glow dull red.  It looks like a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Pinhead
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Pinhead has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of a cenobite demon
that goes by the moniker of Pinhead with full leather body suit, pale blue
flesh and face and head 'pinned' with, well, pins.  It looks like a lot of
fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Pennywise
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Pennywise has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of a Pennywise, a
demon with a clown fetish, with greased white flesh, fun frilly white one-
suit, shoes so large they flap as it walks, honkable red nose, shock of
scarlet hair and jolly smile filled with razor sharp fangs.  It looks like
a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Michael Myers
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Michael Myers has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of a Michael Myers, 
with grey boiler suit, plain white face-mask and large gore-covered knife.
It looks like a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Count Orlok
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Pennywise has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of a Count Orlok,
better known as the Nosferatu, with tight-fitting Victorian-style coat,
long boney hands that end in claws, pointed ears, hairless-scalp, and
teeth like a thousand needles.  It looks like a lot of fun to play with.

name: a Pumpkin Patch Nitemare
longdesc: An ugly little doll in the likeness of Nitemare has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
Pumpkin Patch dolls are ugly, rotund little creations covered in slugs
and snails.  This one has been made in to the likeness of Nitemare, with
frizzy blonde wig, dancing shoes, shorts and a soul blacker than the very
pits of Hell.  It looks like a lot of fun to play with.

name: the Key to Manor
longdesc: A large, grand-looking Manor Key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This key opens the main doors to Sleepy Hollow Manor.

name: the Key to the Ottoman
longdesc: A small silver key used to lock an ottoman has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description: This key opens the ottoman located in Constable Crane's bedroom.

name: the Key to the Pumpkin Patch
longdesc: A sturdy wooden key to the Pumpkin Patch has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This wooden key has a grip shaped like a pumpkin that has been carved with a
madly grinning face.  The rest of the key is a mess of knotted tendrils that
make you go cross-eyed just looking at them!

name: the Key to the Hidden Grave
longdesc: An ancient, fire-stained black iron key has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This key is made from very heavy black iron.  It looks like it has been
tarnished in a fire at some point.  It is an ugly thing.  You should 
throw it away!

name: a large ottoman
longdesc: A large ottoman sits at the base of the bed.

extra_descriptions.description:
This ottoman is made of sturdy, reinforced oak with cast iron corner
protectors.  The lid is hinged and covered in a soft, padded quilt
that would be comfortable to sit on.  In most cases an ottoman would
contain spare blankets for the bed for use during the cooler months,
but something tells you there is something far more valuable inside
this one.

name: the Horseman's Ring
longdesc: An ugly ring has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This is a plain band of gold that has been inscribed in Elvish with
the words:
#{green bold}
Prepare yourselves,
the bells have tolled! 
Shelter your weak, 
your young and your old! 
Each of you shall pay the final sum! 
Cry for mercy! 
The reckoning has come!
#{o}
You wonder what that awful rhyme could mean...

name: the Witch-Knights Signet
longdesc: An old and grotesque signet has been dropped here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This silver signet is adorned with a wide, flat head emblazoned with
a pumpkin wearing a witches hat that has been adorned by 6 tiny, high
quality diamonds that make it sparkle like it was filled with stars.

name: the Witch-Knights Ring
longdesc: An dull unadorned ring has been dropped here.

name: the Horseman's Blade
longdesc: A very sharp, very beautiful sword has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword has been forged from mithril.  It is beautiful, worthy of
the Elven smiths of old.  It has been emblazoned with flames that pour
from the hilt and flow along the blade, making it shimmer in the light
and glimmer like glass in the night.

name: the Horseman's Edge
longdesc: A very sharp, very beautiful knife has been left here.

extra_descriptions.description:
This knife has been forged from mithril.  It is beautiful, worthy of
the Elven smiths of old.  It has been emblazoned with flames that pour
from the hilt and flow along the blade, making it shimmer in the light
and glimmer like glass in the night.

name: the Horseman's Decapitator
longdesc: A gigantic sword has been dropped here, sharper than the anything you've ever seen.

extra_descriptions.description:
This sword is over 7-feet in length and incredibly heavy.  The grip
and handle is long enough for even a giant to hold it with both hands
and the blade itself is straight, only narrowing at the tip.  Clearly
meant for slicing and not for stabbing.  It is incredibly sharp, and
likely lives up to the name, 'Decapitator'.

name: a Pumpkin Brew
longdesc: A bubbling orange brew fizzes and boils on the floor here.

extra_descriptions.description: This brew comes in a convenient pumpkin shaped bottle, replete with grin so wide you're left wondering where the Cheshire Cat owner is.

name: a Skellington Mix
longdesc: A thin black mix smokes here.

extra_descriptions.description: This mix was made just for you by Jack Skellington.  It comes in a thin test-tube shaped bottle and the cork has been carved to look like a skull.  With inky black liquid inside that smokes and bubbles, you're sure that liquorice is the last thing it will taste like.

name: a Handful of Worms
longdesc: A handful of worms squiggles and squirms here.

extra_descriptions.description: Nobody likes you.  Everybody hates you.  Think you'll go and eat worms?  Big, fat juicy ones?  Teeny weeny ickle ones?  Worms that squiggle and squirm?
